Writing and presenting a short opinion column on a current social issue; vocabulary: шинэчлэл, ардчилал, шударга ёс, авлига, нийгмийн тэгш байдал, үр дагавар, дүгнэлт; grammar: review and free production of all three Mongolian constructions in an essay, and EN: consolidating negative-adverbial inversion in formal written and spoken style

units.scope: research, startups, future tech; converbs -магц, -нгаа; EN: future continuous and future perfect

lessons.focus: A researcher shows a visitor around a university lab in Ulaanbaatar; research vocabulary (experiment, hypothesis, data, sample, result, equipment); EN: future continuous for actions in progress at a future time (This time tomorrow we'll be running the test); MN: review of -ж байна/-на and the simultaneous converb -нгаа (ярьж байхдаа vs. ярьнгаа) for doing two things at once

A conference talk or thesis defense; academic phrases (findings, analysis, conclude, publish, peer review, funding); EN: future perfect for completed actions by a deadline (By June we will have published the paper); MN: converb -магц (immediate sequence: 'as soon as') with result and reporting verbs, e.g. дүн гармагц мэдээлнэ

Pitching an idea to investors in a Ulaanbaatar tech hub; startup vocabulary (founder, investor, prototype, market, launch, scale up); EN: contrasting future continuous and future perfect in business plans (This time next year we'll be selling in three countries; by then we'll have raised funds); MN: combining -магц and -нгаа in planning sentences, e.g. санхүүжилт авмагц, туршилт хийнгээ бүтээгдэхүүнээ сайжруулна

Discussing AI, renewable energy and robots in a friendly debate; future-tech vocabulary (artificial intelligence, automation, solar and wind power, sensor, algorithm); EN: predicting with future continuous/perfect plus certainty adverbs (probably, definitely, by 2050); MN: expressing prediction with -х байх, -ах бий and the converbs -магц/-нгаа in longer sentences

Reading and talking about Mongolian innovation: solar in the countryside, herder apps, mining tech, clean-air projects; vocabulary of development and sustainability (renewable, efficiency, pilot project, adopt, impact); EN: future forms in news-style reports (will have been completed by, will be operating); MN: using -магц/-нгаа in written news style with nominalizations from u37

Capstone panel discussion on ethics, risks and benefits of new technology and what the world will look like in 2040; vocabulary of ethics and debate (risk, regulation, privacy, benefit, responsible); EN: free use of future continuous and future perfect to argue a position (By 2040 we will have changed how we work); MN: review and free production with -магц and -нгаа in connected speech and a short opinion text

units.scope: hedging, tact, irony, softening; particles шүү, л, даа/дээ, биз, юм; EN: hedging and softening language

lessons.focus: Asking a colleague or neighbor for a favor without sounding pushy; polite request vocabulary (хэрвээ боломжтой бол, жаахан, түр); Mongolian softeners -чих, -аач/-ээч with жаахан and the particle л, EN: could/would you mind, I was wondering if, a bit/a little

Giving a cautious opinion in a meeting or class discussion; vocabulary of probability and vagueness (магадгүй, ихэвчлэн, нэг төрлийн, шиг санагдах); Mongolian хэдий ч/-х шиг байна, юм шиг, бололтой and the nominal юм as a softener, EN: seems to, tends to, sort of, I'd say, probably

lessons.title_mn: Эв зүйтэй татгалзах, муу мэдээ дуулгах
lessons.focus: Declining an invitation or delivering criticism diplomatically; vocabulary of feelings and face-saving phrases (харамсалтай нь, уучлаарай, санаа зовох, бодит байдал); Mongolian indirect refusal with -х байх, гэхдээ, ч гэсэн and the particle даа/дээ for gentleness, EN: I'm afraid, with respect, not quite, I see your point but

lessons.title_mn: Шүү, биз, даа: сэтгэлийн өнгө аяс
lessons.focus: Everyday chat between friends and family: reminders, reassurance, seeking agreement; vocabulary of casual talk (мэдээж, за яахав, чи ч гэсэн); the particles шүү (emphatic reminder), биз (expecting agreement), даа/дээ (appeal, mild complaint), EN: right?, you know, tag questions, stress and intonation

Joking with friends and reading sarcasm in a text or at a gathering; vocabulary of humor and understatement (шоолох, ёгтлох, яасан сайн, чамайг хар л даа); Mongolian rhetorical questions and exaggerated praise with л, ч, яасан and the particle юм, EN: sarcasm, understatement, rhetorical questions, Oh great, Thanks a lot, not bad at all

Choosing the right tone for elders, a boss, close friends, and strangers in a longer dialogue and message; register vocabulary (хүндэтгэл, дотно, албан, хэрэглээ); combining particles, polite endings and hedges and judging when they sound too blunt or too stiff, EN: formal vs casual softening, combining hedges and politeness markers

units.scope: casual talk, slang, register shifts; colloquial contractions like байгаам, яасан бэ → яасан; EN: informal speech, ellipsis, fillers

lessons.focus: Casual meetup with friends in Ulaanbaatar; everyday greetings and check-ins (юу байна, яасан, за тийм) vs formal ones; shifting from та to чи and dropping polite endings; EN: informal greetings, contractions (gonna, wanna, how's it going)

Fast talk in a café or on a bus; reduced spoken forms (байгаам, яасан бэ → яасан, за яалаа, мэдэхгүй ээ → мэдэхгүй); how particles and endings get clipped; EN: ellipsis (dropping subject and auxiliary: 'Seen it?', 'Got a minute?')

Phone chat and storytelling with a friend; fillers and reaction words (ингэхэд, тэгээд, аа тийм, өө, ёстой, шүү, биз дээ); keeping a conversation going and showing interest; EN: fillers and backchannels (well, you know, like, right, no way)

Texting and social media among students; current slang, loanwords and abbreviations (кино шиг, гоё, мундаг, чаладаг, лоларх), nicknames; emphatic particles (ёстой, л, шүү); EN: slang and intensifiers (awesome, totally, kind of, super), with notes on when not to use them

Same message to a friend, a grandmother, a boss and a stranger; choosing between чи/та, -аарай/-аач/-уу, honorific vs plain verbs; softening and bluntness; EN: register shifts (Could you... vs Can you... vs Gimme...), hedging and softeners (I guess, sort of, just)

A relaxed evening at a family or friends' gathering, mixing everything; regional and generational differences, humor, teasing, set phrases (за болж байна, яахав, дээ, юм аа); reading tone and context; EN: putting it together, informal idioms, understanding fast native speech

units.scope: lost luggage, delayed flights, hotel complaints; travel problems and solutions; completive -чих (-чихлаа, -чихсан); EN: had better, would rather

lessons.focus: Airport: a flight is delayed or cancelled and you ask staff what happens next; vocabulary: departure board, delay, gate, boarding, rebooking, compensation; grammar: reporting delays with 'be delayed/cancelled' and polite questions about the new time (Нислэг хойшилсон, хэзээ ниснэ вэ?)

Baggage claim: reporting lost luggage at the airport desk; vocabulary: suitcase, baggage tag, description of a bag, claim form, delivery address; grammar: completive -чих to say something has gone/ended up (чемодан үлдчихсэн, алга болчихсон) with simple past forms -чихлаа

Missed connections and lost items on the road (train, bus, taxi); vocabulary: miss a train, forget, lose, wallet, passport, ticket, mistake; grammar: completive -чихсан/-чихлаа for regretful or unintended results (мартчихсан, алдчихлаа); EN: past simple vs present perfect for recent mishaps

Hotel: complaining politely about a room that is noisy, dirty or broken; vocabulary: reception, key card, air conditioning, heating, hot water, towel, noise, refund; grammar: describing a state that has resulted using -чихсан/-сан байна (дулаан ус тасарчихсан байна) and polite requests with -аач/-ээч

Giving urgent advice to a fellow traveler in a problem situation; vocabulary: hurry, insurance, contact the embassy, cancel the card, keep the receipt, report to the police; grammar: EN 'had better (not)' for strong advice; MN -сан нь дээр / -х нь дээр, with completive -чих for finishing things quickly (картаа хаачих нь дээр)

Choosing among solutions: wait, rebook, switch hotels, take a refund, and explaining preferences; vocabulary: alternative, upgrade, voucher, refund, reschedule, compromise; grammar: EN 'would rather (not)' and 'would rather ... than'; MN -хаар/-хын оронд, илүү дуртай/-сан нь дээр, plus review of -чих in a travel-problem role play

units.scope: marriage, in-laws, old and young generations; relationship vocabulary; reciprocal-cooperative -лц/-лд; EN: each other/one another, reflexive pronouns

lessons.focus: Talking about engagement, wedding and marriage plans; vocabulary: сүйен, гэрлэх, хуримлах, сүйт бүсгүй, хүргэн, хурим, гэр бүл, нөхөр, эхнэр; grammar: introduction to reciprocal -лц/-лд (хуримлах, танилцах, ярилцах) and EN: each other / one another in simple statements

First visit to a partner's family and how in-laws address each other; vocabulary: хадам, ураг, бэр, хүргэн, анд, хадам аав/ээж, ураг төрөл; grammar: -лц/-лд with the comitative (-тай) to show doing something together (танилцах, золголцох, мэндлэх); EN: each other vs. one another, possessive forms (each other's)

Couples and relatives sharing chores, money and care; vocabulary: туслах, дэмжих, хуваалцах, итгэх, хүндлэх, үүрэг, хариуцлага; grammar: cooperative -лц/-лд (туслалцах, хуваалцах, зөвлөлдөх, хамтран ажиллах) and бие биедээ / бие биенээ; EN: reflexive pronouns (myself, themselves) vs. each other

Old and young generations at home, passing down traditions and care for elders; vocabulary: ач, зээ, өвөө, эмээ, өтөл, залуу үе, уламжлал, өв залгамжлал, хөгшин настан; grammar: reflexive possessive -аа/-ээ and өөрөө for emphasis in mixed use with -лц/-лд; EN: reflexive pronouns for emphasis and reflexive verbs (enjoy yourself, take care of yourself)

Discussing disagreements between parents and young people over studies, marriage, city vs. countryside life; vocabulary: үзэл бодол, зөрчилдөх, ойлголцох, хэрүүл, хүлцэх, эвлэрэх, чөлөөт, хатуу; grammar: reciprocal-conflict verbs with -лц/-лд (зөрчилдөх, маргалдах, ойлголцох, эвлэрэх); EN: each other/one another in longer sentences and with prepositions (talk to each other, rely on one another)

Giving a short talk about a family's story and how relatives rely on each other over time; vocabulary: удам, өвөг дээдэс, ураг садан, харилцаа, хайр халамж, холбоотой байх, нэгдмэл; grammar: review of -лц/-лд vs. бие биедээ and the reflexive -аа/-ээ in connected speech; EN: review of each other/one another and reflexive pronouns in a narrative

units.scope: tailoring a deel, haircuts, apartment repairs, car service; benefactive auxiliaries -ж өгөх, -ж авах; EN: have/get something done

lessons.title_mn: Хэн хэнд юу хийж өгдөг вэ?
lessons.focus: Asking a friend or neighbor for a favor; everyday favor verbs (carry, fix, lend, explain, bring); benefactive -ж өгөх (doing something for someone) and polite requests like 'надад ... өгөөч'; EN: do something for someone vs. have someone do it, introducing 'have something done'

Visiting a tailor to have a deel made or altered; fabric, measurements, sleeves, buttons, lining, fitting; -уулах causative-like 'have made' (оёулах, засуулах) with -ж авах for getting something for oneself; EN: have/get + object + past participle (I had my deel altered)

lessons.title_en: At the Barber and Hair Salon
lessons.focus: Booking and describing a haircut, coloring, shave, or manicure; hair vocabulary (bangs, layers, trim, dye, shorter, length); -уулах with services (үс засуулах, үс будуулах) and polite instructions with -ж өгөөч; EN: get a haircut / have my hair cut, giving instructions to a stylist

Dealing with a repairman or landlord in an Ulaanbaatar apartment; leaks, heating, wiring, windows, locks, paint, plumber/electrician; -ж өгөх for what the worker does vs. -уулах for what the owner arranges; EN: have/get something repaired, describing problems and asking when it will be done (get the heater fixed)

Taking a car to a garage and understanding the mechanic; oil change, tires, brakes, battery, inspection, estimate; -ж авах (pick up, take back, get for oneself) with -уулах, -ж өгөх in mechanic's promises; EN: have the car serviced / get the brakes checked, past participle in reported work, asking about cost and time

Complaining politely when a service went wrong and negotiating a fix or refund; vocabulary of poor work, warranty, redo, compensation; combining -ж өгөх, -ж авах and -уулах in formal requests (дахин хийж өгнө үү, буцааж авмаар байна); EN: have/get it done again, had it done badly, contrasting have vs. get in formal and informal complaints

units.scope: lectures, research papers, citing sources; -ын талаар, -тай холбогдуулан, academic nominal style; EN: reporting verbs, suggest/recommend + subjunctive

lessons.focus: Situation: a university lecture on social sciences; vocabulary: lecture, topic, thesis, argument, handout, seminar, to take notes; grammar: introducing a topic with -ын талаар / -ийн тухай (лекц нь хотжилтын талаар байлаа); EN: signposting phrases in lectures (today I'll talk about, let's turn to)

Situation: reading and summarizing a journal article; vocabulary: abstract, method, data, findings, hypothesis, conclusion, limitation; grammar: academic nominal style with verbal nouns (-лт, -лтын үр дүнд, -х явц) replacing clauses; EN: nominalization and passive in academic writing (the analysis of data was conducted)

Situation: writing a paper with references and quotations; vocabulary: citation, reference, author, bibliography, quote, paraphrase, plagiarism; grammar: attributing with -ын үзэж байгаагаар, -ийн хэлснээр, -ийн дүгнэснээр and хэмээн/гэж; EN: according to + reporting verbs in the present and past (argues, claims, notes, found)

Situation: building a paragraph that connects a claim to data; vocabulary: evidence, correlation, factor, impact, in relation to, support/contradict; grammar: -тай холбогдуулан, -тай холбоотой, -ын үр дүнд to relate topics and results; EN: linking evidence to claims (this is consistent with, in relation to, is linked to)

Situation: writing the recommendations section of a report; vocabulary: recommendation, proposal, policy, implement, measure, to propose; grammar: formal proposals with -х нь зүйтэй, -х шаардлагатай, -ахыг санал болгов; EN: suggest/recommend/propose/insist + subjunctive (we recommend that the university adopt...) and suggest + -ing

Situation: a conference talk or thesis defense with questions from a panel; vocabulary: panel, supervisor, objection, clarify, contribution, future research; grammar: combining -ын талаар, -тай холбогдуулан and nominal style in a polished spoken-academic register, with hedged answers; EN: reporting verbs and hedging in Q&A (the results suggest, it could be argued that, I'd like to clarify)

units.scope: deals, foreign partners, terms and compromises; -х нөхцөлтэйгээр, -хаар тохиролцох; EN: provided that, as long as, inverted conditionals (Should you...)

lessons.focus: First meeting with a foreign company in Ulaanbaatar; business introductions, company profiles, products and markets; formal openers and stating aims with -хаар ирсэн / -х зорилгоор, EN: polite business small talk and stating purpose with 'we are here to...'

Presenting a proposal for supplying cashmere or meat; offers, prices, quantities, delivery dates; making offers with -х саналтай байна and -хаар төлөвлөж байна, EN: describing proposals with 'we would be willing to...' and 'we can offer...'
Negotiating payment and delivery terms; conditions, deposits, deadlines, guarantees; -х нөхцөлтэйгээр (on the condition that), EN: 'provided that' and 'as long as' for stating conditions

Discussing contingencies in a contract draft such as delays, price changes, and cancellations; risk and contingency vocabulary; hypothetical conditions with -вал/-х тохиолдолд, EN: inverted conditionals ('Should you...', 'Were we to...', 'Had they...')

A tense discussion over price and schedule where both sides give ground; concessions, counteroffers, mutual benefit; -хаар тохиролцох (agree to do), EN: negotiating language such as 'meet halfway', 'in return for', 'agree to'

Wrapping up with a verbal agreement, summary of terms, follow-up email and signing; closing and confirmation vocabulary; combining -х нөхцөлтэйгээр and -хаар тохиролцсон in summaries, EN: summarizing agreements by mixing 'provided that', 'as long as' and 'Should you...'

units.scope: psychology, subtle feelings, regrets; emotion verbs and adjectives with -рх, -мтгай; EN: mixed conditionals

lessons.focus: Talking to a friend after a hard week; a precise emotion vocabulary (nostalgic, uneasy, content, overwhelmed, resentful, relieved) and the mood verbs санаа зовох, урам хугарах, сэтгэл гутрах; EN: gradable vs. extreme emotion adjectives and -ed/-ing pairs (bored/boring, exhausted/exhausting)

Describing personality types in a counseling or workplace chat; temperament words (shy, touchy, anxious, easygoing, gullible); adjective-forming suffixes -мтгай/-мтгий (мэдрэмтгий, ичимтгий, уучлангуй) and -рх (баярхах, гомдоллох, догдолж, шоолонгуй); EN: personality adjectives and collocations (be prone to, tend to, easily + adjective)

A university psychology lecture or podcast; psychology vocabulary (stress, anxiety, habit, memory, motivation, subconscious, coping); verbs and nominalizations for mental processes (санах, мартах, зөвшөөрөх, дасан зохицох); EN: reporting research findings and cause/effect language (lead to, result in, be linked to) in a formal register

Reflecting on regrets over a life decision (leaving the countryside, choosing a major); regret and relief expressions (харамсах, дутуу орхих, дурсах); Mongolian -сан бол, -ах байсан, -маар байсан for regretted past actions; EN: mixed conditionals (If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now) and wish/if only

Discussing how earlier choices shaped who one is today, in a long conversation between old classmates; vocabulary of choice, fate and responsibility (хувь заяа, шийдвэр, үр дагавар, хариуцлага); Mongolian conditional chains mixing past and present time (-сан бол ... одоо -на / -ч байна); EN: mixed conditionals in both directions (If she weren't so cautious, she would have taken the job) with contrast of time references

Comforting a friend and giving gentle emotional advice, then writing a short reflective piece; empathy and coping vocabulary (өрөвдөх, тайвшрах, дэмжих, урам өгөх, хязгаар тогтоох); Mongolian softened advice and empathy with -мээр, -сан нь дээр, шүү/даа; EN: mixed conditionals and hedging in advice (If I were you, I'd have talked to her already) with a review of the unit's emotional vocabulary

units.scope: Mongolian script, loanwords, language policy, translating; word formation -жих, -лах, Russian/English loans; EN: prefixes, suffixes, word families

lessons.focus: A university talk about Cyrillic and the traditional Mongolian script (бичиг, үсэг, босоо бичиг, галиглах); vocabulary of writing systems and transliteration; EN: word families around write/script (write, writer, writing, written, rewrite) and the suffixes -er/-ing/-ten

Chatting with a friend about Russian, English, Chinese and Tibetan loanwords in daily speech (компьютер, вокзал, цай, лам); vocabulary of loanwords and borrowing (зээлсэн үг, гарал); grammar: adapting loans with native suffixes and vowel harmony (шалгалт өгөх, имэйлдэх); EN: Latin/Greek/French-origin prefixes and word roots (inter-, trans-, tele-, -graph)

Playful word-building contest on a language blog; vocabulary of new verbs from nouns and loans (утасдах, чатлах, шинэчлэх, томрох, хөгжимдөх, ухаж ойлгох); grammar: verb-forming suffixes -лах/-лэх, -дах, -рах, -жих with the nuance of gradual or diminutive action; EN: verb-forming suffixes -ize, -ify, -en, -ate and prefixes en-/be-

Radio debate about the State Language Law, signage and school language; vocabulary of language policy (төрийн хэл, хууль, зөв бичих дүрэм, цөөнхийн хэл, хэлний хомсдол); grammar: formal nominal constructions -лт/-лага and -хыг шаардах, -хыг дэмжих; EN: negative and reversing prefixes (un-, dis-, mis-, in-, non-) and noun suffixes -ion/-ment/-ness in policy language

Working with a translator on a book or subtitles; vocabulary of translation (орчуулга, эх хэл, зорилтот хэл, шууд орчуулга, утгын орчуулга, ойролцоо тэмдэг); grammar: Mongolian word order and case-marking pitfalls when rendering English (SVO vs SOV), relative clauses as participles; EN: false friends, collocations and word families built on translate/mean (meaning, meaningful, meaningless, mistranslation)

Review discussion at a language festival or in a dictionary office: coining new terms and choosing between a loan and a native word; vocabulary of lexicography (толь бичиг, нэр томьёо, шинэ үг, утга, хэлц); grammar: consolidation of derivation chains such as ном → номлох → номлол → номлогч and hedged opinions with -х нь дээр, -х шиг байна; EN: full word-family analysis (create, creative, creativity, creation, creator) and choosing the right affix

units.scope: toasts, wedding speeches, ерөөл blessings, public addresses; elevated register, optative -тугай/-түгэй; EN: rhetorical devices, parallelism, the rule of three

lessons.focus: Giving a short toast at a family dinner or Tsagaan Sar gathering; toast vocabulary (хундага, эрүүл мэнд, аз жаргал, урт настан, ерөөх); optative -аасай/-ээсэй and the first -тугай/-түгэй wishes (Урт наслаарай → Урт наслагтун); EN: toasting formulas and the simple rule of three (health, happiness, success)

Delivering a wedding speech as a relative or friend; vocabulary of marriage and family bonds (сүйт бүсгүй, ханиад биш ханилсан, хуримын ёслол, гэр бүл, хань ижил, өргөөс); address forms with vocative and honorific endings plus -тугай/-түгэй for wishes to the couple; EN: parallelism in speeches (balanced clauses, repeated structures such as 'May you...')

Understanding and reciting traditional blessings at a ger-warming, Naadam or the start of a journey; vocabulary of blessing imagery (цагаан сүү, хийморь, аян замын мэнд, элбэг хишиг, өлзий хутаг, сайн сайхан); optative -тугай/-түгэй in full, rhythmic blessing lines and alliteration; EN: rhetorical devices in blessings: repetition, imagery, rhythm, and the rule of three

Opening a ceremony or conference as host or master of ceremonies; formal vocabulary (хүндэт зочид, нээлт хийх, баяр хүргэх, оролцогчид, урилга, талархал илэрхийлэх); elevated sentence connection with -сан/-х participles, -хын өмнө and honorific verbs; EN: formal openings, direct audience address, signposting what you will say

Giving a public address at a graduation, a community meeting or an anniversary; vocabulary of values and appeal (эв нэгдэл, ирээдүй, өв уламжлал, хариуцлага, урам зориг, уриалах); exhortation with -хыг уриалъя, -цгаая and -тугай/-түгэй in a closing appeal; EN: persuasive devices: anaphora, contrast (not only... but also), rhetorical questions, rule of three

Composing and delivering a full short speech with a memorable ending, such as a farewell, retirement or award acceptance; vocabulary of gratitude, memory and farewell (чин сэтгэлээсээ, гүн талархал, мөнхөд мартагдашгүй, золгох, баяртай гэж хэлэх); combining optative -тугай/-түгэй, honorifics and reflexive possessive in a polished close; EN: structuring a speech (opening, three points, closing), delivery tips, pauses and emphasis

units.scope: apartment hunting, ger-district plots, mortgages, moving day; housing terms; -хаас өмнө, -сны дараа, -снаас хойш; EN: future in the past (was going to, would)

lessons.focus: Searching listings and calling a landlord or agent; housing terms (өрөө, давхар, түрээс, барьцаа, зарын сайт, агент); grammar: -хаас өмнө to say what happens before an action (e.g. before signing, before moving in); EN: was/were going to for plans made earlier, e.g. 'I was going to rent a flat downtown'

Visiting flats and comparing options (heating, floor, neighborhood, utilities); vocabulary of condition and features (халаалт, лифт, засвартай, цонх, нийтийн тээвэр); grammar: -сны дараа for sequence after an action (e.g. after viewing it, after the owner left); EN: would for habits and expectations in the past and in reported plans, e.g. 'I thought it would be quieter'

lessons.title_en: A Plot in the Ger District
lessons.focus: Buying or fencing a plot, building a house or putting up a ger; vocabulary of land and utilities (газар, өмчлөх, хашаа, гэрчилгээ, цахилгаан, ус, шугам); grammar: -снаас хойш for 'since' a past event (e.g. since we got the plot); EN: contrasting plans and outcomes with 'was going to... but' and 'would have' in short narratives

Talking to a bank about a mortgage loan; financial vocabulary (ипотек, зээл, хүү, урьдчилгаа төлбөр, сарын төлбөр, баталгаа); grammar: combining -хаас өмнө and -сны дараа in multi-step procedures (before applying, after approval); EN: future in the past in reported expectations, e.g. 'The bank said the rate would drop'

Organizing a move: boxes, movers, truck, cleaning, handing over keys; vocabulary (ачаа, хайрцаг, ачигч, машин түрээслэх, түлхүүр, цэвэрлэх); grammar: -сны дараа and -хаас өмнө to order tasks in a moving plan, -снаас хойш for time elapsed; EN: 'was going to' and 'would' to describe what was supposed to happen and what actually did

Life in the new home: meeting neighbors, registering the address, utilities and local services, missing the old place; vocabulary (хөрш, хаяг бүртгүүлэх, дэлгүүр, сургууль ойр, дасах, санагдах); grammar: review of -хаас өмнө, -сны дараа, -снаас хойш in a connected account of the move; EN: free narrative with future in the past, e.g. 'I knew I would miss it, but I was going to make new friends'

units.scope: police reports, courts, fraud, witnesses; legal vocabulary; embedded questions with эсэх, -х эсэхийг; EN: indirect questions (Could you tell me where...)

lessons.focus: Going to the police station to report a stolen phone or wallet; basic crime and police vocabulary (хулгай, гэмт хэрэг, цагдаа, мэдүүлэг, хохирогч, сэжигтэн); asking and answering simple wh-questions politely, EN: Could you tell me where/what...? (indirect questions with wh-words)

A witness describes a traffic accident or street fight to an officer; witness and evidence vocabulary (гэрч, нотлох баримт, камерын бичлэг, дүрсэлэх, санах); embedded yes/no questions with эсэх, e.g. тэр байсан эсэхийг мэдэхгүй; EN: indirect questions with if/whether (I don't know whether...)

Warning a relative about online banking scams and fake phone calls; fraud vocabulary (луйвар, залилан, залилагч, данс, нууц код, хохирол, мэдээлэл алдах); embedded questions with -х эсэхийг (зөв эсэхийг шалгах, найдвартай эсэхийг лавлах); EN: Do you know if/whether..., I wonder whether... when checking facts

Following a court hearing as an observer or juror; court vocabulary (шүүх, шүүгч, прокурор, өмгөөлөгч, нэхэмжлэгч, хариуцагч, хууль зөрчих, шийдвэр); reporting what the court must decide with -х эсэхийг and шийдэх, тогтоох; EN: indirect questions in formal register (The judge asked the defendant whether...)

Consulting a lawyer about a dispute, fine or contract problem; legal advice vocabulary (хуульч, торгууль, хариуцлага, гомдол гаргах, эрх, үүрэг, шийтгэл, нөхөн төлбөр); polite embedded questions combining эсэх and question words (хэзээ, хэн, яаж) with -х, -сан; EN: Could you tell me whether/how/when... I'd like to know if... (polite indirect requests)

Reading and discussing a crime news story and a court verdict; sentencing vocabulary (ял, ял шийтгүүлэх, цагаатгах, баривчлах, давж заалдах, хоригдол, тэнсэн харгалзах); consolidating эсэх / -х эсэхийг with wh-clauses in summaries and discussion; EN: mixed indirect questions (statements, yes/no, wh-) when reporting investigations and asking for updates

units.scope: recipes, dairy foods like aaruul and öröm, borts, cooking methods; intensive reduplication (ув улаан, цав цагаан), diminutive -хан/-хэн; EN: adjective order, compound adjectives

lessons.title_mn: Гал тогооны хэрэгсэл ба хоол хийх арга
lessons.focus: Helping a relative cook in a Mongolian kitchen; utensils (тогоо, данх, хутга, шанаа) and cooking verbs (чанах, шарах, жигнэх, хуурах, исгэх, борц хатаах); the -хан/-хэн diminutive for small amounts and gentle requests (бага зэрэг давс → давсхан), with English compound adjectives for tools (non-stick, long-handled, well-seasoned)

Sharing a family recipe for buuz or khuushuur; ingredients, quantities, step-by-step instructions; sequencing with -аад/-ээд and дараа нь; EN: adjective order in recipe descriptions (a small round flat dough sheet, finely chopped fresh onion)

lessons.title_en: Dairy Foods: Aaruul, Öröm and Tarag
lessons.focus: Visiting a herder family in summer and learning how dairy foods are made; vocabulary of цагаан идээ, taste and texture words (исгэлэн, шингэн, хатуу, зөөлөн); intensive reduplication for color and quality (цав цагаан, ув улаан, хав хатуу); EN: compound adjectives for food (freshly made, sun-dried, full-fat, home-made)

Preparing for winter in the countryside; making borts (dried meat), storing meat, salting and drying; reduplication for intensity in describing state (хуурай хуурай → хав хуурай, шар шаргал, бүлээн) and the process with -ж болгох; EN: compound adjectives with participles (air-dried, wind-cured, long-lasting, ready-to-eat)

Tasting dishes at a family gathering and giving opinions; taste vocabulary (давслаг, амтат, ширүүн, өөх тос ихтэй, шаржигнасан); combining reduplication with -хан/-хэн for nuance (цайвархан, халуунхан, чихэрлэгхэн) and softening a comment; EN: order of several adjectives before a noun (a delicious hot salty milk tea) and tasting phrases

lessons.title_en: Cooking for Guests: A Holiday Meal
lessons.focus: Planning and hosting a holiday meal in a city apartment or ger: dividing tasks, preparing the table, offering food politely; reviewing diminutive -хан/-хэн, intensive reduplication and instructions together in a longer cooking dialogue; EN: using adjective order and compound adjectives in a descriptive paragraph about a feast (a warm, home-cooked, mouth-watering meal)

units.scope: loans, savings, QPay transfers, scams; finance terms; fractions and percentages (гуравны нэг, хувь), collective numerals -уулаа, approximate -аад; EN: large numbers, the number of vs the amount of

lessons.focus: At a bank branch in Ulaanbaatar opening a savings account and getting a card; vocabulary: данс, карт, үлдэгдэл, хадгаламж, зээл, хүү, нууц код, bank and account terms; grammar: large numbers in Mongolian (мянга, сая, тэрбум) and in English, reading amounts like 2,500,000₮ aloud, plus a pinch of 'the amount of' for money

Comparing interest rates and savings offers between banks; vocabulary: хувь, жилийн хүү, гуравны нэг, талаас, дөрөвний гурав, хямдрал, өсөлт, бууралт; grammar: Mongolian fractions with -ны/-ний (X-ны Y) and хувь, and English fractions and percentages, the number of vs the amount of with countable and uncountable nouns

Discussing a mortgage or small business loan with a loan officer; vocabulary: зээлдэгч, барьцаа, сарын төлбөр, хугацаа, өр, төлөх, зээлийн хүү; grammar: approximate numbers with -аад (гучаад сая, хорь гаруй хувь) and English approximations (about, around, roughly, over), with the number of / the amount of in loan contexts

Paying by QPay, splitting a restaurant bill and sending money to family in the countryside; vocabulary: шилжүүлэг, QR код, гүйлгээ, төлбөрийн картын апп, хураамж, баримт; grammar: collective numerals -уулаа (гурвуулаа, дөрвүүлээ) for sharing costs, with English split the bill between three of us, each and altogether

Receiving a suspicious call or text and warning a relative about online fraud; vocabulary: залилан, залилагч, нууц үг, хуурамч, мэдээлэл, блоклох, гомдол гаргах; grammar: reviewing Mongolian conditional and obligation forms for warnings (-вал, -ж болохгүй, -х ёстой) and English warnings with number of / amount of (a growing number of scams, a large amount of money lost)

Reviewing a monthly family budget and explaining spending and saving habits to a friend; vocabulary: орлого, зарлага, төсөв, хэмнэлт, хөрөнгө оруулалт, татвар, цалин; grammar: combining percentages, fractions, approximate -аад and -уулаа in a short money report, with English large numbers and the number of vs the amount of in a summary

units.scope: Natsagdorj's "Miniy nutag", classic and modern writers, book discussions; literary converbs -вч, -ваас, archaic forms in reading; EN: literary devices, metaphor vs simile, archaic forms in texts

lessons.focus: Situation: a literature class reads the opening lines of Natsagdorj's "Миний нутаг" together; Vocabulary: landscape and homeland imagery (нутаг, хангай, цэнгэг, уул ус, өлгий) and basic poem terms (шүлэг, бадаг, мөр); Grammar: reading older and poetic word forms in a text, with EN archaic and poetic forms in texts (thou, hath, o'er) and how to recognize them

Situation: analyzing images in a poem for a seminar; Vocabulary: literary devices (зүйрлэл, дүр дүрслэл, хүндрүүлэл, цуглуулга, бэлгэдэл) and nature symbols; Grammar: comparison markers -мэт, шиг, адил versus direct metaphor, with EN metaphor vs simile (is vs like/as)

lessons.title_mn: Сонгодог зохиолчид ба тэдний эрин үе
lessons.focus: Situation: a lecture on Mongolian writers such as Natsagdorj, Rinchen and Ayurzana, and how their era shaped their work; Vocabulary: literary history (зохиолч, яруу найрагч, туульс, роман, уран зохиолын урсгал); Grammar: the literary converb -вч (although, however) for contrasts in prose, with EN narrative contrast structures (albeit, however) in texts

lessons.title_mn: Орчин үеийн зохиолчид ба шинэ номууд
lessons.focus: Situation: a bookstore visit and a talk about contemporary Mongolian authors and translations; Vocabulary: publishing and genres (хэвлэлт, гарсан ном, өгүүллэг, тууж, бестселлер, орчуулга); Grammar: the conditional-concessive converb -ваас and literary conditionals, with EN literary devices such as inversion and elevated register

Situation: a book club meeting about plot, characters and theme; Vocabulary: narrative analysis (өрнөл, дүр, гол санаа, өгүүлэгч, төгсгөл, гэнэтийн эргэлт); Grammar: expressing nuanced opinions with participles and -вч / -ваас combined with familiar connectors, with EN critical discussion phrases (the narrator conveys, it reads as)

lessons.title_en: Close Reading: Archaic Forms in Texts
lessons.focus: Situation: writing a short literary analysis of a passage containing older forms; Vocabulary: analysis terms (өнгө аяс, хэлбэр, агуулга, эш татах, ишлэл, тайлбарлах); Grammar: recognizing and paraphrasing archaic verb endings and literary converbs -вч, -ваас into modern Mongolian, with EN paraphrasing archaic and literary English into modern usage

units.scope: Buddhism, shamanism, ovoo rituals, taboos and etiquette; prohibitives бүү, битгий, -х хэрэггүй; EN: be supposed to, be meant to, there's no point -ing

lessons.focus: Talking with a friend about Buddhism and the lama's role in family life, from monastery visits to blessing a new home; vocabulary: lama, monastery (хийд), prayer wheel, incense, мөргөх, залбирах, буян; grammar: be supposed to / be meant to for describing customary expectations (EN) and the habitual -даг/-дэг plus ёстой to express what is customary (MN).

Travelling through the countryside and stopping at an ovoo with a guide who explains what to do; vocabulary: ovoo, blue scarf (хадаг), stones, three circles clockwise, offerings, mountain spirits, байгалийн мөргөл; grammar: step-by-step ritual instructions with sequential converbs -аад/-ээд and the polite imperative; EN: be supposed to for rules of a ritual.

Visiting a herder family and being warned about household taboos (don't step on the threshold, don't point at the ger's hearth, don't pour water on fire); vocabulary: босго, гал, цээр, золгүй, ёс; grammar: prohibitives бүү and битгий with verb stems, and -х хэрэггүй for 'no need to / shouldn't'; EN: negative commands and shouldn't.

Discussing a documentary about Mongolian shamanism and how it coexists with Buddhism; vocabulary: бөө, удган, тэнгэр, сүнс, хийморь, ид шид, зан үйл, шүтлэг; grammar: reporting beliefs and tradition with гэж үздэг / гэнэ, plus careful distance from the claim; EN: be said/meant to and there's no point -ing when skeptics dismiss a belief.

lessons.title_mn: Зочин ба ахмад хүнтэй харьцах ёс
lessons.focus: Preparing a foreign colleague for a visit to a ger and a snuff bottle greeting with an elder; vocabulary: хүндлэх, хоёр гараараа өгөх, зүүн гараар, шаахай, сархад, табу; grammar: contrasting бүү/битгий (direct warning) with -х хэрэггүй (not needed) and softer advice; EN: be supposed to for etiquette and there's no point -ing for futile behavior.

Debating with friends whether young Ulaanbaatar residents should keep old beliefs, such as picking auspicious dates and visiting Gandan; vocabulary: сайн өдөр, зурхай, уламжлал, сэргэн мандалт, ухамсар, хэвшил; grammar: combining prohibitives, obligation and attitude in an extended opinion; EN: be supposed to, be meant to, and there's no point -ing in balanced argument.

units.scope: press conferences, editorials, fact-checking; media vocabulary; mirative -сан юм байна, epistemic юм; EN: sentence adverbs (allegedly, reportedly, arguably)

lessons.focus: Morning editorial meeting at a Ulaanbaatar newsroom; media vocabulary (сэтгүүлч, редактор, мэдээ, нийтлэл, эх сурвалж, гарчиг, нэвтрүүлэг); sentence adverbs for stance in English (reportedly, apparently, officially) and basic epistemic юм in statements like 'Энэ үнэн юм'

A government spokesperson takes reporters' questions; press-conference vocabulary (мэдэгдэл, асуулт хариулт, тайлбар өгөх, мэдээлэл хийх, албан ёсны); mirative -сан юм байна for sudden discovery ('Үнэндээ ийм байсан юм байна'); EN: allegedly, reportedly in reporting claims

Preparing and conducting an interview with a public figure; interview vocabulary (ярилцлага, ярилцагч, асуулга, хариулт өгөхөөс зайлсхийх, дэлгэрэнгүй); epistemic юм to soften or probe ('Та мэдэж байсан юм биз дээ?') contrasted with mirative; EN: arguably, admittedly, supposedly in framing questions

Verifying a viral claim on social media; vocabulary (баримт, няцаалт, худал мэдээлэл, эх сурвалж шалгах, батлах, үгүйсгэх, гуйвуулах); combining mirative -сан юм байна ('худал байсан юм байна') with evidential юм for what turns out true or false; EN: allegedly, supposedly, evidently, clearly for degrees of certainty

Reading and writing an opinion piece on a public issue; editorial vocabulary (байр суурь, санал бодол, шүүмжлэл, үндэслэл, дүгнэлт, нийтлэлч); epistemic юм in argumentation and stance-marking, balancing with гэж үздэг; EN: arguably, undeniably, ostensibly, regrettably to signal the writer's attitude

Capstone: a journalist covers breaking news, interviews witnesses, checks facts, and files a report; ethics and press freedom vocabulary (мэдээллийн эрх чөлөө, нууц эх сурвалж, залруулга, хариуцлага); integrating mirative -сан юм байна, epistemic юм and a range of sentence adverbs (reportedly, allegedly, arguably, apparently) in one coherent news report

units.scope: diplomacy, the third neighbor policy, the diaspora, tourism; complex postpositions -ын оронд, -ын хүрээнд, -ыг дагаж; EN: noun clauses (the fact that, whether, what-clauses)

lessons.focus: Reading a news analysis about Mongolia's geography and its neighbors Russia and China; vocabulary of geopolitics (хөрш, хил, эрх чөлөө, тусгаар тогтнол, харилцаа); intro to postposition -ын оронд ('instead of') for contrasting options, with EN noun clauses introduced by 'the fact that'

Explaining to a foreign student why Mongolia seeks partners such as the US, Japan, South Korea, Germany and the EU; vocabulary of foreign policy (гадаад бодлого, түнш, хамтын ажиллагаа, тэнцвэр); postposition -ын хүрээнд ('within the framework of') for programs and agreements; EN: 'whether' clauses (whether the policy works)

lessons.title_en: At the Embassy and the UN
lessons.focus: A diplomat's briefing and a formal meeting: peacekeeping, summits, treaties; vocabulary of diplomacy (элчин сайд, гэрээ, чуулган, дипломат харилцаа, хүлээн авалт, байр суурь); postposition -ыг дагаж ('following, in line with') for trends and developments; EN: what-clauses as subject and object (what the minister said was...)

A conversation with a Mongolian family living in Seoul or Prague, and a radio piece about diaspora communities; vocabulary of migration and identity (диаспор, гадаадад амьдрах, эх орон, нутаг руугаа буцах, дэмжлэг илгээх, зуршил); -ыг дагаж and -ын оронд used for changing habits and substituted traditions (e.g., celebrating Tsagaan Sar abroad); EN: noun clauses after verbs of feeling and belief (She misses the fact that..., I wonder whether...)

Planning a tourism campaign and guiding foreign visitors to ger camps, the Gobi and Lake Khövsgöl; vocabulary of tourism (жуулчин, аялал жуулчлалын салбар, дурсгалт газр, байгаль хамгаалал, үйлчилгээ, мэдээлэл түгээх); -ын хүрээнд for tourism programs and -ын оронд for alternatives (staying in a camp instead of a hotel); EN: combining what-clauses and 'the fact that' to describe attractions and concerns (what attracts visitors is...)

Capstone: a panel discussion or short essay on Mongolia's place in the world, combining diplomacy, diaspora and tourism; review vocabulary of global relations and national image (имиж, нөлөө, түншлэл, олон улсын хамтын нийгэмлэг); contrast and use -ын оронд, -ын хүрээнд, -ыг дагаж together in connected argument; EN: mixing noun clauses (the fact that, whether, what-clauses) in formal spoken and written opinions

units.scope: visas, scholarships, culture shock, homesickness; continuing aspect -саар байна, -саар байгаад; EN: be used to vs get used to + -ing

lessons.focus: Preparing an application for a government or foreign scholarship; vocabulary: тэтгэлэг, өргөдөл, магистр, элсэлтийн шалгалт, зөвлөмжийн захидал, IELTS; grammar: review of purpose and sequence (-хын тулд, -аад) in application contexts, and EN: talking about plans and requirements with 'to' + verb and 'for' + noun

Visa appointment at an embassy and arriving at a foreign airport; vocabulary: виз, паспорт, элчин сайдын яам, нэвтрэх зөвшөөрөл, хил, байршуулалт; grammar: continuing aspect -саар байна for waiting and ongoing processes (хүлээсээр байна, бөглөсөөр байна); EN: still / yet / already with present perfect and continuous

lessons.title_mn: Эхний долоо хоног ба соёлын цочрол
lessons.focus: Adjusting to food, weather, manners and language in a new country; vocabulary: соёлын цочрол, заншил, хоолны өөрчлөлт, хэлний бэрхшээл, танихгүй орчин; grammar: -саар байгаад for 'having kept on doing, so...' explaining a result (хичээллэсээр байгаад ядарлаа); EN: be used to + -ing (state of familiarity)

Describing gradual adaptation in dorm life, classes and daily routine abroad; vocabulary: дасах, зохицох, дотуур байр, өдрийн хуваарь, хоол бэлдэх, найз нөхөд олох; grammar: contrasting -саар байна with habitual -даг and the verb дасах (-аж дассан); EN: get used to + -ing vs be used to + -ing

Talking with family by video call and with friends about missing home; vocabulary: сэтгэл тавгүй, санах, гэр орноо мэдрэх, видео дуудлага, ганцаардал, баяр ёслол холоос тэмдэглэх; grammar: -саар байна for ongoing feelings and repeated contact (санасаар байна, залгасаар байна); EN: I miss..., get over it, cope with + -ing, review of be/get used to

Writing and giving a talk about your study-abroad experience to students back home; vocabulary: туршлага, сорилт, өсөн дэвжих, санхүүгийн төлөвлөгөө, нийгмийн сүлжээ, буцаж ирэх; grammar: combining -саар байна, -саар байгаад and дасах structures in a reflective narrative; EN: be used to / get used to + -ing in extended advice and reflection

units.scope: gyms, basketball, marathons, training, injuries; causal postpositions -ын улмаас, -ын ачаар, -ын төлөө; EN: gerund vs infinitive (stop, remember, try)

lessons.focus: Signing up at a gym in Ulaanbaatar and asking about memberships, trainers and equipment; gym vocabulary (фитнесийн заал, дасгалжуулагч, гишүүнчлэл, жин, тоног төхөөрөмж); EN: verbs followed by gerund vs infinitive (enjoy, avoid, want, decide, plan) as the base rule

Playing and watching a basketball game with friends and discussing the team and the result; team sports vocabulary (сагсан бөмбөг, тоглогч, баг, оноо, хожих/хожигдох, шүүгч); -ын төлөө (for the sake of, on behalf of) for goals and motivation; EN: gerund vs infinitive with stop and start/begin (stopped playing vs stopped to play)

Preparing for the Ulaanbaatar marathon with a training plan and a running routine; endurance and training vocabulary (марафон, зай, хурд, бэлтгэл, амралт, тэсвэр); -ын ачаар (thanks to, positive cause) for results of training; EN: remember/forget + gerund vs infinitive (remember running vs remember to run)

Talking to a physio about a sprained ankle and missing a race; injury and recovery vocabulary (шүүрэлт, булчин, үе, бэртэл, сэргээн засах, амрах); -ын улмаас (because of, due to, negative cause) in explanations; EN: try + gerund vs infinitive (try taking a rest vs try to run) and regret + gerund vs infinitive

Discussing diet, sleep and staying motivated, and giving advice to a friend who wants to get fit; nutrition and habit vocabulary (хооллолт, нойр, зуршил, урам зориг, зорилго, тууштай); contrasting -ын ачаар, -ын улмаас and -ын төлөө in one text; EN: go on / keep / can't help / be used to + gerund vs infinitive of purpose

Writing and presenting a short report on a university or company sports day, with results, causes and plans; mixed sports vocabulary review (тэмцээн, медаль, дээд амжилт, оролцогч, зохион байгуулагч); using all three causal postpositions accurately in narrative; EN: review of gerund vs infinitive across stop, remember, try, regret, go on in a connected text

units.scope: apartment owners' associations, khoroo meetings, volunteering; inclusive and exclusive ч гэсэн, -аас өөр, зөвхөн ... л; EN: both/either/neither, all/none

lessons.focus: Meeting neighbors and learning how an apartment owners' association works; vocabulary: байр, орц, лифт, хураамж, хамтын өмч, дарга, гишүүн; grammar: EN both/neither/either with two things or people (both owners, neither of us), MN ч ... ч and хоёулаа for 'both'

Discussing everyday neighbor complaints politely; vocabulary: дуу шуугиан, машины зогсоол, хог, хашаа, гомдол, зөрчил; grammar: EN either/neither ... nor in offering options and refusals, MN ч гэсэн ('even/also') for inclusive statements and concessions

Attending and speaking at a khoroo residents' meeting; vocabulary: хороо, хурал, санал, санал хураалт, хуралдаан, тогтоол, дарга; grammar: EN all/most/none/none of the with plural and uncountable nouns in reporting votes, MN бүгд, ихэнх, хэн ч ... үгүй (negative inclusion)

lessons.title_en: Who Is Included, Who Is Not
lessons.focus: Deciding who pays, who votes, and who is exempt in a building or district; vocabulary: оршин суугч, түрээслэгч, эзэмшигч, чөлөөлөгдөх, үл хамаарах; grammar: EN all but / except / apart from vs none, MN -аас өөр ('other than, except') for exclusion

Organizing a cleanup day and recruiting volunteers; vocabulary: сайн дурын ажил, цэвэрлэгээ, мод тарих, оролцогч, санаачилга, хандив; grammar: EN review of both/either/neither/all/none in appeals and invitations, MN зөвхөн ... л for 'only' to stress limits and requirements

Writing and presenting a short proposal for a playground or courtyard improvement and responding to objections; vocabulary: төсөл, төсөв, тоглоомын талбай, дэмжих, эсэргүүцэх, зөвшилцөл; grammar: combined review, EN both/either/neither/all/none in persuasive speech, MN inclusive ч гэсэн, -аас өөр, зөвхөн ... л used together

units.scope: choosing cars, phones, apartments, reviews; equatives шиг, адил, -тай ижил, proportional -ын хэрээр; EN: as...as, not as...as, whereas

lessons.title_mn: Машин сонгох: адил уу, өөр үү?
lessons.focus: Two friends compare a used Toyota Prius and a Hyundai at a car market in Ulaanbaatar; car vocabulary (engine, fuel consumption, mileage, price, condition); the equative шиг and -тай адил/ижил (Энэ машин тэр машин шиг найдвартай) with EN as + adjective + as

lessons.title_en: Not Quite as Good: Phone Comparisons
lessons.focus: Choosing a new phone in an electronics shop and comparing models; phone vocabulary (battery, camera, storage, screen, brand); expressing 'not as ... as' with шиг ... биш, -гүй, and -аас дутуу, with EN not as ... as and (not) nearly as ... as

lessons.title_mn: Орон сууц сонгох: давуу ба сул тал
lessons.focus: A couple compares a central apartment with one in a new district, weighing rent, size, location and noise; housing and neighborhood vocabulary, pros and cons; ижил/адил in noun phrases (ижил үнэтэй, адил том, ижил хэмжээний) with EN the same ... as, similar to, different from

lessons.title_en: The More, the Better? Proportional Change
lessons.focus: Discussing how price, quality and comfort change together when choosing between options (e.g. bigger flat, higher rent); vocabulary of change and proportion (increase, in proportion to, depending on, budget); proportional -ын хэрээр / -сан хэрээр with EN in proportion to, the higher ... the better, as ... gets ...

Reading and writing online reviews of products, shops and services on Mongolian and international sites; review vocabulary (rating, pros/cons, recommend, value for money, disappointed); contrast with харин, мөн ... бол ..., -ж байхад and EN whereas, while, on the other hand

Family or friends discuss and justify a final choice between a car, a phone and a flat, using all unit structures; decision vocabulary (compromise, priority, worth it, regret, choose over); combining equatives, negated equatives, proportional -ын хэрээр and contrast to argue and persuade, with EN as ... as, not as ... as, whereas in a spoken and written summary

units.scope: negdel collectives, Soviet times, the 1990 democratic revolution; past habitual -даг байсан, -саар ирсэн; EN: would vs used to for past habits

lessons.title_en: Grandma's Village in the Negdel Days
lessons.focus: A grandmother describes life on a herding collective (negdel) in the countryside; vocabulary: нэгдэл, сум, бригад, малчин, төлөвлөгөө, хөдөлмөрийн баатар; grammar: past habitual -даг байсан for routines that no longer exist, contrasted with plain -даг; EN: would vs used to for past habits (introducing used to)

Adults recall childhood in the 1970s-80s; vocabulary: пионер, октябрист, орос хэлний хичээл, дүрэмт хувцас, багш нар, хурал; grammar: -даг байсан with time frames and frequency words (долоо хоног бүр, тэр үед); EN: would for repeated past actions, and why would cannot describe past states

Sharing memories of rationing and shopping in the 1980s; vocabulary: талон, дэлгүүрийн дараалал, ховор бараа, нөөц, хуваарилалт, үнэ тогтоосон; grammar: -даг байсан in negative and question forms (-даггүй байсан, -даг байсан уу?); EN: used to vs would in negatives and questions, with states (we used to have, not would have)

Talking about studying abroad and imported goods and ideas; vocabulary: ЗХУ-д суралцах, оросоос орж ирсэн бараа, мэргэжилтэн, тусламж, уул уурхай, Дархан, Эрдэнэт; grammar: -саар ирсэн (by way of/through, means or route) and ablative origin -аас ирсэн for sources and arrivals; EN: used to and would in storytelling with contrasts to the present (but now...)

Witnesses recall hunger strikes and demonstrations in Sükhbaatar Square; vocabulary: ардчилал, жагсаал, цөлжилт, намууд, хоолны გაფიცვა (өлсгөлөн stranger removed: өлсгөлөн зарлах), нийгмийн өөрчлөлт; grammar: contrasting one-time past events (-сан, -лаа) with background habits (-даг байсан) in one narrative; EN: used to/would versus past simple for single events in a narrative

lessons.title_en: Then and Now: Telling Family History
lessons.focus: Capstone: an interview with an elder and a family-history talk comparing socialist-era life with today; vocabulary: зах зээл, хувьчлал, шилжилтийн үе, ой санамж, дурсамж, нийгмийн халамж; grammar: combining -даг байсан, -саар ирсэн and past tenses in extended recollection with нэг үе, одоо бол; EN: using would/used to appropriately across a longer spoken or written memoir, avoiding overuse of would

units.scope: jokes, anecdotes, comedy shows, puns; expressive ideophones like пид пад, түг таг; EN: puns, homophones, understatement

lessons.focus: Friends swapping jokes at a gathering; joke vocabulary (онигоо, шог, инээд хүргэх, цэг дээр нь, өгүүлбэр төгсгөл); the structure of a joke (setup and punchline) with narrative converbs -аад/-ээд and the quotative гэж to deliver a punchline; EN: understatement as a joke device (not bad at all, a bit of a problem)

Describing rain, footsteps, and a crowded market vividly; ideophones such as пид пад, түг таг, шаагих, бүгдрэх, жигдэрсэн; forming and using reduplicated sound-image words as adverbs with байх/хийх; EN: onomatopoeia and expressive adverbs (pitter-patter, thud) in everyday description

Playing with words at a family dinner or on a radio show; homonyms and near-sounds in Mongolian (нар, хар, ус/үс style pairs, case-ending ambiguity) and how a pun turns on them; using the particle л and -aa to point at the second meaning; EN: puns and homophones (flour/flower, knight/night, I'm reading a book on anti-gravity)

Telling a funny story about a mishap in the countryside or on a bus; anecdote vocabulary (тохиолдол, инээдтэй явдал, гэнэтийн эргэлт, хэл амтай); building suspense with -тал/-тэл, -хад/-хэд, and evidential -жээ/-чээ for surprise; EN: narrative timing, understatement and deadpan (Well, that went well)

Watching a stand-up night or a TV comedy in Ulaanbaatar and reviewing it; vocabulary of comedy (инээдмийн жүжигчин, үзэгчид, шоглох, егөөдөх, хошин шог, хэт хэтрүүлэх); evaluating humor with -мээр, -маар, -мтгай and the epistemic юм; EN: reviewing performances, hyperbole vs understatement, irony in speech

lessons.title_en: Is It Funny, or Too Far?
lessons.focus: Discussing the limits of humor, teasing friends, cultural differences in jokes, and translating wordplay; vocabulary of tact (доог тохуу, гомдоох, зохисгүй, хил хязгаар, шоглох); softening and justifying with -сан ч, гэхдээ, биз, шүү and polite hedging; EN: explaining why a pun is untranslatable, and softening a joke that landed badly with understatement

units.scope: management, feedback, workplace conflict; agentive participles -гч as nouns (удирдагч, зохион байгуулагч); EN: dependent prepositions and noun + preposition collocations

lessons.focus: Introducing a new manager to the team; leadership roles (удирдагч, захирал, ахлагч, менежер, дэд); forming agent nouns with -гч from verbs (удирдагч, зохион байгуулагч, хөтлөгч, шийдвэрлэгч) and how they differ from -ч professions; EN: noun + preposition collocations for roles (head of, responsibility for, authority over)

Planning a project meeting and assigning tasks; delegation vocabulary (даалгавар, хуваарилах, хариуцах, хугацаа, эцсийн хугацаа); -гч nouns for task roles (зохион байгуулагч, хэрэгжүүлэгч, зохицуулагч, хянагч) with -х үүрэгтэй and -ыг хариуцах; EN: dependent prepositions with verbs (delegate to, depend on, be in charge of, report to)

A performance review conversation between a manager and an employee; feedback vocabulary (үнэлгээ, сайжруулах зүйл, давуу тал, дутагдал, шүүмж, урам өгөх); tactful phrasing using -гч nouns (шүүмжлэгч, дэмжигч, зөвлөгч) and softened criticism; EN: adjective + preposition collocations (good at, proud of, critical of, satisfied with)

Discussing what motivates a team and a leader's style; motivation vocabulary (урам зориг, шагнал, хариуцлага, итгэл, хөгжил, багийн замаг/уур амьсгал); -гч nouns describing leader types (чиглүүлэгч, урамшуулагч, эрхлэгч, шийдэмгий удирдагч) in descriptions and comparisons; EN: noun + preposition collocations (commitment to, trust in, reward for, influence on, respect for)

Resolving a disagreement between colleagues, with a mediator; conflict vocabulary (зөрчил, маргаан, үл ойлголцол, буулт хийх, эвлэрэх, зуучлагч); -гч nouns for roles in disputes (зуучлагч, гомдол гаргагч, эвлэрүүлэгч, шийдвэрлэгч) with reasons and responsibilities; EN: dependent prepositions in conflict language (argue with/about, disagree with, apologize for, blame someone for, clash over)

Presenting recommendations on team culture at a staff meeting; culture vocabulary (ил тод байдал, хүндлэл, хамтын ажиллагаа, ёс зүй, ажил амьдралын тэнцвэр, хариуцлага); combining -гч nouns in short formal proposals (санаачлагч, хэрэгжүүлэгч, хяналт тавигч) with earlier unit patterns; EN: review and use of dependent prepositions and noun + preposition collocations in a spoken proposal (focus on, contribution to, commitment to, approach to, emphasis on)

units.scope: urban planning, satellite towns, architecture, public space; nominalized subjects -х нь, -сан нь; EN: concessive whatever/however/no matter + clause

lessons.focus: Describing Ulaanbaatar's rapid growth in a radio interview with an urban planner; vocabulary: population density, master plan, urbanization, migration to the capital, infrastructure; grammar: nominalized subjects with -х нь (Хот өргөжиж байгаа нь...) and -сан нь to state facts and evaluations (Хүн амын өсөлт хурдассан нь...); EN: noun clauses as subjects in formal description

Debating plans to build satellite towns such as New Kharkhorum and Zuunmod at a public forum; vocabulary: satellite town, commuting, relocation, land allocation, zoning, green belt; grammar: -х нь with case endings as object and in oblique cases (нүүх нь, нүүснийг, нүүхэд); EN: concessive whatever/whoever + clause (Whatever the government decides, residents will...)

Talking with a ger district resident about redevelopment and moving into apartments; vocabulary: land plot, utilities, sewage and heating, compensation, resettlement, redevelopment; grammar: -сан нь / -х нь with possessive and evaluative predicates (Орон сууцанд нүүсэн нь дээр байсан, нүүх нь хэцүү); EN: however + adjective/adverb (however small the plot, however long it takes)

Walking through the city with an architect comparing Soviet-era blocks, glass towers and traditional ger-inspired design; vocabulary: facade, skyscraper, heritage building, materials, design, skyline; grammar: nominalized clauses as reasons and contrasts (барилга өндөр байгаа нь, төлөвлөсөн нь учраас); EN: no matter how/what/where + clause to express contrast about design choices

lessons.title_mn: Нийтийн орон зай ба өдөр тутмын амьдрал
lessons.focus: Writing a community proposal for parks, squares, bike lanes and playgrounds in a district; vocabulary: public space, pedestrian zone, green area, accessibility, lighting, safety, urban furniture; grammar: -х нь + хэрэгтэй / чухал / зүйтэй to argue what matters (Хүүхдүүд аюулгүй тоглох нь чухал); EN: whatever/wherever/whenever in proposals (wherever space allows, whenever possible)

Giving a short presentation and joining a panel discussion on a vision for the capital; vocabulary: sustainability, smart city, public transport, green energy, long-term vision, stakeholders; grammar: combining -х нь and -сан нь in extended argument and summary (Хэн ч юу ч гэсэн, өөрчлөлт хийх нь...); EN: mixing whatever/however/no matter + clause for persuasive, balanced conclusions

units.scope: ordering online, couriers, returns and refunds; e-commerce terms; purpose/cause -хаар, -х гэсэн чинь; EN: make/let/allow + object + verb

lessons.focus: Choosing items in an app or website and placing an order; e-commerce vocabulary (сагс, захиалга, нэмэх, хөнгөлөлт, төлбөр, апп); EN: make + object + verb (The app makes me log in again) and MN: causal-purpose basics with -хаар (захиалахаар сайт руу орлоо)

Tracking a parcel and talking with a courier about address and timing; delivery vocabulary (хүргэлт, курьер, хаяг, илгээмж, хүлээн авах, хоцрох); MN: -хаар for intention when going/calling (хүлээн авахаар гарлаа); EN: let + object + verb (Let the courier leave it at the door)

Opening a package and discovering surprises, good or bad; unpacking and product-condition vocabulary (хайрцаг, сав баглаа, эвдэрсэн, дутуу, буруу размер); MN: -х гэсэн чинь for unexpected discovery (нээх гэсэн чинь хагарсан байлаа); EN: allow/permit + object + to-infinitive (The shop doesn't allow customers to open sealed items)

Requesting a return or refund from customer service by chat or phone; vocabulary (буцаах, солих, баримт, баталгаа, мөнгө буцаалт, нөхцөл); MN: contrasting -хаар (purpose) with -х гэсэн чинь (discovery) in complaints; EN: make/let/allow contrasted in policy language (The policy lets you return items within 14 days)

Reading reviews, spotting fake shops, and paying safely with QPay or card; vocabulary (сэтгэгдэл, үнэлгээ, хуурамч, залилан, нууц үг, картын мэдээлэл); MN: cause with -хаар and -х гэсэн чинь in warnings and stories (төлөх гэсэн чинь сайт алга болсон); EN: make/let/allow with passive and negative forms (We were made to wait; I won't let them cheat me)

Telling and responding to a full shopping story from order to refund, e.g. a Tsagaan Sar gift ordered online; review of the unit's vocabulary; MN: combining -хаар and -х гэсэн чинь in connected narration; EN: make/let/allow/get in a short mixed narrative and role-play

units.scope: driving tests, road signs, fines, winter roads; traffic vocabulary; -хгүй бол, -хаас бусад, -тал нь; EN: in case vs if, otherwise

lessons.focus: Enrolling at a driving school in Ulaanbaatar and preparing for the theory test; vocabulary: жолооны үнэмлэх, шалгалт, багш, гарын авлага, суудал, дугуй, тоормос; grammar: -хгүй бол ('if not / unless') for requirements, e.g. 'Шалгалтад тэнцэхгүй бол үнэмлэх авч болохгүй'; EN: otherwise as a linking adverb for consequences

Reading road signs and explaining rules to a new driver; vocabulary: замын тэмдэг, гэрлэн дохио, зам хөндлөх газар, хурдны хязгаар, урдуур түрүүлэх, зогсоол; grammar: -хаас бусад ('except for') for exceptions, e.g. 'Нийтийн тээврээс бусад машин энд орохгүй'; EN: except (for) and otherwise in rules

Being stopped by traffic police and discussing a fine, paying it by QPay; vocabulary: цагдаа, торгууль, зөрчил, акт, хурд хэтрүүлэх, бүс зүүх, төлбөр; grammar: -хгүй бол with consequences and warnings, e.g. 'Хугацаанд төлөхгүй бол торгууль нэмэгдэнэ'; EN: otherwise vs or else in warnings

Preparing the car for icy roads and snow in January; vocabulary: хөл цана, гөлгөр зам, цас шуурга, өвлийн дугуй, гинж, антифриз, тээврийн түгжрэл; grammar: -тал нь ('part of it / some of them') with partitive meaning, e.g. 'Замын тал нь мөстэй'; EN: in case vs if (in case it snows vs if it snows)

Car breaks down on the road to the countryside and you call for help; vocabulary: хөдөлгүүр, аккумулятор, дугуй хагарах, өөрөө татах машин, засвар, бензин; grammar: combining -хгүй бол, -хаас бусад and -тал нь in one explanation; EN: in case plus otherwise, e.g. 'Take a spare tire in case you get a flat; otherwise you'll be stuck'

Planning a long drive and giving safety advice to a friend, then a mock driving-test interview; vocabulary: review of traffic, sign, fine and winter-road terms, plus осол, даатгал, анхны тусламж; grammar: contrast of -хгүй бол, -хаас бусад, -тал нь in connected advice; EN: in case vs if vs otherwise in extended spoken and written advice

units.scope: hiking, camping, outdoor mishaps; nature-trip gear; -сан хойно, -чихвал, -х байсан юм; EN: should have / could have / needn't have + past participle

lessons.focus: Friends plan a weekend camping trip and check their gear list; tent, sleeping bag, stove, flashlight, backpack, first-aid kit; -х байсан юм for intentions that did not happen ('I was going to bring it') with EN: should have + past participle for forgotten items

Arriving at the campsite by the Tuul river and pitching tents, making a fire; camp-building vocabulary (peg, rope, firewood, campsite, riverbank); -сан хойно for 'after/since having done' (майхан барьсан хойно гал түлэв) with EN: could have + past participle for missed alternatives

A hike goes wrong when the group takes a wrong turn on a mountain path; trail vocabulary (trail, map, compass, signpost, summit, slope, GPS signal); -сан хойно to sequence events ('after we had walked for hours...') with EN: should have / shouldn't have + past participle for criticizing choices

Sudden rain, hail and a cold night in the Gorkhi-Terelj hills; weather and clothing vocabulary (raincoat, soaked, shiver, thunderstorm, damp, dry out); completive -чихвал for conditions ('if it gets all wet/ruined') with EN: needn't have + past participle for wasted effort ('we needn't have worried')

A twisted ankle, a burned hand, a lost phone, and calling the rescue service or asking nearby herders for help; outdoor injuries and emergency vocabulary (sprain, blister, bandage, rescue, signal); -чихвал for warnings about bad outcomes ('if it breaks/gets worse') combined with -х байсан юм for regrets; EN: mixed should have / could have / needn't have to discuss what went wrong

Friends retell the whole trip around the fire, joking about mistakes and learning lessons for next time; trip-review vocabulary (lesson learned, leave no trace, rubbish, wildlife, starry sky); integrating -сан хойно, -чихвал and -х байсан юм in a connected narrative with EN: should have / could have / needn't have for reflection and advice

units.scope: kindergartens, choosing schools, parenting styles; childhood vocabulary; -х гэж оролдох, -хыг хичээх, -уулж сургах; EN: question tags and echo questions

lessons.focus: Parents visiting and comparing kindergartens in Ulaanbaatar; vocabulary: цэцэрлэг, багш, хоолны цэс, бүлэг, элсэлт, төлбөр, нойрны цаг; grammar: question tags (isn't it? don't they? aren't there?) to check information and invite agreement, with Mongolian equivalents such as биз дээ, тийм биз?

Parents chatting about a toddler's development and daily care; vocabulary: нялх, хүүхэд, алхах, ярьж сурах, шүд гарах, тоглоом, хөдөлгөөнт тоглоом; grammar: echo questions in English ("She walked at ten months." "She did?") to show surprise or interest, and Mongolian reaction forms such as тийм үү? ийм үү?

lessons.title_mn: Сайн зуршил төлөвшүүлэх гэж оролдох нь
lessons.focus: A mother describing her attempts to get a child to brush teeth and tidy up; vocabulary: зуршил, шүдээ угаах, цэвэрлэх, дуулгавартай, зөрүүд, дэг журам; grammar: -х гэж оролдох (try to) and -хыг хичээх (make an effort to), with EN try to / do one's best to and tags in everyday requests

Grandparents and parents teaching a child to ride a horse, read, and help with chores; vocabulary: сургах, дадуулах, уншиж сурах, морь унах, гэрийн ажил, тусалах; grammar: causative -уулж сургах (train someone to do) such as уншуулж сургах, ажил хийлгэж сургах, with EN teach someone to / get someone to and echo questions in dialogue

Parents discussing public, private, and English-language schools, class sizes, and commuting; vocabulary: ерөнхий боловсролын сургууль, хувийн сургууль, анги, хичээл, дүн, хөтөлбөр, зайны холбоо; grammar: combining tags, echo questions, and the -х гэж оролдох / -хыг хичээх patterns to debate and confirm opinions politely

A family discussion between generations about strict and gentle upbringing, screen time, and discipline; vocabulary: хүмүүжил, чанд, зөөлөн, шагнал, шийтгэл, хязгаар тогтоох, үлгэр дуурайл; grammar: review of -х гэж оролдох, -хыг хичээх, -уулж сургах with question tags and echo questions in a longer natural conversation

units.scope: moral dilemmas, values, fairness debates; abstract ethics terms; rhetorical questions -хгүй гэж үү, яах юм бэ, -х биш гэж; EN: it's (high) time + past, if need be, as it were

lessons.focus: Everyday moral dilemma: a cashier gives you too much change, and friends discuss what to do; core ethics vocabulary (ёс зүй, шударга, шударга бус, үнэт зүйл, итгэл үнэмшил, ухамсар, хариуцлага); EN: it's (high) time + past simple ('It's time we told the truth') for urging action

Conversation about whether it is ever acceptable to lie to spare someone's feelings or to protect a family member; vocabulary of honesty and trust (үнэн, худал, нууц, итгэл, хууран мэхлэх, шударга зан); MN: rhetorical questions with -хгүй гэж үү ('Үнэнийг хэлэхгүй гэж үү?') to challenge a view; EN: 'if need be' for conditional necessity

Debate on fairness: university admissions, quotas, salaries, and who gets help first; fairness and justice vocabulary (тэгш байдал, шударга ёс, давуу эрх, ялгаварлан гадуурхах, хуваарилах, эрх тэгш); MN: rhetorical яах юм бэ ('Яах юм бэ, хүн бүр тэнцүү биш бол?') to express doubt or resignation; EN: 'as it were' for hedging a loose description

Dilemma at work: reporting a friend's wrongdoing or a boss's corruption; whistleblowing vocabulary (үүрэг, үнэнч байдал, авлига, мэдээлэгч, сонголт, үр дагавар, шийдвэр гаргах); MN: rhetorical -х биш гэж ('Дуугүй байх биш гэж!') for emphatic objection; EN: reviewing 'it's high time we reported it' and 'if need be' in workplace argument

lessons.title_mn: Уламжлал ба орчин үеийн үнэт зүйл
lessons.focus: Family and generational disagreement over customs, elder respect, and individual freedom, including Mongolian-life examples such as obligations to relatives; vocabulary of values and tradition (уламжлал, хүндлэл, эрх чөлөө, нийтийн ашиг, хувийн ашиг сонирхол, тэвчээр); MN: combining the three rhetorical patterns (-хгүй гэж үү, яах юм бэ, -х биш гэж) in a persuasive speech; EN: 'as it were' and 'it's time + past' for nuanced argument

Capstone: discuss a classic dilemma (a limited resource, an emergency decision, a technology ethics case) in a panel discussion and write a short reasoned position; abstract ethics terms (зарчим, хүлцэл, эв нэгдэл, шүүн тунгаах, ёс суртахуун, давхар стандарт); MN: choosing rhetorical forms for tone, persuading without sounding aggressive; EN: integrating 'it's high time', 'if need be', and 'as it were' in a balanced argument

units.scope: cashmere trade, cooperatives, herder markets; agricultural economics; distributive тус бүр, нэг нэгээр, -ын хэмжээгээр; EN: each/every/per, rates and ratios

lessons.focus: A herder family in Arkhangai weighs where to sell its livestock products; vocabulary of herding economics (мал, бүтээгдэхүүн, худалдан авагч, зах зээл, орлого); distributive тус бүр for 'each' (айл бүр, нэг малчин тус бүр) with EN each/every

Selling raw cashmere to a buyer in spring combing season and negotiating the price; vocabulary of cashmere (ноолуур, самнах, түүхий эд, чанар, килограмм, үнэ); per-unit prices with -ын хэмжээгээр and EN per (per kilo, per head)

A village meeting where herders discuss forming a herder cooperative; vocabulary of cooperatives (хоршоо, гишүүн, хувь нийлүүлэх, ашиг, дүрэм, санал хураах); distribution of shares and duties with нэг нэгээр and тус бүр, EN each/every in formal proposals

Reading a soum livestock census and comparing herd sizes across aimags; vocabulary of livestock statistics (малын тоо толгой, сүргийн бүтэц, бэлчээрийн даац, өсөлт, бууралт); expressing proportions with -ын хэмжээгээр and хувь, EN rates and ratios (one in five, twice as many, a ratio of 3 to 1)

A herder family calculates annual costs of hay, fodder, transport and loans versus income from cashmere, wool and meat; vocabulary of agricultural economics (зардал, ашиг, алдагдал, өртөг, татаас, зээл); combining distributive forms in calculations (нэг толгой тутамд, сар бүр, жил тутам), EN per capita, per annum, rates of change

Presenting a short analytical report at a regional forum on sustainable herding, fair cashmere supply chains and herder incomes; vocabulary of policy and sustainability (тогтвортой, нийлүүлэлтийн сүлжээ, дэмжлэг, шинэчлэл, үзүүлэлт); integrating тус бүр, нэг нэгээр, -ын хэмжээгээр in formal summary, EN reporting figures with each/every/per and ratios

units.scope: earthquakes, fires, floods, emergency services; disaster response terms; -х гэж байтал, -хаас наана, -магцаа шууд; EN: be about to, be on the verge of, be bound to

lessons.focus: Dialing 101, 102, 103 and describing an emergency to a dispatcher; emergency services vocabulary (цагдаа, гал команд, түргэн тусламж, яаралтай дуудлага, ослын газар); EN: be about to (The building is about to collapse) with the Mongolian near-future pattern -х гэж байна as a contrast

Earthquake in an apartment block in Ulaanbaatar: what to do during and after the tremor; earthquake vocabulary (газар хөдлөлт, чимээ, доргилт, нүүлгэн шилжүүлэх, үлдэгдэл); grammar: -х гэж байтал 'just as I was about to... suddenly' for sudden interruptions; EN: be about to in narration (I was about to leave when...)

A winter fire from a stove in a ger district, evacuation and firefighters; fire vocabulary (гал түймэр, утаа, гал унтраагуур, галын хор, амь аврах); grammar: -магцаа шууд 'immediately upon doing' for quick reactions (сэрмэгцээ шууд гарав); EN: be on the verge of (on the verge of panic/tears/collapse)

Summer flash floods in Ulaanbaatar and the countryside, warnings and rescue; flood vocabulary (үер, голын ай, далан, усны түвшин нэмэгдэх, аврах завь, хамгаалалтын байгууламж); grammar: -хаас наана 'before reaching / short of' for limits and deadlines (үер ирэхээс наана нүүх); EN: be bound to (Heavy rain is bound to cause floods)

National Emergency Management Agency, shelters, volunteers, donations after a disaster; response terms (онцгой байдал, нөхөн сэргээх, хүмүүнлэгийн тусламж, түр хоргодох байр, сайн дурынхан, хохирлын үнэлгээ); grammar: combining -х гэж байтал, -хаас наана, -магцаа шууд in one report; EN: be bound to / be about to / on the verge of for predictions and risk

lessons.title_mn: Бэлэн байх нь аюулгүй байх нь
lessons.focus: Community preparedness: emergency kit, evacuation plan, drills at school and khoroo, a news bulletin summary; preparedness vocabulary (яаралтай үеийн цүнх, нүүлгэн шилжүүлэх төлөвлөгөө, сургуулилалт, сэрэмжлүүлэг, урьдчилан сэргийлэх); grammar: review of all three Mongolian patterns in speech and short writing; EN: review of be about to, be on the verge of, be bound to in a spoken safety briefing

units.scope: memoirs, reflective essays, life lessons; abstract reflection vocabulary; -сан юм бол, -х юм гэхэд, -даг байж; EN: cohesion through substitution (so, do so, one)

lessons.focus: Opening a short memoir about childhood in the countryside or a ger district; memory and reflection vocabulary (дурсамж, туршлага, эргэцүүлэх, өөрчлөгдөх, утга учир); EN: substitution with 'one/ones' to avoid repeating nouns (the house I grew up in, not the one I live in now)

Writing a reflective essay on a mistake and what it taught you; life-lesson vocabulary (сургамж, алдаа, ухаарах, нөхөн сэргээх, хариуцлага); grammar -сан юм бол for 'if it is the case that / since' with a reflective stance; EN: 'so' as a substitute for a clause (I think so, I hope so, if so, I was afraid so)

Describing habits and values inherited from grandparents and herder traditions; character and values vocabulary (зан чанар, зуршил, үнэт зүйл, хүмүүжил, тэвчээр); grammar -даг байж for 'although one habitually does... yet' contrasts; EN: 'do so / does so' to replace verb phrases (She always rose at dawn, and I did so too)

Essay about leaving home or choosing a career, weighing what was gained and lost; abstract vocabulary of decision and regret (сонголт, золиослох, эргэлзээ, харамсал, эвлэрэх); grammar -х юм гэхэд for 'as for doing / even supposing it came to'; EN: combining 'one', 'so' and 'do so' in contrasts (the road I took and the one I didn't)

Reflecting on how Ulaanbaatar, family and homeland changed and how you changed with them; identity and time vocabulary (өв залгамжлал, хувирал, мөн чанар, үе, холбоо); review of -сан юм бол, -х юм гэхэд, -даг байж in one flowing text; EN: cohesion chains mixing substitution forms with pronouns and linking phrases

Drafting and polishing a personal essay with an introduction, reflection and conclusion; essay-structure and evaluation vocabulary (өгүүлэмж, дүгнэлт, үзэл бодол, тусгах, өөрийн дүгнэлт); consolidating all three Mongolian structures for tone and nuance; EN: editing for cohesion by replacing repetition with so, do so, one

units.scope: music festivals, concert tickets, crowds, open-air events; entertainment terms; causal -сан учраас, -х тул, -сан болохоор; EN: so...that, such...that

lessons.focus: Friends look up a summer music festival online and decide to go; festival and concert vocabulary (на›нц концерт, фестиваль, уран бүтээлч, тайз, хөтөлбөр, олон нийтийн арга хэмжээ, задгай талбай); introducing causal -сан учраас to explain why an event is popular or chosen (e.g. 'Дуучид олон ирдэг учраас очмоор байна'); EN: because/so review as lead-in to so...that

Buying tickets online and at the box office, comparing seat types and prices; tickets vocabulary (тасалбар, VIP, ердийн суудал, урьдчилан захиалах, зарагдаж дууссан, QPay-ээр төлөх, буцаан олгох); causal -х тул in semi-formal notices and explanations (e.g. 'Тасалбар дууссан тул...'); EN: so + adjective + that (The tickets were so expensive that...)

Arriving at a packed venue, queuing, security checks, losing a friend in the crowd; crowd and venue vocabulary (дараалал, хяналтын цэг, орох хаалга, хөл хөдөлгөөн, нягтрал, цугларах, төөрөх); causal -сан болохоор in casual speech explaining delays and problems; EN: such + (a/an) + adjective + noun + that (It was such a long queue that...)

Enjoying an outdoor evening show, weather, food stalls, sound and lights; open-air event vocabulary (чанга дуу, гэрэлтүүлэг, чөлөөт бүс, аж ахуйн зөөврийн хоолны павильон, борооны цув, хүйтэн болох); contrasting -сан учраас / -х тул / -сан болохоор by register and nuance; EN: choosing between so...that and such...that (so loud that / such loud music that)

Talking after the show and writing a short social media review; evaluation vocabulary (гайхалтай, сэтгэл хөдлөм, жүжиглэл, хамтлаг, дуу авиа, хөгжимчин, шүүмж, сэтгэгдэл); combining cause suffixes with results in longer sentences, e.g. '...тул ... байсан'; EN: so...that / such...that for strong opinions and reviews (The show was so good that we stayed until the end)

Understanding announcements and writing a polite complaint about a cancelled or delayed event; organizer vocabulary (зохион байгуулагч, цуцлагдах, хойшлогдох, аюулгүй байдал, нөхөн олговор, зарлал, уучлал гуйх); formal cause chains with -х тул and -сан учраас in announcements and emails; EN: so...that and such...that in explanations and complaints (The delay was such a problem that many guests left)

units.scope: quitting smoking, new routines, lifestyle changes; habit vocabulary; aspect auxiliaries -ж эхлэх, -хаа болих, -сан хэвээр; EN: still, already, yet, anymore

lessons.focus: A friend decides to start jogging in the morning at Sukhbaatar Square; habit vocabulary (зуршил, дадал, дэглэм, өглөөний гүйлт, эхлэх); the inchoative auxiliary -ж эхлэх (гүйж эхэлсэн, ном унших гэж эхэлсэн) and its English counterpart 'started to / started -ing' with the adverb 'already'

A man tells his family he has quit smoking and explains how it feels; health and addiction vocabulary (тамхи татах, донтох, хорих, өөрийгөө хянах, нікотин); the cessation construction -хаа болих (тамхи татахаа болилоо) with reflexive -аа/-ээ; EN: 'not ... anymore / no longer' and 'stopped smoking'

Old classmates meet after years and compare who has stayed the same; life-status vocabulary (хэвээр, өөрчлөгдөх, адилхан, хуучин, одоо ч); the continuity pattern -сан хэвээр / -даг хэвээр (ажилласан хэвээр, ам бүл хэвээр); EN: 'still' (position in sentence) versus 'anymore' in negatives

lessons.title_mn: Аль хэдийн үү, одоо болтол уу?
