lessons.focus: Coworkers check on progress of a new daily routine and fitness plan; time-progress vocabulary (аль хэдийн, одоохондоо, хараахан, сүүлийн үед, дөнгөж); negative-expectation structures -аагүй байна / хараахан ... -аагүй; EN: contrast of 'already', 'yet', 'still' in statements, questions, and negatives

Moving from a ger district to the city and adjusting diet, sleep, and screen time; lifestyle vocabulary (хэв маяг, хоолны дэглэм, нойр, дасах, хэвшил, хазайх); combining -ж эхлэх, -хаа болих and -сан хэвээр in one story about before and after; EN: narrating change with 'used to', 'no longer', 'still', 'have started to'

A support-group conversation about relapses, motivation, and small wins, plus giving encouragement; persistence vocabulary (дахин ундрах, тэвчээр, урам, хэвшүүлэх, шийдэмгий, дахин эхлэх); mixed review of -ж эхлэх, -хаа болих, -сан хэвээр with softened advice; EN: still / already / yet / anymore review in a longer discussion

units.scope: passwords, hacked accounts, screen time, online privacy; cybersecurity terms; iterative -аад байна, -х гээд байна; EN: keep + -ing, tend to, be likely to

lessons.focus: Setting up a new account and choosing a strong password; vocabulary: нууц үг, нэвтрэх, бүртгэл, хэрэглэгчийн нэр, давхар баталгаажуулалт; grammar: introducing -х гээд байна (keeps trying/wanting to, keeps saying) with the system asking again and again; EN: keep + -ing (The site keeps asking me to change my password)

Reporting a hacked social media or bank account to a friend or support center; vocabulary: хакердах, сэжигтэй линк, залилан, вирус, мэдэгдэл ирэх; grammar: iterative/continuous -аад байна (keeps happening, messages keep coming in); EN: keep + -ing for repeated problems (Someone keeps logging in from another country)

Talking with family about phone habits and screen time limits; vocabulary: дэлгэцийн хугацаа, мэдэгдэл унтраах, донтох, апп, цэнэг; grammar: contrasting -аад байна with -х гээд байна for repeated habits and repeated intentions (хараад байна vs үзэх гээд байна); EN: tend to (I tend to scroll before bed)

lessons.title_mn: Миний мэдээллийг хэн харж болох вэ?
lessons.focus: Checking privacy settings on social media and apps; vocabulary: нууцлал, хувийн мэдээлэл, зөвшөөрөл, байршил, хандах эрх, тохиргоо; grammar: combining -аад байна and -х гээд байна in complaints about apps that keep requesting permissions; EN: be likely to (Apps are likely to share your location)

Recognizing phishing texts, fake QPay links and phone scams, and warning an older relative; vocabulary: фишинг, хуурамч, мэхлэх, баталгаажуулах код, мэдээлэл алдах; grammar: using -аад байна in narration of ongoing scam attempts and -х гээд байна for pushy requests; EN: tend to / be likely to to describe scam patterns (Scammers tend to create urgency)

Giving a short talk or writing tips for safer digital habits at work or school; vocabulary: програм шинэчлэх, нөөцлөх, нийтийн Wi-Fi, VPN, нууцлалын бодлого; grammar: review of iterative -аад байна and -х гээд байна in tips and warnings; EN: review of keep + -ing, tend to, be likely to in advice and risk statements

units.scope: life events, congratulations, condolences; respectful nouns and euphemisms (бие давхар, бурхан болох, нас барах); EN: expressing sympathy, euphemisms

lessons.focus: Sharing and responding to pregnancy news with relatives; pregnancy and birth vocabulary with tactful terms (жирэмсэн, бие давхар, хөл хүндэлсэн, төрөх); EN: polite ways to ask about and react to personal news (How exciting! When is the baby due?)

Visiting a new mother and baby, naming and first-month customs; newborn and family vocabulary, blessings and gifts (нялх, нэр өгөх, төрсний баяр, хүүхдийн ерөөл); EN: congratulating and wishing well (Congratulations on..., May she grow up healthy)

Attending a Mongolian wedding as a guest; engagement and wedding vocabulary (сүйтгэх, ёс, хуримын ширээ, сүйт бүсгүй, хүргэн, ерөөл, бэр авах); EN: toasts and congratulations to newlyweds, giving gifts and polite thanks

Learning of a death in the family and speaking about it gently; euphemisms and respectful nouns (нас барах, бурхан болох, өөд болох, ужиг, өвчтэй байсан vs нас эцэслэх) with register differences; EN: euphemisms (pass away, lose someone, no longer with us) versus blunt wording

Attending a funeral and visiting a grieving family; condolence phrases (гүн эмгэнэл илэрхийлье, сэтгэл хөдөлж байна, тэнгэрт заяа, мөнх амгалан), mourning customs and what to avoid saying; EN: expressing sympathy (I'm so sorry for your loss, My thoughts are with you, If there's anything I can do)

Talking about remembrance, anniversaries and life milestones in a conversation or short memorial speech; memorial vocabulary (дурсгал, дурсамж, жил болох, өвлөх, амьдралын үе шат) combining joyful and sad events in one text; EN: combining tact and warmth in a eulogy or message, review of euphemisms and sympathy phrases

units.scope: surveys, census results, charts, reports; statistics vocabulary; -аас хамаарч, -тай харьцуулахад, -ын дийлэнх; EN: describing trends (rise sharply, a steady decline), approximation

lessons.focus: A news article reports a national survey; survey and census vocabulary (судалгаа, асуумжийн хуудас, хариулагч, түүвэр, хүн амын тооллого, нийт); describing proportions with the structure -ын дийлэнх (хариулагчдын дийлэнх нь...) and EN: the majority/a minority of, approximate quantities (roughly, around, just under, well over)

Describing a line chart of Ulaanbaatar's population and prices; trend verbs and nouns (өсөх, буурах, огцом нэмэгдэх, тогтвортой өсөлт, бага зэрэг хорогдох); EN: rise sharply, fall slightly, a steady decline, a sudden peak, adverb-adjective pairs

Comparing statistics between years and regions (Ulaanbaatar vs. aimags, 2010 vs. 2020); comparison vocabulary (өмнөх оныг бодвол, харьцангуй, ялгаа, зөрүү); -тай харьцуулахад as the main comparison pattern; EN: compared with/to, whereas, twice as high as, the gap between

Explaining which factors influence results (age, income, region, education) in a research summary; factor and correlation vocabulary (хүчин зүйл, хамаарал, нөлөөлөх, насны бүлэг, орлогын түвшин); -аас хамаарч for variation by factor; EN: depending on, vary according to, be related to, tend to

Giving a short office or class presentation on a bar or pie chart; presentation vocabulary (диаграмм, хувь, дундаж, медиан, хамгийн их үзүүлэлт, тэнхлэг); combining -ын дийлэнх, -тай харьцуулахад, -аас хамаарч in a structured talk; EN: signposting (the chart shows, as can be seen), approximation and rounding (about a third, nearly 40 percent)

Writing a short written report on census or survey findings with cautious conclusions; report vocabulary (дүгнэлт, хязгаарлалт, тооцоолол, урьдчилсан мэдээ, статистик алдаа, чиг хандлага); consolidating all three structures in formal written style, avoiding overclaiming; EN: describing future trends (is expected to, is projected to, is likely to), hedged conclusions

units.scope: women in the workforce, housework, equal pay debates; social equality terms; contrastive биш харин, -хаас илүүтэй, -ыг эс тооцвол; EN: rather than, let alone, not so much X as Y

lessons.focus: Talking about women's share of the workforce in Mongolia (teachers, doctors, bankers, miners); vocabulary: ажиллах хүч, мэргэжил, цалин, албан тушаал, эрэгтэй/эмэгтэй хүн; grammar: contrastive биш харин ('not X but rather Y') paired with EN 'rather than' for simple contrasts

Couples and families discussing who cooks, cleans and looks after children and livestock; vocabulary: гэрийн ажил, хоол хийх, цэвэрлэгээ, хүүхэд харах, хуваалцах, ачаалал; grammar: -хаас илүүтэй ('more than / rather than') for preferences and priorities, with EN 'rather than' + verb/noun forms

A news-style discussion of the gender pay gap in Mongolian companies; vocabulary: цалингийн зөрүү, адил тэгш хандлага, ахиц, шалгуур, хөдөлмөрийн хөлс; grammar: not so much X as Y, rendered through биш харин and -хаас илүүтэй to explain causes

lessons.title_mn: Үл хамаарах тохиолдол ба нарийн заалт
lessons.focus: Reading statistics and workplace policies and noting what is excluded; vocabulary: статистик, үзүүлэлт, хууль тогтоомж, хөнгөлөлт, тусгай нөхцөл; grammar: -ыг эс тооцвол ('except for, not counting') with EN except for / apart from alongside 'let alone' for extremes

lessons.title_mn: Хэвшмэл ойлголт ба нийгмийн тэгш байдал
lessons.focus: Discussing stereotypes about men and women, fathers on parental leave, and men's role in families; vocabulary: хэвшмэл ойлголт, тэгш эрх, ялгаварлан гадуурхах, хүйсийн тэнцвэр, өмөөрөх; grammar: combining биш харин, -хаас илүүтэй and -ыг эс тооцвол in longer arguments, with EN 'let alone' and 'not so much... as' in opinions

A panel or short essay on women in politics, business leadership and quotas, and how to build fairer workplaces; vocabulary: квот, манлайлагч, саад бэрхшээл, дэмжлэг, оролцоо, өөрчлөлт; grammar: review and free production of all three contrastive structures (биш харин, -хаас илүүтэй, -ыг эс тооцвол) with EN rather than / let alone / not so much X as Y

units.scope: snow leopards, Gobi bears, poaching, national parks; conservation terms; double negation -хгүй байж болохгүй, -хгүй байх аргагүй; EN: litotes and formal double negatives (not uncommon)

lessons.focus: A ranger briefs visitors about snow leopards in the Altai and Khangai mountains; vocabulary: ирвэс, нэн ховор, амьдрах орчин, популяц, ан амьтан; grammar: review of negation (-гүй, биш) and the EN pattern of simple negatives, introducing not uncommon / not unlike as an idea of litotes

lessons.title_en: The Gobi Bear and Its Fragile Home
lessons.focus: Reading a short report on the Gobi bear (мазаалай) in the Great Gobi Strictly Protected Area; vocabulary: хамгаалалттай газар, ус гарах эх үүсвэр, цөлжилт, устах аюул, тоо толгой; grammar: EN not a few, not infrequently, not unlikely; MN -хгүй байх аргагүй as 'cannot fail to / inevitably'

A news discussion on illegal hunting, the fur and bone trade and penalties; vocabulary: хууль бус агнуур, хилийн хяналт, торгууль, зөрчил, хураах, мэдээлэгч; grammar: MN -хгүй байж болохгүй 'must not fail to / must' for obligation; EN: cannot/could not fail to, formal double negatives such as it is not without risk

Park staff and local herders negotiate grazing, tourism and visitor rules around Gorkhi-Terelj and Khustai; vocabulary: улсын тусгай хамгаалалттай газар, бэлчээр, нөөц газар, зөвшөөрөл, аялагч, хяналт тавих; grammar: contrasting -хгүй байж болохгүй with -хгүй байх аргагүй in rules and predictions; EN: not unreasonable, not insignificant in formal reports

lessons.title_mn: Шинжлэх ухаан ба олон нийтийн хамгаалал
lessons.focus: A researcher presents camera-trap and GPS-collar findings and herder-led conservation programs; vocabulary: камер залуур, хяналт судалгаа, экосистем, биологийн төрөл зүйл, хамтын ажиллагаа, ашиг шим; grammar: double negation for cautious claims, e.g. үгүйсгэх аргагүй 'cannot be denied', -хгүй байх магадлал багагүй; EN: hedged litotes such as not insignificant, hardly unknown, no small achievement

Drafting and presenting a persuasive appeal to save a threatened species; vocabulary: уриалга, үүрэг хариуцлага, өв, ирээдүй хойч үе, санхүүжилт, идэвхтэн; grammar: choosing double negatives for emphasis and tact across both languages, mixing -хгүй байж болохгүй, -хгүй байх аргагүй with EN not uncommon, not without merit, can hardly be ignored

units.scope: bone-setters, herbal remedies, rashaan springs, sanatoriums; healing vocabulary; recommendation forms -вал зохино, -х нь зүйтэй; EN: it is advisable/essential that, be said to have

lessons.focus: Visiting a traditional bone-setter (яс засалч) after a fall or sprain; vocabulary of bones, joints, massage and manual treatment (яс, үе мөч, мөчрөл, зүүлт, засалт); describing a treatment in the present tense and with be said to have (He is said to have healed many people)

Talking with a grandmother about herbal remedies and teas; vocabulary of medicinal plants, roots, decoctions, dosage (эмийн ургамал, жонхуу, гол, шарсан, ундаа, хэмжээ); introducing the recommendation form -х нь зүйтэй (Энэ цайг өглөө уух нь зүйтэй) and EN: it is advisable to/that

Planning a trip to a mineral spring and discussing what it supposedly cures; vocabulary of springs, mineral water, cures, seasons for treatment (рашаан, эдгээх, ус, ундны, эмчилгээний улирал); reporting reputation with be said/believed to have + past participle and -дог гэнэ

Booking and living through a stay at a sanatorium, with a doctor's schedule and rules; vocabulary of sanatoriums, courses of treatment, diet, rest regimen (сувилал, эмчилгээний чиглэл, горим, хоолны дэглэм, физик эмчилгээ); giving advice with -вал зохино (Амарвал зохино) and EN: it is essential/vital that + subjunctive (It is essential that he rest)

Debating with a doctor when to combine folk healing and hospital care; vocabulary of diagnosis, side effects, evidence, complementary treatment (оношилгоо, дайвар нөлөө, нотолгоо, нөхөн эмчилгээ, эмч нарын зөвлөгөө); contrasting and balancing -вал зохино / -х нь зүйтэй with caution, and EN: it is advisable that, it is not recommended that, be said to have

Writing and presenting a short advice leaflet or radio talk on traditional healing for a general audience; review vocabulary of healing, prevention and care (урьдчилан сэргийлэх, тэнцвэр, нөхөн сэргээх, анхаарах); combining all recommendation forms in a coherent, polite text with EN: advisable/essential structures and be said to have

units.scope: pets in apartments, vet visits, stray dogs, adopting; animal care vocabulary; plurals -ууд/-үүд, -нар, -чууд; EN: few/a few, little/a little

lessons.focus: talking with neighbors about keeping cats and dogs in an apartment building; pet types and basic care words (тэжээл, хоол, бие засах, салхилуулах); plural -ууд/-үүд with vowel harmony (нохойнууд, муурнууд, тэжээвэр амьтад) / EN: few vs a few with countable nouns

booking and attending a vet visit with a sick pet; symptoms and treatments (вакцин, тарилга, шинжилгээ, хоолонд дургүй болох); -нар for groups of people (эмч нар, эзэд, малын эмч нар) vs -ууд/-үүд / EN: little vs a little with uncountable nouns (a little appetite, little energy)

discussing stray dogs in Ulaanbaatar districts and khoroo responses; safety and animal-control vocabulary (золбин, хазах, сүрэг, саармагжуулах); plurals of nouns with stem changes and irregular forms (нохой → нохойнууд, хүүхэд → хүүхдүүд, эзэн → эзэд) / EN: few/a few/little/a little in opinions (few people care, a few volunteers help)

visiting an animal shelter and filling out an adoption form; adoption and shelter vocabulary (асрамжийн газар, үрчлэх, сайн дурын ажилтан, хариуцлага); -чууд for groups of people by nationality, role or origin (сайн дурынхан, монголчууд, гадаадынхан) / EN: quite a few, only a few, very little, only a little

giving and following care instructions for grooming, feeding and winter cold; grooming and supply words (сам, хүзүүвч, оосор, ус, үс самнах); choosing between -ууд/-үүд, -нар, -чууд and leaving nouns unmarked after numbers and quantifiers (гурван муур, олон нохой) / EN: few/little vs a lot of, many, much in instructions

lessons.title_en: Pets and Herding Dogs: Then and Now
lessons.title_mn: Хотын тэжээвэр амьтан ба хоточ нохой
lessons.focus: comparing city pet culture with countryside herding dogs and bankhar traditions in a short discussion; cultural and attitude vocabulary (хоточ, банхар, хамгаалах, хандлага); review of all plural suffixes in connected speech / EN: review of few/a few, little/a little in contrasting statements

units.scope: mix-ups, wrong messages, clearing things up; apology phrases; indefinite pronouns хэн ч, юу ч, хэзээ ч, хаа нэгтээ; EN: some-/any-/no-/every- compounds

lessons.focus: texts and calls sent to the wrong person or group chat; message and phone mix-up vocabulary (андуурах, буруу илгээх, устгах); MN хэн нэгэн, юм нэг, нэг юм for 'someone/something'; EN some-/any- compounds in statements and questions (someone, anything)

apologizing for small and serious mistakes; apology phrases by register (уучлаарай, өршөөгөөрэй, хүлцэл өчье, санамсаргүй, буруутай); MN negative indefinites хэн ч, юу ч + verb + -гүй ('nobody/nothing'); EN no- compounds vs not any- (nobody, nothing, not anyone)

clearing up a misunderstood comment between friends or colleagues; clarification vocabulary (буруу ойлгох, тайлбарлах, санаа, утга); MN хэзээ ч, хаана ч, яаж ч with negation ('never, nowhere, in no way'); EN never/nowhere and emphatic at all, ever

missed meetings, wrong addresses and mixed-up places in Ulaanbaatar; meeting-point and location vocabulary (уулзах газар, хаяг, хүлээх, хоцрох); MN хаа нэгтээ, хаашаа ч юм, хэзээ нэгэн цагт for 'somewhere/sometime'; EN somewhere/anywhere/everywhere and -where/-time compounds

office or family mix-ups about plans and changed schedules; information-flow vocabulary (мэдэгдэх, дамжуулах, санамж, анхааруулах); MN хэн бүхэн, бүгд, юу бүхэн vs хэн ч + positive verb ('anyone at all'); EN every- compounds with singular verbs and anyone/anything = 'it doesn't matter who/what'

accepting and responding to apologies, making amends and repairing relationships; forgiveness vocabulary (уучлах, гомдох, эвлэрэх, нөхөх, сэтгэл засах); review of all indefinite pronouns in longer dialogues (хэн ч, юу ч, хэзээ ч, хаа нэгтээ, хэн нэгэн); EN review of some-/any-/no-/every- compounds plus responses like It's nothing, No problem at all

units.scope: ID cards, khoroo offices, E-Mongolia, deadlines; bureaucracy terms; auxiliaries -ж амжих, -ж дуусах, -хаас аргагүй; EN: manage to, be able to, succeed in

lessons.focus: renewing an expired ID card at the registration office; documents and forms (иргэний үнэмлэх, өргөдөл, бүрдүүлэх бичиг баримт, хугацаа дуусах); -ж амжих for getting something done in time (сунгуулж амжсан) / EN: manage to + verb

getting a residence certificate and stamps at the khoroo office; local administration terms (хорооны засаг дарга, тодорхойлолт, тамга, дугаар авах, дараалал); -ж дуусах for completed tasks (бөглөж дууссан) / EN: be able to in past and future (was able to, will be able to)

requesting documents online through E-Mongolia; e-government vocabulary (цахим үйлчилгээ, нэвтрэх, баталгаажуулах код, лавлагаа татах, хүсэлт илгээх); -ж амжих vs -ж чадах contrast (татаж чадсангүй, илгээж амжлаа) / EN: managed to vs could, couldn't for specific occasions

tax filing and fee payments before a deadline; deadline and penalty terms (эцсийн хугацаа, торгууль, хоцрох, төлбөр барагдуулах, сунгалт); negative -ж амжаагүй, -ж дуусгаж чадаагүй / EN: succeed in + -ing, fail to + verb

long queues, missing signatures, and being sent from desk to desk; bureaucracy frustrations (хүнд суртал, гарын үсэг, шилжүүлэх, хариу өгөх, хүлээн авах цаг); -хаас аргагүй for unavoidable actions (дахин ирэхээс аргагүй боллоо) / EN: have no choice but to, can't help + -ing

telling a friend how a full day of errands (bank, notary, passport office) finally worked out; review of paperwork vocabulary (нотариат, гадаад паспорт, хуулбар, эх хувь, бүртгүүлэх); combining -ж амжих, -ж дуусах, -хаас аргагүй in narrative / EN: manage to, be able to, succeed in contrasted in one story

units.scope: good and bad news, gifts, reacting to events; feelings and reactions; exclamatives ямар ... юм бэ, ёстой, третье-person imperative -г (ирэг); EN: what a.../how... exclamations

lessons.focus: sharing good news with friends (new job, exam results, engagement); news and surprise vocabulary (гэнэтийн, баярын мэдээ, итгэмээргүй); exclamative ямар ... юм бэ (Ямар сайхан юм бэ!) / EN: What a...! with countable nouns (What a surprise!)

reacting to bad news (lost phone, canceled trip, failed exam); disappointment and sympathy vocabulary (харамсалтай, сэтгэл гонсойх, хөөрхий); exclamative ямар ... юм бэ with negative adjectives, ёстой as an intensifier (ёстой муу юм) / EN: How...! and What + uncountable/plural (What bad luck!)

giving and receiving gifts at birthdays and Tsagaan Sar; gift and thanking vocabulary (баярлалаа, санаа тавих, гоё юм аа); ёстой in emphatic praise and gratitude (Ёстой гоё бэлэг байна!) / EN: such/so in exclamations (It's such a lovely gift!)

a surprise party plan, deciding what others should do; party and planning vocabulary (нууцлах, гэнэдүүлэх, зочид); third-person imperative -г/-тугай in everyday speech (Тэр ирэг, Бат авчирг) / EN: let him/her/them + verb

reacting to shocking events in the news and around the city; strong feeling vocabulary (цочирдох, гайхах, уурлах, тайвшрах); combining ямар ... юм бэ, ёстой and emotion verbs in reactions / EN: How + adjective + subject + verb! (How strange it is!)

telling the story of a big surprise and everyone's reactions; review of reaction and feeling vocabulary; review of exclamatives, ёстой and third-person imperative -г in narrative / EN: mixed what/how/such/so exclamations in storytelling

units.scope: ads, slogans, marketing campaigns, public notices; marketing vocabulary; formal imperative -гтун/-гтүн (анхаарагтун); EN: persuasive language, emphatic do, Why not...?

lessons.focus: brainstorming slogans for a Mongolian brand (cashmere, airag, a café); marketing basics: брэнд, уриа, зорилтот хэрэглэгч, сурталчилгаа; MN: short slogan style with optative -аарай and nominal phrases; EN: persuasive imperatives and short punchy slogans

reading notices in UB buses, parks, stations and khoroo boards; notice vocabulary: анхааруулга, мэдэгдэл, иргэд, хориглоно; MN: formal imperative -гтун/-гтүн (анхаарагтун, сонсогтун); EN: formal notice language (Please note, Passengers are reminded that)

TV and radio ads for products and services; product benefits: давуу тал, чанартай, хямдрал, үнэгүй; MN: persuasive rhetorical questions -ж яагаад болохгүй гэж, -вал ямар вэ; EN: Why not...? and Why don't you...?

testimonials and customer reviews in ads; credibility vocabulary: баталгаа, үр дүн, сэтгэгдэл, итгэл; MN: emphatic particles шүү, л, үнэхээр, яг in persuasion; EN: emphatic do/does/did (It does work, I did try it)

agency meeting planning a social media campaign before Naadam or Tsagaan Sar; campaign terms: кампанит ажил, зах зээл, хамрах хүрээ, нөлөөлөгч, төсөв; MN: formal imperative -гтун/-гтүн vs everyday -аарай/-ээрэй and register choice; EN: persuasive pitch language (imagine, picture this, don't miss out)

debating misleading ads, scams and ad regulation; critical vocabulary: хуурамч мэдээлэл, төөрөгдүүлэх, хэрэглэгчийн эрх, ил тод байдал; MN: combining -гтун/-гтүн appeals with rhetorical questions in a public statement; EN: emphatic do and Why not...? in argument, recognizing manipulative techniques

units.scope: pensions, retirement, nursing homes, caring for parents; social care terms; -сан ч бай, -хгүй ч бай; EN: whether or not, regardless of, irrespective of

lessons.focus: a colleague nearing retirement age talks about leaving work; retirement vocabulary (тэтгэврийн нас, ажилласан жил, тэтгэвэрт гарах, retirement age, years of service); MN -сан ч бай, -хгүй ч бай for two-sided conditions / EN whether or not + clause

visiting the social insurance office to calculate a pension; pension terms (нийгмийн даатгалын шимтгэл, тэтгэврийн хэмжээ, хуримтлал, contributions, pension fund); MN -сан ч бай -хгүй ч бай with nouns and adjectives (их ч бай бага ч бай) / EN regardless of + noun phrase

siblings discuss who will look after an ailing mother in Ulaanbaatar or the countryside; family caregiving vocabulary (асрах, сахих, хөдөлгөөний хязгаарлалт, caregiver, look after, move in with); MN contrasting obligations with -сан ч бай, -хгүй ч бай + -х ёстой / EN whether... or... with alternatives

touring a care home and asking staff questions; facility and service terms (асрамжийн газар, сувилагч, өдрийн асаргаа, nursing home, assisted living, day care); MN хаана ч бай, хэн ч бай, юу ч бай with question words / EN irrespective of + noun phrase, no matter where/who

lessons.title_en: Health and Dignity in Old Age
lessons.title_mn: Өндөр насны эрүүл мэнд, нэр төр
lessons.focus: a doctor and a family talk about dementia, mobility and respect for elders; elder health and rights terms (ой санамж муудах, хараа муудах, хүндлэл, хайхрамжгүй байдал, dementia, neglect, dignity); MN -сан ч бай, -хгүй ч бай in formal statements of rights / EN regardless of whether + clause

a radio debate on state versus family responsibility for elder care; social policy vocabulary (хүн амын хөгшрөлт, халамжийн бодлого, ачаалал, ageing population, welfare, burden); review and contrast of -сан ч бай / -хгүй ч бай in argumentation / EN whether or not, regardless of, irrespective of in formal debate

units.scope: meaning of life, free will, knowledge and mind; philosophy terms; literary verbal noun -хуй/-хүй (мэдэхүй, сэтгэхүй); EN: concessive inversion (Strange as it may seem)

lessons.focus: late-night talk with friends about the meaning of life; утга учир, зорилго, оршихуй, амьдралын утга; recognizing -хуй/-хүй verbal nouns (оршихуй, амьдрахуй) vs ordinary -х nouns; EN: intro to concessive inversion with adjectives (Simple as it sounds, ...)

university seminar debate on free will vs fate; чөлөөт хүсэл зориг, хувь заяа, сонголт, хариуцлага, учир шалтгаан; using -хуй/-хүй nouns with case endings (сонгохуйн эрх, үйлдэхүйд); EN: concessive inversion with adjectives and adverbs (Free as we may feel, Hard as I try)

philosophy lecture on knowledge and certainty; мэдэхүй, танин мэдэхүй, баримт, итгэл үнэмшил, эргэлзээ, нотолгоо; -хуй/-хүй in fixed academic terms (танин мэдэхүйн онол, мэдрэхүй); EN: concessive inversion with verbs (Try as they might, Much as I respect...)

podcast on consciousness, AI and thinking machines; сэтгэхүй, ухамсар, оюун ухаан, сэтгэл, мэдрэмж; contrasting сэтгэхүй / сэтгэлгээ / бодол in meaning and register; EN: concessive inversion with nouns (Child though she was, Genius though he is)

lessons.title_en: Wisdom from the Steppe and Beyond
lessons.title_mn: Тал нутгийн болон дэлхийн мэргэн ухаан
lessons.focus: book club comparing Buddhist ideas, nomadic worldview and Western philosophers; хоосон чанар, үйлийн үр, мөнх бус, мэргэн ухаан, ертөнцийг үзэх үзэл; -хуй/-хүй in literary and religious texts (үзэхүй, сонсохуй, ухаарахуй); EN: concessive inversion in written style (Strange as it may seem, ...) vs although/however

writing and presenting a short personal essay on a big question; review of philosophy terms; choosing between -хуй/-хүй forms and everyday -х/-лт nouns by register; EN: concessive inversion mixed with other concessive structures (however, no matter how, although)

units.scope: deer stones, Xiongnu tombs, Gobi dinosaur fossils, excavations; dating and evidence; inferential -сан бололтой, -сан шинжтэй, -х төлөвтэй; EN: appear to have, there is evidence that

lessons.focus: visiting deer stones in Khövsgöl and reading museum signs; monuments, carvings, Bronze Age terms; inferential -сан бололтой vs EN appear/seem to have + past participle
a field team excavating a Xiongnu elite tomb; burial, grave goods, nobility vocabulary; -сан шинжтэй for evidence-based inference vs EN there is evidence that / there are signs that
paleontologists at Bayanzag and the Flaming Cliffs; dinosaur fossils, eggs, skeletons, sediment layers; -х төлөвтэй for likely outcomes vs EN be likely to / be expected to

lab specialists discussing radiocarbon dating and stratigraphy; dating methods, centuries, millennia, BCE/CE; combining бололтой, шинжтэй and магадгүй to grade certainty vs EN appear to have been + passive, is thought to date from

news reports on illegal digging and smuggled fossils returned to Mongolia; heritage protection, black market, repatriation; inference about the past with -сан бололтой/-сан шинжтэй in reports vs EN reporting evidence (evidence suggests, there is no evidence that, apparently)

giving a conference talk on a season's excavation results; interpretation, hypothesis, conclusion vocabulary; integrating all inferential forms in cautious academic argument vs EN hedged evidential language (the findings appear to indicate, this points to)

units.scope: quitting, retraining, starting over at 30; career and skills vocabulary; without-converbs -лгүй, -хгүйгээр; EN: despite/in spite of + -ing, in spite of the fact that

lessons.focus: Telling a friend you're unhappy at work and want to quit; job dissatisfaction vocabulary (ажлаасаа гарах, сэтгэл ханамж, ядрах, цалин, урам); MN -лгүй with simple verbs (амрахгүй/амралтгүй vs амралгүй ажиллах, бодолгүй шийдэх); EN despite + noun (despite the good salary)

Talking to your manager and writing a resignation request; resignation vocabulary (өргөдөл өгөх, ажил хүлээлгэн өгөх, мэдэгдэх, гэрээ дуусах); MN -хгүйгээр for manner (мэдэгдэхгүйгээр гарах, зөвшөөрөл авахгүйгээр); EN in spite of + noun and in spite of + -ing

Enrolling in a retraining course or bootcamp; skills and training vocabulary (мэргэжил дээшлүүлэх, давтан сургалт, ур чадвар, гэрчилгээ, дадлага); MN -лгүй vs -хгүйгээр contrast (унталгүй хичээллэх, туршлагагүйгээр эхлэх); EN despite + -ing (despite having no experience)

Family and friends questioning your career change; risk and emotion vocabulary (эрсдэл, тогтвортой орлого, зөрүүд, итгэл алдах, зориг); MN -лгүй/-хгүйгээр in concessive-like contexts (хэнийг ч сонсолгүй, айхгүйгээр шийдэх); EN in spite of the fact that + clause vs although

Rewriting a CV and job applications for a new field; transferable skills vocabulary (шилжүүлэх боломжтой ур чадвар, хувийн төсөл, портфолио, ажлын туршлага, зөвлөгч); MN -лгүйгээр and -лгүй байж in planning and advice (туршлагагүй байж өргөдөл гаргах); EN despite/in spite of vs although/even though rewriting

Sharing your career-change story a year later; new beginnings vocabulary (шинэ эхлэл, дасах, анхан шатны албан тушаал, харамсах, амжилт); MN review of -лгүй and -хгүйгээр in narration (харамсалгүй, эргэж харахгүйгээр); EN review of despite, in spite of, and in spite of the fact that in a personal story

units.scope: shagai, chess, board games, esports tournaments; gaming vocabulary; repetition -х бүр, -х болгон, -х бүрийд; EN: whenever, every time, each time + clause

lessons.focus: playing shagai at Tsagaan Sar in a ger; shagai pieces and terms (морь, тэмээ, хонь, ямаа, шагай харвах, нүүдэл); MN -х бүр (буудах бүр, хаях бүр), EN every time + clause
a school chess club and online chess; chess vocabulary (хүү, тэрэг, бэрс, мэх, шаг, мад, тэнцээ); MN -х болгон (нүүх болгон), contrast with -х бүр, EN each time + clause
friends at a board game café in Ulaanbaatar; game vocabulary (шоо, хөзөр, ээлж, дүрэм, оноо, ялагч); MN -х бүрийд (ээлж ирэх бүрийд), EN whenever + clause
talking with a team captain about practice; esports vocabulary (баг, тоглогч, бэлтгэл, стратеги, сервер, рейтинг); MN -х бүр/-х болгон with habitual -даг, EN every time vs whenever in routines

watching and commenting on an esports tournament stream; tournament vocabulary (тэмцээн, шигшээ, хасагдах, тайлбарлагч, үзэгч, шагналын сан); MN -х бүр/-х бүрийд with past tense for repeated past events, EN each time / every time + past simple

a parent and teen debating gaming habits and screen time; vocabulary of addiction and balance (донтох, цаг алдах, хязгаар, амрах, тэнцвэр); review of -х бүр, -х болгон, -х бүрийд with complex clauses, EN whenever / every time / each time in arguments

units.scope: insomnia, night shifts, dreams and folk dream readings; sleep vocabulary; change of state -тай болох, -гүй болох, -дог болох; EN: get/become/grow/go + adjective, turn into

lessons.focus: describing insomnia to a friend; sleep vocabulary (нойргүйдэл, унтаж чадахгүй, сэрэх, хурхирах); MN -гүй болох for losing a state (нойргүй болсон); EN get/become + adjective (get tired, become sleepy)

nurses, guards and miners on night shifts; shift-work and body-clock vocabulary (ээлж, биеийн цаг, ядрах); MN -дог болох for new habits (өдөр унтдаг болсон); EN get used to vs grow + adjective (grow tired, grow used to)

sleep advice from a doctor and an app; sleep hygiene vocabulary (дэлгэц, кофейн, гүн нойр, хөнжил); MN -тай болох for gaining a state (сайн нойртой болох, дадалтай болох); EN become/get + comparative (get better, become calmer)

telling a dream over breakfast; dream vocabulary (зүүд, хар дарах, зүүдлэх, сэрэх); MN combined change of state -тай/-гүй болох in narration; EN turn into and go + adjective (turned into a horse, went quiet, went dark)

grandmother's folk dream readings (тайлах, сайн/муу ёр, шүд унах, ус харах); omen vocabulary; MN -вал ... -тай болно / -гүй болно in sayings (зүүдэндээ мах идвэл баян болно); EN go + adjective for negative change (go bad, go wrong, go missing)
a short personal account of how one's sleep changed over a year; review of sleep and dream vocabulary; MN contrasting -тай болох, -гүй болох, -дог болох; EN choosing get/become/grow/go/turn into

units.scope: bus cards, traffic jams, the planned metro and cable car, ride-hailing; transit terms; alternatives юм уу, эсвэл, -х уу -х уу; EN: be to, be due to, be set to for scheduled events

lessons.focus: topping up a U Money bus card at a kiosk and tapping on the bus; fares, transfers, card balance, validator; MN alternatives with эсвэл (бэлнээр эсвэл картаар); EN: be due to for scheduled times (The bus is due to arrive at 8:10)

being late because of a traffic jam on Peace Avenue, calling work; rush hour, congestion, odd-even license plate restrictions, detours; MN юм уу for loose alternatives (арван минут юм уу хагас цаг); EN: be due to vs because of, arrival estimates

choosing between a street taxi and a ride-hailing app; booking, pickup point, surge pricing, driver rating, cancel a ride; MN choice questions -х уу -х уу (явганаар явах уу, такси барих уу); EN: Should I... or...?, Would you rather... or...?

reading news about the planned Ulaanbaatar metro; stations, lines, construction, budget, completion date; MN combining эсвэл and юм уу in plans and options; EN: be set to and be to for officially planned events (Construction is set to begin next year)

lessons.title_en: A Cable Car Over the Hills
lessons.focus: debating the planned cable car linking ger districts to the center; route, capacity, safety, residents' views; MN embedded alternatives -х уу үгүй юу, -х уу эсвэл -х уу (баригдах уу үгүй юу гэдэг нь тодорхойгүй); EN: be to for future plans in formal news, whether... or...

comparing commute options and planning a better route; travel time, schedules, walking, cycling, transit apps; review of юм уу, эсвэл, -х уу -х уу; EN: review of be to, be due to, be set to in a short commute plan

units.scope: astronomy, satellites, Mongolian star lore like Долоон бурхан; space terms; -шгүй adjectives (тоолшгүй, мартагдашгүй); EN: preposition + which/whom, whereby

lessons.focus: stargazing far from Ulaanbaatar's lights; night sky words (од, оддын ордон, Тэнгэрийн заадас, сүүлт од); intro to -шгүй adjectives (тоолшгүй, мартагдашгүй); EN: preposition + which (the sky under which we slept)

lessons.title_en: The Seven Gods and Other Star Tales
lessons.focus: grandparents telling Mongolian star lore; Долоон бурхан, Алтан гадас, Мичид, Хүмүүн од; -шгүй with -гдашгүй for legends (үгүйсгэшгүй, давтагдашгүй); EN: preposition + whom (the hero after whom the stars were named)

lessons.title_mn: Хиймэл дагуул ба тойрог зам дахь Монгол
lessons.focus: news about Mongolian satellites like Mazaalai and space cooperation; satellites and launches (хиймэл дагуул, тойрог зам, хөөргөх, дохио); -шгүй for evaluation (зайлшгүй, хэмжишгүй) in formal reports; EN: whereby (a system whereby signals are relayed)

a museum talk on the 1981 flight of Jügderdemidiin Gürragchaa; spaceflight terms (сансрын нисгэгч, жингүйдэл, хөлөг, газардах); -шгүй in tribute language (мартагдашгүй, үнэлэхийн аргагүй vs үнэлэшгүй); EN: formal relative clauses with during which, in which, by whom

lessons.title_mn: Хиртэлт, гараг ба одон орны төв
lessons.focus: visiting an observatory near Ulaanbaatar for an eclipse; astronomy terms (нар хиртэх, гараг, дуран, гэрлийн жил); contrasting -шгүй with -хын аргагүй and -ж боломгүй; EN: quantifier + of which/whom (many of which, none of whom)

lessons.title_en: Are We Alone in the Universe?
lessons.focus: debating space exploration, dark skies and life beyond Earth; cosmology terms (орчлон ертөнц, хар нүх, амьдралын ул мөр, гэрлийн бохирдол); free use of -шгүй adjectives in argument (ойлгомжгүй vs ойлгошгүй, хязгааргүй vs хязгаарлашгүй); EN: review of whereby and preposition + which/whom in formal argument

units.scope: Zamyn-Üüd, customs, imports, exchange rates, small traders; trade terms; speculative болов уу, -сан болов уу, бил үү; EN: collective nouns and subject-verb agreement

lessons.focus: traveling to the border town and meeting small traders; border, freight and trading-post vocabulary (хил, ачаа, наймаачин, худалдааны төв); MN: speculative болов уу in present/future guesses (өнөөдөр хил хаалттай болов уу); EN: collective nouns (staff, crowd, team) with singular verbs

declaring goods and dealing with inspectors; customs terms (гаалийн мэдүүлэг, татвар, хязгаар, хураах); MN: past speculation -сан болов уу (бичиг баримт дутуу байсан болов уу); EN: the police, the staff, customs + plural vs singular agreement

ordering goods from Ereen and tracking shipments; import/export and logistics vocabulary (импорт, нийлүүлэгч, тээвэр, агуулах); MN: wondering with бил үү in self-directed questions (ачаа маань хэзээ ирэх бил үү); EN: British vs American agreement with collective nouns (the company is/are)

following yuan-tögrög rates and their effect on prices; currency and pricing terms (ханш, юань, валют солих, үнийн өсөлт); MN: combining болов уу and -сан болов уу to speculate about causes and outcomes; EN: amounts as singular subjects (Ten thousand tögrög is...)

interviewing a trader about risks, debts and competition; small-business and market vocabulary (бараа эргэлт, зээл, ашиг, өрсөлдөөн); MN: reflective бил үү and rhetorical speculation (ингэж хэр удаан явах бил үү); EN: either/neither/each, a number of vs the number of with agreement

discussing a policy report on trade, rail links and free zones; trade-policy terms (чөлөөт бүс, худалдааны тэнцэл, хамтын ажиллагаа); MN: hedged forecasting with болов уу, -сан болов уу, бил үү in formal discussion; EN: agreement with committee, government, majority, and the public in formal writing

units.scope: felt-making, silversmiths, saddles, master and apprentice; craft and process terms; as-soon-as converbs -нгуут/-нгүүт; EN: perfect participles (having + past participle) in process descriptions

lessons.focus: a herder family making felt in autumn (wool beating, soaking, rolling with a horse); felt-making terms (ноос, эсгий, гөлөм, ширэх, булах); -нгуут/-нгүүт for an immediate next step (ноос норонгуут) / EN: having + past participle for completed steps (Having soaked the wool, they roll it)

visiting a silversmith in Ulaanbaatar who makes bowls and snuff bottles; metalwork terms (дархан, мөнгө, хайлуулах, цутгах, сийлбэр, хээ); -нгуут/-нгүүт vs -аад/-ээд to contrast immediacy with simple sequence / EN: having + past participle vs after + -ing

a saddle maker explaining how a traditional saddle is built and decorated; saddle and leather terms (эмээл, ширэлгээ, арьс, мод, бүүрэг, чимэглэл); negative and passive -гдонгуут/-гдөнгүүт (хатангуут, будагдангуут) / EN: passive perfect participle (having been dried, having been carved)

an apprentice describing years of learning from a master craftsman; apprenticeship terms (шавь, ур чадвар, дадлага, өвлөх, уламжлал); -нгуут/-нгүүт with time and life events (сургууль төгсөнгүүт шавь орсон) / EN: perfect participle clauses giving reason or background (Having trained for ten years, she...)

discussing craft markets, tourists, cheap imports and the value of handmade goods; quality and market terms (гар урлал, чанар, хуурамч, жинхэнэ, үнэлэмж); -нгуут/-нгүүт in reported market trends (импорт орж ирэнгүүт) / EN: not + having + past participle and being vs having been

units.scope: rich and poor, taxes, social mobility, the cost of living; socioeconomic terms; extent markers хүртэл, -тлаа, -тлаа ... болох; EN: so much so that, to the extent that, to such a degree that

lessons.focus: comparing life in Zaisan apartments and ger districts; income, poverty line, wealth gap; MN хүртэл as 'even' and 'up to' (хүүхдүүд хүртэл ажилладаг); EN so much so that
discussing rising rent, meat and fuel prices with friends; inflation, wages, household budget; MN -тлаа 'until/to the point of' (ядартлаа ажиллах); EN to the extent that
a radio debate on income tax and VAT receipts (e-barimt); progressive tax, tax evasion, public spending; MN хүртэл with ablative ranges (-аас ... хүртэл орлого); EN to such a degree that

lessons.title_mn: Өр зээл ба өдөр тутмын бэрхшээл
lessons.focus: interviewing families about pension loans and salary loans; debt, collateral, social welfare, benefits; MN combining хүртэл and -тлаа in extent clauses (зээл авахаас хүртэл айтлаа); EN to the point where, intensifying structures

lessons.title_mn: Тэгш бус байдлыг засаж болох уу?
lessons.focus: writing an opinion column on the mining wealth fund and redistribution; redistribution, minimum wage, sovereign fund; MN review of extent markers in formal argument; EN review of so much so that, to the extent that, to such a degree that

units.scope: running a tourist ger camp, guiding foreigners, online reviews; hospitality terms; worth-forms -ууштай/-үүштэй, -хуйц (үзүүштэй, үзэхүйц); EN: worth + -ing, it's no use + -ing, need + -ing

lessons.title_mn: Манай жуулчны баазад тавтай морилно уу
lessons.focus: greeting tourists and checking them in at a ger camp; hospitality terms (жуулчны бааз, захиалга, үйлчилгээ, хоноглох, хоол багтсан); MN: intro to -ууштай/-үүштэй (үзүүштэй, амсууштай) for recommending; EN: worth + -ing (It's worth trying airag)

a guide recommending sights like Kharkhorin, Khövsgöl and the Gobi; sightseeing vocabulary (үзвэр, дурсгалт газар, аялал, хөтөч, үзэсгэлэнт); MN: -ууштай/-үүштэй as a modifier vs a predicate (үзүүштэй газар, энэ газар үзүүштэй); EN: be worth + -ing vs be worth + noun (worth the trip, worth a visit)

explaining customs and etiquette to foreigners on a tour; guiding vocabulary (тайлбарлах, ёс заншил, орчуулах, аяллын хөтөлбөр, бүлэг); MN: -хуйц/-хүйц for 'enough to, worthy of' (үзэхүйц, итгэхүйц, тэвчихүйц); EN: worth + -ing contrasted with worthwhile (It's worthwhile to...)

lessons.title_en: When Things Go Wrong at Camp
lessons.focus: handling guest complaints about broken stoves, no hot water and late meals; service problem vocabulary (гомдол, засвар, халуун ус, хүлээлгэх, уучлалт); MN: negative worth-forms -хуйц биш, -ууштай зүйл биш; EN: it's no use + -ing, there's no point + -ing

writing and replying to reviews on booking sites; review vocabulary (сэтгэгдэл, үнэлгээ, од, санал болгох, сэтгэл ханамжтай); MN: -ууштай vs -хуйц in evaluations (санал болгууштай, сэтгэл хангалуун байхуйц); EN: need + -ing as passive meaning (The bathrooms need cleaning)

camp staff planning improvements for next season based on feedback; business and hospitality terms (улирал, ажилтан сургах, тав тух, үйлчилгээний чанар, үнэ цэнэ); MN: review of -ууштай/-үүштэй and -хуйц together; EN: review of worth + -ing, it's no use + -ing and need + -ing

units.scope: near misses, almost missing a flight, slipping on ice, lucky escapes; mishap vocabulary; almost-forms -х шахах, -х дөхөх, арай л; EN: nearly/almost/barely/hardly

lessons.focus: telling a friend about a small near miss; basic mishap words (унах, мөргөх, хальтрах, осол); арай л + past -сан/-лаа for 'almost happened'; EN: almost/nearly + past simple
winter sidewalks and stairs in Ulaanbaatar; falls and minor injuries (мөс, гулгах, шагай мушгирах, хөлөө татах); -х шахах (унах шахсан); EN: nearly + -ed vs almost, I nearly fell

rushing to Chinggis Khaan airport, check-in closing, traffic; travel-timing words (бүртгэл хаагдах, суудал, хүлээлгийн танхим, яаран гүйх); -х дөхөх for being on the edge of a result (хоцрох дөхсөн); EN: barely + past (we barely made it), just in time vs on time

road and countryside close calls, a car swerving, a horse bolting; luck and danger vocabulary (азаар, аюул, аврагдах, ослоос мултрах); contrasting арай л, -х шахах and -х дөхөх; EN: hardly/barely + any/ever, hardly vs hard

everyday near misses with keys, passports, deadlines, gas left on; memory and carelessness words (мартах, гээх, анзаарах, хайхрамжгүй); arай л ... -гүй/-хгүй (арай л амжаагүй) and negative almost-forms; EN: almost/nearly + never/nothing/nobody, almost no vs hardly any

lessons.title_en: The Story of My Close Call
lessons.focus: narrating a full near-miss story and reacting to others' stories; reaction phrases (зүрх үсрэх, айдаст автах, амь гарах, хувь заяа); combining almost-forms with past narration and converbs; EN: review of nearly/almost/barely/hardly in storytelling, Hardly had... when

units.scope: haggling at the market, secondhand goods, quality and condition; market terms; degree words ядаж, бараг, нэлээд, дэндүү; EN: gradable vs non-gradable adjectives, quite/rather/fairly

lessons.focus: arriving at the market and finding stalls; market terms (лангуу, худалдагч, бөөний үнэ, хямдрал, бэлэн мөнгө); MN нэлээд with adjectives (нэлээд том, нэлээд хол) / EN fairly and quite with gradable adjectives

checking quality of boots, deels and coats; materials and quality (жинхэнэ, хуурамч, ноолуур, арьс, чанартай); MN дэндүү for excess (дэндүү үнэтэй, дэндүү нимгэн) / EN gradable vs non-gradable adjectives (very cold vs absolutely freezing)

basic haggling over prices; bargaining phrases (үнэ буулгах, хямдруулах, сүүлийн үнэ, тохирох); MN ядаж for minimum offers (ядаж арван мянгаар буулгаач) / EN rather vs quite with positive and negative meanings

buying used phones, bikes and furniture; condition words (хуучин, бараг шинэ, эвдэрсэн, зураастай, ажиллагаатай); MN бараг for 'almost' (бараг шинэ, бараг хэрэглээгүй) / EN almost/nearly vs practically with non-gradable adjectives

tough negotiations, walking away and coming back; reaction and persuasion phrases (за яахав, өөр газар үзье, хоёуланг нь авбал); MN contrasting ядаж, бараг, нэлээд, дэндүү in one exchange / EN absolutely, completely, totally vs very, extremely, a bit

telling friends about good deals and bad buys; review of market and condition vocabulary; MN combining degree words in narration (нэлээд хямд авсан ч бараг ажиллахгүй) / EN quite/rather/fairly review with modifier placement (quite a good deal, a rather old coat)

units.scope: relatives in the countryside, sending parcels with drivers, hometown associations; kinship and contact terms; contrastive -сан мөртөө, -х атлаа; EN: so do I / neither do I, so am I, echo agreement

lessons.focus: phoning grandparents and relatives in the soum; kinship terms (авга, нагац, үеэл, хадам, төрөл садан); EN: So do I / Neither do I agreement with present simple

lessons.title_en: Sending a Parcel with the Driver
lessons.focus: handing meat, aaruul and medicine to a long-distance driver at the bus station; parcel and contact terms (илгээмж, ачаа, дамжуулах, утасны дугаар үлдээх); contrastive -сан мөртөө (the driver promised but didn't call)
apologizing for not visiting relatives and staying out of touch; contact verbs (сураг тавих, холбоо барих, эргэж очих, мэнд дамжуулах); contrastive -х атлаа vs -сан мөртөө
joining a hometown association meeting in Ulaanbaatar; community terms (нутгийн зөвлөл, нутаг нэгт, хандив, уулзалт); EN: So am I / Neither am I, So have I with be and auxiliaries

lessons.title_mn: Гэр бүлийн групп чат, сураг сонсгол
lessons.focus: sharing news in family Messenger groups and with relatives abroad; news and greeting terms (сураг, мэнд, баяр хүргэх, зураг явуулах); EN: echo agreement and short responses (Me too, Me neither, Oh, did you? So did I)
reflecting on keeping family ties across city and countryside; review of kinship and contact vocabulary; review of -сан мөртөө / -х атлаа with EN So/Neither agreement in conversation

units.scope: wheat, greenhouses, meat exports, food imports; agricultural policy terms; result and blame forms -аас болж, -ын үр дүнд, -ын хор уршгаар; EN: absolute constructions (weather permitting, all things considered)

lessons.title_en: Bread on the Table: Mongolia's Wheat
lessons.title_mn: Ширээн дээрх талх: Монголын улаан буудай
lessons.focus: Talking about wheat harvests, flour mills and the Atar campaigns; grain and harvest vocabulary (ургац, тариалан, гурил, үр тариа); result marker -аас болж for causes of good and bad harvests; EN: weather permitting, harvest permitting

Discussing meat-processing plants, veterinary checks and export quotas to China and Russia; livestock trade terms (мал эмнэлэг, хорио цээр, экспортын квот, мах боловсруулах үйлдвэр); contrasting -аас болж and -ын үр дүнд for bans and new deals; EN: all things considered, other things being equal

Reading news about dependence on imported rice, sugar, oil and fruit and how exchange rates hit shoppers; import and price terms (импорт, хараат байдал, үнийн өсөлт, ханш, нөөц); -ын хор уршгаар for harmful consequences; EN: absolute constructions with with (with prices rising, with the border closed)

interviewing suspects; suspect and alibi vocabulary (сэжигтэн, сэдэл, алиби, худал мэдүүлэг); inference -сан байж таарна (Тэр түлхүүрийг авсан байж таарна)
explaining how a detective spotted a lie; deduction vocabulary (дүгнэлт, зөрчил, илчлэх, сэжиг төрөх); EN: wh-clefts (What gave him away was...)
solving logic puzzles and Mongolian оньсого with friends; reasoning vocabulary (таах, шийдэл, логик, санамж); contrasting -сан хэрэг vs -сан байж таарна vs -сан бололтой

the detective's closing speech and a book-club discussion of the ending; plot vocabulary (өрнөл, санаандгүй төгсгөл, сэжүүр, нууц тайлагдах); combining clefts with -сан хэрэг/-сан байж таарна in a full summary

explaining gestures and body language that differ between cultures (pointing, handshakes, sleeves and hats in a ger); gesture vocabulary (дохио зангаа, гар барих, нүдээр харах, толгой дохих); topic marker нь on subjects and topics (Хуруугаар заах нь ...); EN: fronting adverbials and adjectives (Rude it may be, but...)

discussing stereotypes about Mongolians and foreigners in a podcast chat; stereotype and prejudice terms (хэвшмэл ойлголт, өрөөсгөл үзэл, ерөнхийлөх, ялгаварлах); additive and emphatic ч on focused words (Би ч гэсэн, Нэг ч хүн ...); EN: vague language (sort of, kind of, more or less)

making casual conversation with foreign colleagues at an office party in Ulaanbaatar; small-talk and hospitality terms (сонин сайхан, зочломтгой, ая тухтай, эвгүй байдал); concessive and extreme ч (хэн ч, юу ч болсон, хэчнээн ... ч); EN: vague approximations and lists (or so, and whatnot, and stuff like that, -ish)

giving a short talk on lessons learned from intercultural work and culture shock; intercultural competence terms (соёл хоорондын, дасан зохицох, хүндлэх, ойлголцол); combining бол, нь and ч for topic and focus in longer discourse; EN: fronting and vague language contrasted in formal vs informal speech

units.scope: the Tuul River, water shortages, mining water use, springs drying up; water resource terms; limiting forms ердөө л, дөнгөж, -хаас хэтрэхгүй; EN: three-part phrasal verbs (run out of, cut down on, come up with)

Herders in the countryside describe springs and wells drying up; spring and well vocabulary (булаг шанд, худаг, гүний худаг, ширгэх, хуурайшил); combining ердөө л and дөнгөж with the past (ердөө л хэдхэн жилийн өмнө, дөнгөж саяхан); EN: come up against, do away with

A community brainstorm at a khoroo meeting on saving water; conservation terms (хэмнэх, дахин ашиглах, борооны ус хуримтлуулах, ус цэвэршүүлэх); -хаас хэтрэхгүй with targets and rules (өдөрт ... литрээс хэтрэхгүй); EN: come up with, get around to

A formal debate on mining permits, river protection, and Ulaanbaatar's water future; policy terms (усны сан бүхий газар, тусгай зөвшөөрөл, хамгаалалтын бүс, тогтвортой); review of all limiting forms in argument; EN: three-part phrasal verbs in formal vs informal register (put up with, look forward to, stand up for)

carbon monoxide poisoning, symptoms and alarms; CO, gas detector, ventilation, dizziness (утаат хий, хий мэдрэгч, агааржуулах, толгой эргэх); -хаас болгоомжлох (хийнд хордохоос болгоомжил); EN: watch out for + noun/-ing

frozen and burst pipes in an apartment, calling the housing office; pipe, radiator, leak, plumber (шугам хоолой, радиатор, гоожих, сантехникч); -уузай/-үүзэй with third-person worry (хоолой хагарчихуузай); EN: make sure + clause

a winter power cut, keeping warm and safe; flashlight, candle, generator, power outlet, heater (гар чийдэн, лаа, генератор, залгуур, халаагуур); -хаас болгоомжлох vs -уузай/-үүзэй in advice; EN: make sure (that) vs make sure to + verb

electrical heaters, overloaded sockets, fire extinguishers, the 101 emergency line; extinguisher, short circuit, smoke alarm, overload (гал унтраагуур, богино холбоо, утааны дохиолол, ачаалал хэтрэх); negative warnings -хгүй байхаас болгоомжлох; EN: be careful not to vs watch out for contrasted

preparing a relative's home for winter and giving caring warnings by phone; review of home safety terms; combined -уузай/-үүзэй and -хаас болгоомжлох in polite advice; EN: review of make sure, be careful not to, watch out for

lessons.focus: tidying the apartment before guests arrive; household chores (шал угаах, тоос арчих, хог гаргах); EN: make vs do with chores (do the dishes, make the bed)
inviting friends in and offering food and drinks; snacks and table vocabulary (боов, чихэр, аяга таваг); echo words with м- (цай май, боов моов, юм хум) for 'and stuff'
making buuz and salads together for a group; kitchen tasks and quantities (гурил зуурах, мах татах, хуваах); EN: collocations with make (make dinner, make a mess, make room)
juggling cooking, chatting, and setting the table; simultaneous actions in the kitchen; -х зуур for 'while/in the time that' (цай буцлах зуур ширээ засъя)
chatting, games, and taking photos at the gathering; host and guest phrases (тухлах, зочлох, сайхан хооллох); EN: collocations with have and take (have fun, have a seat, take a picture, take a break)
washing dishes, dealing with leftovers, and sharing chores with flatmates; cleanup vocabulary (угаах, хатаах, үлдэгдэл хоол); review of м- echo words, -х зуур, and make/do/have/take

units.scope: long projects, renovations, learning an instrument, long waits; duration terms; -аад ... болж байна, -ын турш; EN: present perfect continuous, for/since

talking about how long you've lived, worked, or studied somewhere; points in time vs periods (2020 оноос, гурван жил); -аад ... болсон, -аас хойш; EN: for vs since, How long have you...?

learning an instrument, practice and slow progress; music practice vocabulary (дасгал, хичээллэх, багш, ахиц); -аад ... болж байгаа ч, дахин дахин; EN: been + -ing with results visible now (My fingers hurt because I've been practicing)

lessons.title_en: A Project Years in the Making
