meeting an old friend and catching up on years apart; duration and change expressions (удаан, олон жил, хэзээ мөдгүй, өөрчлөгдөх); review of -аад ... болж байна, -гүй ... болж байна, -ын турш; EN: it's been (years) since, How long has it been?, for/since review

units.scope: bucket lists, dream trips, lottery daydreams; wishes and goals; wishful -х юм сан, -маар санагдах; EN: hope vs wish vs look forward to

lessons.focus: friends sharing bucket lists over coffee; life goals and experiences (мөрөөдөл, зорилго, жагсаалт, туршиж үзэх); wishful -х юм сан (Тэмээ унах юм сан) / EN: I wish I could + verb

imagining trips to Japan, Paris or the Altai; travel wishes and destinations (аялал, үзэсгэлэнт газар, виз, нисэх); -маар санагдах for longings (Далайд очмоор санагдаж байна) / EN: hope + present/future vs wish + past
lottery daydreams and spending fantasies; money and luxuries (сугалаа, хожих, тансаг, хандивлах); -х юм сан combined with -вал/-сан бол / EN: wish + past simple for present unreal wishes

lessons.title_en: Things I Wish I Had Done
lessons.focus: talking about missed chances and youthful regrets; regret vocabulary (харамсах, боломж алдах, залуу нас); past wishful -сан юм сан, -х байсан юм сан / EN: wish + past perfect, if only

waiting for Naadam, a graduation or a relative's visit; anticipation words (тэсэн ядан хүлээх, удахгүй, баяртай байх); -маар санагдах vs -хыг тэсэн ядан хүлээх / EN: look forward to + noun/-ing vs hope to

turning dreams into New Year plans with a friend; goal-setting vocabulary (төлөвлөгөө, алхам, хуримтлал, биелүүлэх); review of -х юм сан, -маар санагдах with -хын тулд / EN: contrast of hope, wish and look forward to

units.scope: Mongolian hip-hop, K-dramas, fan clubs, celebrity culture; entertainment industry terms; so-called -х гэгч, -ын нэрийн дор; EN: will/would for characteristic behavior

lessons.focus: friends discussing binge-watching K-dramas and favorite actors; series, episodes, plot twists, streaming terms (олон анги, үргэлжлэл, гол дүр); EN: will for characteristic present behavior (She'll watch ten episodes in one night)

talking about Mongolian rappers, battles and new albums; hip-hop and music industry terms (рэппер, цомог, дуу бичлэг, продюсер, клип); -х гэгч for introducing so-called or little-known names and terms (Тэр батл гэгч юу юм бэ?)
joining a fan club, meetups, fan events and merch; fandom vocabulary (шүтэн бишрэгч, фэн, бараа, уулзалт, гарын үсэг); EN: would for characteristic past behavior (We would queue for hours)

gossip, scandals and paparazzi around celebrities; celebrity culture terms (од, хов жив, дуулиан, нэр хүнд, олны танил); -х гэгч with ironic or skeptical meaning (алдартан гэгч нар, "мэргэжилтэн" гэгч)

influencers, sponsorships and hidden advertising; entertainment business terms (ивээн тэтгэгч, гэрээ, сурталчилгаа, контент, орлого); -ын нэрийн дор for doing something under the name or pretext of (урлагийн нэрийн дор, буяны нэрийн дор)

lessons.title_mn: Фэн байх: хүсэл тэмүүлэл үү, донтолт уу?
lessons.focus: a panel debate on fan culture's influence on young people; cultural impact and identity vocabulary (соёлын нөлөө, хандлага, дуурайх, хувийн орон зай); review combining -х гэгч, -ын нэрийн дор and EN will/would for characteristic and annoying behavior (He will keep posting about it!)

units.scope: rumors, fake cures, viral myths, debunking; credibility terms; гэх, гэлцэх, гэх мэт; EN: non-defining relative clauses, sentential which

lessons.focus: friends passing on gossip at work and in group chats; rumor vocabulary (цуу яриа, хов жив, сураг, баталгаагүй мэдээ); гэх as hearsay (... гэх юм, ... гэх мэдээлэл); EN: non-defining relative clauses with who/which and commas

a rumor spreading through a khoroo and on Facebook; spreading and reacting verbs (тараах, дэгдээх, итгэх, сэжиглэх); reciprocal-collective гэлцэх (гэлцдэг, гэлцэж байна); EN: sentential which commenting on a whole clause (..., which surprised everyone)

fake remedies and supplements sold online and at markets; health-claim vocabulary (эдгээх, гаж нөлөө, шинжлэх ухааны үндэслэлгүй, хуурамч эм); listing with гэх мэт and гэх мэтчлэн; EN: non-defining clauses with whose, where, when

viral posts, edited photos, and chain messages; online credibility terms (эх сурвалж, хуурамч зураг, засварласан, итгэл үнэмшил); naming and quoting with гэх as a modifier (... гэх нэртэй, ... гэх нийтлэл); EN: reduced non-defining clauses and appositives (the post, shared 10,000 times, ...)

a journalist verifying a claim step by step; verification vocabulary (нотлох баримт, баталгаажуулах, няцаах, найдвартай); contrasting hearsay гэх and гэлцэх with confirmed fact (-сан нь батлагдсан, гэх нь худал болох); EN: preposition + which/whom in non-defining clauses (, according to which, ...)

writing a public debunking post or an official refutation; correction vocabulary (залруулга, мэдэгдэл, буруу ойлголт, олон нийтийг төөрөгдүүлэх); combining гэх, гэлцэх, гэх мэт in formal written register; EN: sentential which and non-defining clauses in formal writing (, which is why..., none of which...)

units.scope: power plants, the heating grid, Gobi solar and wind farms; energy policy terms; formal future -х болно, -хаар төлөвлөгдсөн; EN: but for, were it not for, if it hadn't been for

lessons.focus: touring Ulaanbaatar's Thermal Power Plant No. 4; coal, boilers, turbines, capacity (хүчин чадал), megawatts; formal future -х болно in official descriptions (станц ... ажиллах болно) / EN: but for + noun (But for this plant, the city would freeze)

a winter outage in an apartment district; district heating, pipes, radiators, hot water, outages (тасалдал); -х болно for announced repairs and restoration times / EN: were it not for + noun for present unreal situations

lessons.title_en: Sun and Wind in the Gobi
lessons.focus: visiting solar and wind farms in Dornogovi and Sainshand; panels, wind turbines, renewable energy (сэргээгдэх эрчим хүч), output; planned future -хаар төлөвлөгдсөн (барихаар төлөвлөгдсөн) / EN: if it hadn't been for + noun for past unreal results

a press briefing on national energy policy; tariffs, subsidies, grid capacity, imports of electricity from Russia, energy independence; contrasting -х болно and -хаар төлөвлөгдсөн for decided vs planned steps / EN: inverted conditionals Were it not for and Had it not been for

lessons.title_mn: Нүүрс үү, цэвэр эрчим хүч үү?
lessons.focus: a debate on coal dependence, air pollution and the energy transition; emissions, storage, batteries, investment, the transition (шилжилт); hedged future -х болов уу vs firm -х болно / EN: but for, were it not for and if it hadn't been for in arguments and counterarguments

writing a short report on energy projects up to 2030; hydropower, the Asian super grid, export potential, efficiency; mixing -х болно and -хаар төлөвлөгдсөн in formal written register / EN: review of but for, were it not for and if it hadn't been for in formal writing

units.scope: wills, family land, heirlooms, passing on traditions; inheritance terms; evaluative -х нь дээр, -хаас -х нь илүү; EN: formal linkers hence, thus, thereby, notwithstanding

lessons.focus: a family gathers to hear a will read by a notary; inheritance terms (гэрээслэл, өв залгамжлагч, нотариат, өмч хөрөнгө, хуваах); evaluative -х нь дээр for recommendations (нотариатаар батлуулах нь дээр); EN: hence and thus to state consequences

siblings discuss a ger-district plot and a countryside winter camp; land and property terms (газар өмчлөл, хашаа, өвөлжөө, гэрчилгээ, эзэмших эрх); comparative evaluation -хаас -х нь илүү (зарахаас хадгалах нь илүү); EN: thereby + -ing to link an action to its result

describing a silver snuff bottle, an old deel, and a saddle handed down for generations; heirloom vocabulary (хөөрөг, мөнгөн аяга, удам дамжсан, дурсгалт, үнэ цэнэ); -х нь дээр vs -х нь илүү with nuance about sentiment versus money; EN: notwithstanding as a formal preposition (notwithstanding its age)

elders and young people talk about teaching khöömii, herding skills, and family customs; tradition and transmission terms (уламжлал, залгамж халаа, өвлүүлэх, сургаал, ёс заншил); combined evaluative forms with conditions (-вал ... -х нь илүү дээр); EN: contrasting hence/thus/therefore in register and position

a dispute over an apartment after a parent dies, with mediation and a court case; legal and conflict terms (маргаан, хууль ёсны өв залгамжлагч, хуваарилалт, эвлэрүүлэх, шүүх); weighing options with -хаас -х нь илүү in formal argument; EN: notwithstanding in clauses and in the end position (the objections notwithstanding)

writing a reflective essay or speech about personal and national legacy; abstract legacy vocabulary (өв соёл, ул мөр, хойч үе, үнэт зүйлс, дурсамж); integrated review of -х нь дээр and -хаас -х нь илүү in formal writing; EN: combining hence, thus, thereby, notwithstanding for cohesion in an essay

units.scope: lunar calendar, auspicious days for travel or haircuts, horoscopes, luck charms; luck vocabulary; presumptive -х байх, -сан байх; EN: must be / might be / can't be for present deduction

lessons.focus: checking the lunar calendar (цаглабар) in the morning; lunar calendar terms (билгийн тоолол, өдрийн сайн муу, жил, сар, мэнгэ); presumptive -х байх for present guesses (өнөөдөр сайн өдөр байх) / EN: might be, must be for present deduction

lessons.title_en: A Haircut on the Right Day
lessons.focus: choosing a day for a haircut or a child's first haircut (даахь үргээх); auspicious and inauspicious acts (үс засуулахад сайн, ээлтэй, харшлах); -х байх vs -сан байх for present vs completed guesses (тэр аль хэдийн үсээ засуулсан байх) / EN: must be vs can't be

picking a departure day and direction for a trip to the countryside; travel luck customs (зүг, мөр гаргах, сүү өргөх, замын ерөөл); -сан байх for deductions about others' actions (тэд аль хэдийн хөдөлсөн байх) / EN: must be + -ing, might be + -ing for ongoing situations

reading horoscopes and the twelve-year animal cycle with friends; zodiac and animal-year terms (жилийн амьтан, од, зурхайч, таарах); negative presumptive -хгүй байх, -аагүй байх (энэ зөв биш байх) / EN: can't be, couldn't be for strong negative deduction

talking about charms, lucky colors and numbers, and everyday superstitions; luck vocabulary (аз, азгүй, сахиус, бэлгэдэл, цээр, хийморь); softening a guess with байх аа, байх даа, байх л даа / EN: must be / might be / can't be contrasted, with may and could

lessons.title_mn: Зүгээр л аз байсан болов уу?
lessons.focus: discussing a lucky win or bad streak and whether luck is real; luck idioms and opinions (аз таарах, хийморь сэргэх, санамсаргүй, тохиолдол); mixing -х байх and -сан байх in reasoning about causes / EN: review of present deduction with must/might/can't in short arguments

units.scope: borrowing money from friends, lending books and tools, giving things back late; lending vocabulary; directional auxiliaries -аад ирэх, -аад явах, -аад өгөх; EN: lend vs borrow, double-object verbs (give it to me / give me it)

lessons.focus: asking a neighbor to lend tools for an apartment repair; tools and lending verbs (зээлэх, зээлдүүлэх, түр авах, буцааж өгөх); MN: зээлэх vs зээлүүлэх, polite requests with -ж болох уу; EN: lend vs borrow (lend someone something, borrow something from someone)

promising to return a borrowed book or charger; returning and deadline vocabulary (буцааж авчрах, хугацаа, хоцрох); MN: directional auxiliary -аад өгөх (авчраад өгөх, хийгээд өгөх); EN: double-object verbs (give me the book / give the book to me)

dropping by a friend's place to pick up or return things; errands and movement vocabulary (дайрах, хүргэх, очиж авах); MN: directional auxiliary -аад ирэх (авчраад ирэх, ороод ирэх); EN: pronoun objects with double-object verbs (give it to me, not give me it in standard use; bring it back)

complaining about someone who borrowed something and disappeared; trust and annoyance vocabulary (найдвар, мартамхай, хариуцлагагүй); MN: directional auxiliary -аад явах (аваад явах, гараад явах), contrast with -аад ирэх; EN: phrasal verbs with objects (pay back, give back, take away) and pronoun placement

lessons.title_en: Can You Lend Me Some Money?
lessons.focus: borrowing money from a friend before payday, agreeing on terms; money-lending vocabulary (өр, өртэй, төлөх, хүү, цалин буух); MN: combining -аад өгөх / -аад ирэх in promises (цалингаа аваад өгье); EN: owe, pay someone back, lend/borrow with amounts and double objects (lend me 50,000 tögrög)

returning things late, apologizing and settling up between friends; apology, damage and gratitude vocabulary (удах, гэмтээх, нөхөж төлөх, баярлалаа); MN: review of all three directional auxiliaries in narration; EN: review of lend vs borrow and double-object verbs in apologies and explanations

units.scope: plot summaries, spoilers, recommending series, cinema trips; film genre vocabulary; simultaneity -ж байхад, -ж байгаад; EN: present tenses for summarizing plots

lessons.title_en: What Kind of Movies Do You Like?
lessons.focus: chatting with a coworker about favorite films; genres (инээдмийн, аймшгийн, тулаант, уран зөгнөлт, баримтат кино); review of -х дуртай plus genre adjectives; EN: genre nouns as adjectives (a horror movie, a sci-fi series)

buying tickets online, choosing seats, snacks at a cinema in Ulaanbaatar; cinema vocabulary (тасалбар, суудал, үзвэр, хадмал орчуулга, дуу оруулга); simultaneity -ж байхад (кино гарч байхад утас дуугарсан); EN: while + past continuous vs when + past simple for interruptions

telling a friend the plot of a film; story vocabulary (гол дүр, үйл явдал, өрнөл, төгсгөл, жүжигчин); present-tense narration in Mongolian with -даг/-на and -ж байхад for parallel events; EN: present simple and present continuous for summarizing plots

avoiding and accidentally giving spoilers; reaction vocabulary (спойлер, гэнэтийн эргэлт, сэтгэл хөдлөм, уйтгартай); -ж байгаад for an action interrupted mid-way (үзэж байгаад унтчихсан); EN: present perfect in plot summaries (By this point, she has discovered...)

lessons.title_en: You Have to Watch This Series
lessons.focus: recommending series and streaming shows to family and friends; series vocabulary (цуврал, анги, улирал, шинэ анги гарах, нэг дор үзэх); combining -ж байхад and -ж байгаад with recommendations (хоол хийж байхад үзэхэд тохиромжтой); EN: recommending with should, you'll love it, it's worth watching

lessons.title_en: Mongolian Films on the Big Screen
lessons.focus: writing a short review of a Mongolian film for a blog; review and production vocabulary (найруулагч, зураг авалт, үнэлгээ, зохиол, дэлгэцнээ гарах); synthesis of -ж байхад and -ж байгаад in a written plot summary; EN: historic and summary present in a written review

units.scope: summer cottages, planting potatoes and vegetables, picking berries, family weekends; gardening vocabulary; quantifiers зарим, ихэнх, бүх, зарим нь ... зарим нь; EN: partitives (a bag of, a bunch of, a row of)

lessons.focus: Packing up and driving out of Ulaanbaatar for the weekend, arriving at the summer cottage; zuslan and cottage vocabulary (байшин, хашаа, худаг, саун, тагт); MN бүх vs бүгд (бүх хүн, бүгдээрээ); EN partitives with containers (a bag of, a box of, a can of)

The family plants potatoes in spring; planting vocabulary (үр, мөр, ухах, булах, хүрз, бордоо); MN ихэнх and ихэнх нь (ихэнх төмс, төмсний ихэнх нь); EN partitives for arrangement and amount (a row of, a sack of, a handful of)

Watering and weeding the garden, checking on carrots, cabbage, cucumbers in the greenhouse; garden-care vocabulary (услах, хогийн ургамал, хүлэмж, соёолох, ургац); MN зарим (зарим ногоо, зарим өдөр) vs ихэнх; EN partitives for produce (a head of cabbage, a bunch of carrots, a clove of garlic)

A berry-picking trip in the hills near the zuslan; berry and forest vocabulary (нэрс, үхрийн нүд, жимсгэнэ, гүзээлзгэнэ, сагс, түүх); MN зарим нь ... зарим нь (зарим нь түүж, зарим нь идэж байлаа); EN partitives for small quantities (a bucket of, a cup of, a pile of)

Relatives gather for khorkhog, games and evenings by the fire; weekend and leisure vocabulary (хорхог, гал түлэх, түлээ, сагсан бөмбөг, амрах); MN quantifiers with people (бүх хамаатнууд, ихэнх хүүхдүүд, зарим нь); EN partitives for groups and pieces (a group of, a piece of, a slice of, a stack of)

Autumn harvest, digging up potatoes, making jam and pickles, storing food in the cellar; harvest and preserving vocabulary (хураах, зоорь, чанамал, даршлах, нөөцлөх); review of бүх, ихэнх, зарим, зарим нь ... зарим нь in contrast; EN review of partitives (a jar of, a sack of, a crate of)

units.scope: Khalkha, Oirat, Buryat and Inner Mongolian speech, regional pride, standard language; dialect terms; recognizing common dialectal word forms vs standard Khalkha; EN: British vs American vs other varieties of English

lessons.focus: meeting someone from Khovd or Buryatia and guessing their origin; dialect terms (аялга, аялгуу, нутгийн хэл, утга зохиолын хэл, эх хэл); nominal suffix -хан/-хэн for place of origin (ховдхон, буриад хүн) and genitive + -х (нутгийнх, хаанахынх); EN: describing accents (a strong/slight/thick accent, sound British, have a Southern twang)

a trip to Uvs and Khovd and listening to Dörvöd and Torguud speakers; Oirat words and sound features compared with Khalkha (vowel length, ц/ч differences, local kinship terms); recognizing dialect forms with -ын хувьд ... гэдэг бол ... гэдэг (Халхад ... гэдгийг ойрдууд ... гэдэг); EN: vocabulary differences British vs American English (flat/apartment, lorry/truck, queue/line)

visiting Buryat relatives in Dornod and Russia and hearing с/х and other sound shifts; Buryat greetings and Russian loanwords in Buryat speech; contrasting forms with -тай адил биш, харин -тай ойролцоо and -хаас ялгаатай нь; EN: pronunciation differences between varieties (rhotic r, the 'bath' vowel, t-flapping)

lessons.title_en: Across the Border: Inner Mongolian Speech
lessons.focus: talking with a student from Hohhot and noticing Chinese loanwords and different terms (e.g., for technology and administration); vocabulary of script and standard (уйгаржин бичиг, кирилл, нэр томьёо, зээлдсэн үг); reported recognition with -дэг юм байна and -гэж хэлдэг юм уу?; EN: spelling and grammar differences (-our/-or, -ise/-ize, have got vs have, collective noun agreement)

a debate about regional pride, teasing accents and whether dialects are disappearing; attitude vocabulary (бахархал, ялгаварлах, шоолох, хадгалан үлдээх, жигдрэх); evaluative and concessive frames -хыг буруутгах аргагүй, -сан ч гэсэн; EN: world Englishes (Australian, Indian, Irish, Nigerian English) and attitudes toward 'standard' accents

writing a short reflective post on standard Khalkha in media, schools and broadcasting; language policy terms (албан ёсны хэл, хэм хэмжээ, зөв бичих дүрэм, нэвтрүүлэгч); academic nominal style with -ын талаар, -тай холбоотойгоор and -х нь зүйтэй; EN: discussing standard vs non-standard forms (General American, Received Pronunciation, dialect leveling) with hedging

units.scope: Mongolian UN peacekeepers, Khaan Quest exercises, national security debates; defense and security terms; postpositions -ын дагуу, -ыг үндэслэн; EN: reduced relative clauses (troops deployed abroad)

lessons.focus: a news feature on Mongolian UN peacekeepers in South Sudan; peacekeeping terms (энхийг сахиулагч, цэргийн алба хаагч, байршуулах, ээлж); -ын дагуу with mandates and agreements (НҮБ-ын шийдвэрийн дагуу); EN: past-participle reduced relatives (troops deployed abroad)

a briefing at the Five Hills training area during the multinational Khaan Quest exercise; exercise and training vocabulary (сургуулилт, оролцогч орон, хамтын ажиллагаа, бэлэн байдал); -ын дагуу with plans and schedules (төлөвлөгөөний дагуу, хуваарийн дагуу); EN: present-participle reduced relatives (soldiers taking part in the exercise)

a peacekeeper's messages to family about daily life on a mission, patrols, and civilians; field and humanitarian terms (эргүүл, хуаран, дүрвэгсэд, хамгаалалт, эргэж ирэх); -ыг үндэслэн for grounds and evidence (мэдээллийг үндэслэн, нөхцөл байдлыг үндэслэн); EN: reduced relatives with prepositional phrases and adjectives (families waiting at home, a camp full of refugees)

a policy seminar on Mongolia's neutrality, the third neighbor policy, and its nuclear-weapon-free status; national security terms (үндэсний аюулгүй байдал, тусгаар тогтнол, бүрэн эрхт байдал, гадаад бодлого, төвийг сахих); -ыг үндэслэн with laws and concepts (Үндсэн хуулийг үндэслэн, үзэл баримтлалыг үндэслэн); EN: reduced relatives in formal policy writing (the concept adopted in 2010, risks facing small states)

lessons.title_mn: Цэргийн алба ба кибер аюулгүй байдал
lessons.focus: a televised debate on mandatory military service, paying instead of serving, and cyber and border threats; debate and threat terms (цэрэг татлага, цэргийн алба хаах үүрэг, мөнгөөр солих, кибер халдлага, хилийн хамгаалалт); contrasting -ын дагуу and -ыг үндэслэн when citing laws and data in an argument; EN: reduced relatives vs full relative clauses for clarity and style

an anniversary ceremony speech and press release on two decades of Mongolian peacekeeping; honors and ceremony terms (одон медаль, гавьяа, дурсгал, эх орныхоо нэрийг өндөрт өргөх); integrated formal register with -ын дагуу and -ыг үндэслэн in official texts; EN: combining reduced relatives in formal speeches (officers honored today, missions completed since 2002)

units.scope: disability rights, ramps and sidewalks in Ulaanbaatar, inclusive schools, sign language; accessibility terms; possibility forms -х боломжтой/боломжгүй, -хад хүндрэлтэй; EN: suppose/supposing, what if, imagine + hypothetical past

lessons.focus: a wheelchair user describes a daily route through Ulaanbaatar; ramps, curbs, sidewalks, elevators, potholes, parked cars; -х боломжтой / -х боломжгүй for physical possibility; EN: suppose/supposing + present for realistic scenarios

lessons.title_en: Rights on Paper and in Practice
lessons.focus: a talk on the law on the rights of persons with disabilities; эрх, хөгжлийн бэрхшээлтэй иргэн, тэгш боломж, ялгаварлан гадуурхах; -хад хүндрэлтэй / -хад хүндрэлгүй for difficulty; EN: what if + present vs past for likely vs unlikely outcomes

parents and a principal discuss inclusive education; хамруулах сургалт, туслах багш, тусгай хэрэгцээ, ангийн орчин; -х боломжийг бүрдүүлэх, -х боломж олгох; EN: imagine + hypothetical past (Imagine you were...)

learning Mongolian Sign Language and working with an interpreter; дохионы хэл, сонсголгүй, хэлмэрч, хадмал, уруул уншах; -х боломжгүй байсан / -х боломжтой болсон for change in possibility; EN: suppose/supposing + past for hypothetical situations

an architect and a blind tester review a new building and website; хүртээмж, дуут дохио, товгор зам, дэлгэц уншигч, брайль; contrasting -х боломжтой vs -хад хүндрэлтэй in evaluations; EN: what if / suppose in proposals and objections (What if we added...?)

a public hearing on making Ulaanbaatar accessible by 2030; хүртээмжтэй орчин, нийтийн тээвэр, хөрөнгө оруулалт, бодлого, оролцоо; combining possibility and difficulty forms in persuasive argument; EN: review of suppose, what if, imagine + past in a debate

units.scope: Mongolian designers, the modern deel, fashion weeks, sustainable clothing; design and style terms; viewpoint postpositions -ын үүднээс, -ыг харгалзан; EN: intensifying adverb + adjective collocations (strikingly original, utterly impractical)

lessons.focus: profiles of Mongolian fashion designers and their brands; design and style terms (загвар, хээ, өнгө хослол, брэнд, цуглуулга); EN: intro to intensifying adverb + adjective collocations (highly original, deeply traditional)
redesigning the deel for city life and the office; garment parts and fabrics (зах, ханцуй, энгэр, торго, ноолуур); viewpoint postposition -ын үүднээс (уламжлалын үүднээс, хэрэглээний үүднээс)

runway shows in Ulaanbaatar, models, stylists, show reviews; event and show vocabulary (тайз, загвар өмсөгч, үзүүлбэр, шүүмж); EN: evaluative collocations (strikingly bold, utterly impractical, surprisingly wearable)

lessons.title_en: Designing with the Client in Mind
lessons.focus: briefs and fittings, adapting designs to climate, budget and body type; tailoring and client terms (хэмжээ, захиалга, төсөв, тав тух); considering postposition -ыг харгалзан (цаг агаарыг харгалзан, төсвийг харгалзан)

eco-friendly clothing, fast fashion vs slow fashion, recycling and ethical sourcing; sustainability terms (тогтвортой, дахин боловсруулах, байгальд ээлтэй, хэт хэрэглээ); combining -ын үүднээс and -ыг харгалзан in arguments; EN: collocations with deeply/highly/seriously (highly wasteful, deeply concerned)

writing and discussing a fashion review or design debate; review vocabulary (уран сайхны шийдэл, гоо зүй, хандлага); review of viewpoint postpositions and intensifier collocations in extended writing (remarkably elegant, painfully dated, refreshingly simple)

units.scope: phones left in taxis, lost wallets, lost-property desks; describing objects; approximate qualities -втар/-втэр, -дуу/-дүү (томовтор, жаахан хуучиндуу); EN: possessive 's vs of, double possessive (a friend of mine)

lessons.title_en: I Left My Phone in a Taxi
lessons.focus: realizing a phone is missing and calling the taxi company or driver; phones, bags, keys, seats and trunk; MN: intro to -втар/-втэр for approximate size and color (томовтор, харовтор); EN: possessive 's with people (the driver's number, my sister's bag)

describing a lost item in detail; shape, material, color, condition (арьсан, даавуун, зураастай, хагарсан); MN: -дуу/-дүү for 'a bit too/rather' (жаахан хуучиндуу, урттуу) contrasted with -втар; EN: of for things and parts (the color of the case, the corner of the wallet)

losing a wallet in a store or on the bus and blocking cards; wallet contents like ID card, bank cards, cash and photos; MN: -втар/-дуу with adjectives of age, thickness and weight (нимгэвтэр, хүндэвтэр, зузаандуу); EN: 's vs of choice rules (the bank's app vs the back of the card)

filling in a lost-item form at a mall, airport or university; form vocabulary like claim, proof of ownership, serial number and pick-up; MN: approximate forms in questions and answers (бараавтар уу, цайвардуу байсан); EN: double possessive (a friend of mine, a colleague of my father's)

finding someone's item and returning it; mine/yours/theirs and identifying an owner; MN: -ынх possessive nouns plus -втар/-дуу in descriptions (миний ах-ынх, жаахан жижигдүү); EN: possessive pronouns and 's with plurals and compounds (the students' dorm, my parents-in-law's car)

telling the story of losing and recovering a valued heirloom or item, with thanks and rewards; story review vocabulary; MN: review of -втар/-втэр vs -дуу/-дүү with subtle nuance; EN: review of 's, of and double possessive in narratives

units.scope: private tutoring, IELTS prep, online courses, staying motivated; learning vocabulary; struggle forms -ж ядах, -х гэж ядах; EN: -ed vs -ing adjectives (bored/boring, confused/confusing)

lessons.focus: searching for a private tutor online and asking about rates and schedules; tutoring vocabulary (хувийн багш, хичээлийн хуваарь, цагийн төлбөр, туршилтын хичээл); MN: intro to -ж ядах for doing something with great difficulty (ойлгож ядаж байна); EN: basic -ed vs -ing adjectives (interested/interesting, bored/boring)

preparing for IELTS and talking about bands and test sections; exam vocabulary (оноо, сонсгол, бичгийн даалгавар, ярианы шалгалт, жишиг тест); MN: -ж ядах with skills (сонсож ядах, бичиж ядах) vs -ж чадахгүй; EN: confused/confusing, tired/tiring when describing tasks vs feelings

taking online courses, video lessons and app subscriptions; online learning vocabulary (бичлэг, даалгавар илгээх, сертификат, холболт тасрах); MN: -х гэж ядах for straining to achieve something (ойлгох гэж ядах, амжуулах гэж ядах); EN: frustrated/frustrating, annoyed/annoying for tech problems

memorizing vocabulary, flashcards and study techniques; study-method vocabulary (цээжлэх, давтах, карт, тэмдэглэл хөтлөх, анхаарал төвлөрүүлэх); MN: contrasting -ж ядах and -х гэж ядах in one context (цээжилж ядах vs цээжлэх гэж ядах); EN: -ed vs -ing adjectives after linking verbs (feel overwhelmed, seem overwhelming)

staying motivated, procrastination and study burnout; motivation vocabulary (урам зориг, хойш тавих, ядрах, зорилго тавих, тууштай байх); MN: -ж ядах in emotional and physical struggle (босож ядах, суугаад ядах) and with past/negative tenses; EN: disappointed/disappointing, encouraged/encouraging, motivated/motivating

getting exam results, thanking tutors and reflecting on the journey; results and feedback vocabulary (дүн, ахиц, зөвлөгөө, тэтгэлэгт тэнцэх); MN: review of -ж ядах and -х гэж ядах in narrating a hard struggle that ended well; EN: review of -ed vs -ing pairs (amazed/amazing, relieved, satisfying) in a short story

units.scope: dropped phones, broken dishes, spilled tea, damaged deliveries; accident vocabulary; expressive completion -ж орхих, -ж хаях; EN: get-passive (got broken, got stolen)

lessons.focus: dropping a phone on the street or in a bus, cracked screen; phone damage words (дэлгэц хагарах, унагах, гулсах, хагархай); -ж орхих for sudden or unintended actions (унагаж орхилоо); EN: get-passive basics (my screen got cracked)

breaking a bowl or plate while washing up or setting the table for guests; kitchenware and breaking verbs (хагалах, хагарах, бутрах, хэлтэрхий, ан цав); transitive vs intransitive pairs (хагалах/хагарах) with -ж орхих; EN: break vs get broken, who did it vs what happened

spilling milk tea on a laptop, documents or a deel; liquid and stain words (асгах, асгарах, толбо, норох, арчих, угаах); -ж хаях for careless or regrettable actions (асгаж хаялаа); EN: get-passive with dirty/wet/stained (it got soaked, my shirt got stained)

receiving a crushed box or broken item from a courier, complaining and asking for a replacement; delivery damage terms (гэмтэх, няцрах, хайрцаг, солиулах, гомдол гаргах); -ж орхих/-ж хаях to blame others' handling (дарж орхисон, шидэж хаясан); EN: get-passive in past simple for complaints (it got crushed in transit)

having a wallet or phone stolen on a crowded bus or at a market, reporting it; loss and theft words (хулгайд алдах, халаас, түрийвч, гээх, мэдүүлэг); -ж хаях vs -ж орхих for losing and forgetting things (гээж хаясан, мартаж орхисон); EN: get stolen, get lost, get taken vs be stolen

talking over a chain of mishaps, apologizing, offering to pay or repair; responsibility and repair vocabulary (санамсаргүй, зориуд, нөхөн төлөх, засуулах, буруутай); review and contrast of -ж орхих and -ж хаях in narratives; EN: get-passive vs be-passive and get + past participle in mixed tenses (it's getting fixed, it got replaced)

units.scope: family albums, wedding photos, trip pictures, phone galleries; photography vocabulary; perception verbs харагдах, сонсогдох, үнэртэх with -ж; EN: see/hear + object + base verb or -ing

lessons.focus: browsing an old family album with grandparents; album and print photo words (зураг, цомог, хар цагаан зураг, хуучирсан); MN харагдах 'to look, appear' (залуу харагдаж байна), EN see + object + base verb (I see Grandpa smile)

choosing and describing wedding photos; photographer and shoot vocabulary (зурагчин, гэрэл, дэвсгэр, ретушь); MN -ж харагдах for how people appear in a moment (инээж харагдана), EN see + object + -ing vs base verb (saw them dancing / saw them cut the cake)

showing countryside and travel pictures to friends; landscape and camera terms (өргөн өнцөг, ойроос авах, бүдэг, тод); MN харагдах vs үзэгдэх for visible things in the frame (уул тод харагдаж байна), EN watch/notice + object + -ing

replaying phone videos from Naadam and family gatherings; video and audio terms (бичлэг, дуу, чимээ, микрофон); MN сонсогдох with -ж (хүүхэд инээж байгаа нь сонсогдож байна), EN hear + object + base verb or -ing (I can hear the kids laughing)

how smells and sounds bring back childhood memories behind photos; senses and memory vocabulary (дурсамж, сэргээх, үнэр, анхилуун); MN үнэртэх and -ж сонсогдох/үнэртэх (буузны үнэр үнэртэж байна), EN smell/feel + object + -ing (I could smell bread baking)

sorting, deleting and backing up phone photos, sharing in family chats; digital photo terms (зургийн сан, хуулбар, үүлэн сан, устгах, хуваалцах); review of харагдах/сонсогдох/үнэртэх with -ж, EN review of perception verb + object + base verb or -ing in storytelling

units.scope: family names (ургийн овог), naming children, nicknames, protective names like Нэргүй; naming terms; paired words (ах дүү, найз нөхөд, эд зүйл); EN: object complements (named him Bat), be known as

lessons.focus: Filling in forms and talking about the 2000s revival of clan names (Боржигин, Хиад); naming terms ургийн овог, эцэг/эхийн нэр, өөрийн нэр; paired words for kin like ах дүү, үр хүүхэд, ураг төрөл; EN: be known as / go by

Parents debating names and asking a lama or grandparent to name the baby; name meanings and elements (Бат, Эрдэнэ, Сүх, Цэцэг); paired words like эд зүйл, хувцас хунар; EN: object complements (They named him Bat, called her Saraa)

Explaining protective names like Нэргүй, Энэбиш, Хүнбиш and the belief in fooling evil spirits; belief and taboo vocabulary; paired words with шүтлэг бишрэл, ёс заншил; EN: object complement with adjectives and nouns (keep the child safe, consider it bad luck)

Friends trading stories about school and work nicknames and short forms (Бат → Батаа, Болороо); nickname and teasing vocabulary; paired words найз нөхөд, хөгжилтэй хошин, the endearment -аа/-ээ; EN: be known as vs be called vs go by + nickname

A guide explaining how places, horses and brands got their names (Улаанбаатар, Хар хорин, horses named for coat color); naming-origin vocabulary нэрлэгдсэн, нэрийг нь хайрласан; paired words газар ус, мал сүрэг; EN: be named after/for, passive object complements (was renamed Ulaanbaatar)

A reflective discussion or short essay on identity, changing your name and names abroad; abstract identity vocabulary; mixed review of paired words in formal register (эрх ашиг, нэр төр); EN: combining object complements with be known as/regarded as in formal writing

units.scope: olympiads, talent shows, scholarship contests, fair judging; competition terms; correlative clauses хэн ... тэр, юу ... тэр, хаана ... тэнд; EN: nominal relative clauses (whoever wins, what matters is)

lessons.focus: registering for a national math or physics olympiad (аймгийн шат, улсын шат, бүртгүүлэх, оролцогч, даалгавар); correlative хэн ... тэр for open participation (Хэн хүсэж байна, тэр бүртгүүлж болно); EN: whoever as subject (Whoever wants to can register)

TV talent shows and live voting (шүгэл, үзэгчдийн санал, шүүгчид, дараагийн шатанд шалгарах, тоглолт); юу ... тэр for whatever is done or shown (Юу бэлдсэн, тэрийгээ үзүүл); EN: what-clauses as object (Show us what you've prepared)

scholarship contests and application essays (тэтгэлэг, шалгуур, өрсөлдөөн, амжилт, сурлагын дүн, ярилцлага); хэн ... тэр with conditions and results (Хэн хамгийн өндөр оноо авна, тэр тэтгэлэг авна); EN: whoever/whichever in subject position (Whoever scores highest gets the scholarship)

talent scouting in aimags and soums, rural schools and wrestling and chess clubs (авьяас илрүүлэх, дасгалжуулагч, сонгон шалгаруулалт, нутгийн клуб); хаана ... тэнд and хэзээ ... тэр үед correlatives; EN: wherever/whenever clauses and nominal where (That's where champions start)

disputed results, bias and appeals (шударга шүүлт, ашиг сонирхлын зөрчил, давж заалдах, оноо, нууц санал, ил тод байдал); correlatives with юу/ямар (Ямар шалгуур тавина, тэрийгээ мөрдөх ёстой); EN: pseudo-clefts with what (What matters is transparency)

a debate on merit versus connections, quotas and the value of competition (чадварт суурилсан, танил тал, тэгш боломж, шагнал, урам зориг); combining multiple correlatives in argument (Хэн хичээнэ, тэр л амжилтад хүрнэ; хаана шударга бус, тэнд итгэл алга); EN: nominal relative clauses as subject/complement (What we need is..., Whoever deserves it should...)

units.scope: TV news bulletins, government decrees, press statements; official register; literary converb -н, participle -ж буй, буюу; EN: complex prepositions (in light of, with regard to, owing to)

lessons.focus: TV news bulletin openings and headlines; news anchor vocabulary (мэдээлэл, шуурхай, сурвалжлагч, эх сурвалж); participle -ж буй as an official present modifier (үргэлжилж буй, хэрэгжиж буй); EN: in light of, in view of

Reading government decrees and resolutions; decree vocabulary (тогтоол, зарлиг, захирамж, хүчин төгөлдөр); literary converb -н linking official actions (хэлэлцэн баталж, судлан үзэж); EN: in accordance with, pursuant to

Press statements and official responses; press office vocabulary (мэдэгдэл, хэвлэлийн төлөөлөгч, байр суурь, тодруулга); буюу for clarification and restatement (2025 он буюу ирэх жил); EN: with regard to, with respect to, regarding

Emergency and weather announcements (school closures, road closures, quarantine); public notice vocabulary (түр хугацаагаар, хязгаарлалт, иргэд, анхааруулга); combining -н and -ж буй in announcement chains; EN: owing to, due to, on account of

Announcing new laws, tax and fee changes, and effective dates; legislation vocabulary (нэмэлт өөрчлөлт, мөрдөх, шийдвэрлэх, хэрэгжүүлэх); буюу in definitions and numbered alternatives in official texts; EN: as of, with effect from, in the event of

Drafting and paraphrasing a full announcement from casual speech into official register; register-shift vocabulary (иргэдэд мэдэгдэж байна, анхаарна уу, уучлалт гуйж байна); integrated review of -н, -ж буй, буюу; EN: complex prepositions review (on behalf of, in response to, by means of)

units.scope: bribery scandals, transparency, public trust in institutions; governance terms; emphatic negation огт, ерөөсөө, нэг ч ... -гүй; EN: emphatic negatives (by no means, not in the least, whatsoever)

lessons.focus: reading and discussing news of a bribery scandal at a ministry; core corruption terms (авлига, хээл хахууль, албан тушаалтан, мөрдөн шалгах); emphatic огт + -гүй (огт мэдээгүй) / EN: not at all, not in the least

officials denying accusations at a press briefing; denial and accusation vocabulary (буруутгал, няцаах, нотлох баримт, хариуцлага); ерөөсөө for flat denial (ерөөсөө аваагүй) / EN: by no means, in no way, whatsoever after nouns

citizens checking public spending and tenders online, glass-account (шилэн данс) style transparency; transparency terms (ил тод байдал, тендер, төсөв, тайлагнах); нэг ч ... -гүй (нэг ч тайлан нийтлээгүй) / EN: not a single, not one, no ... at all

discussing survey results on trust in courts, police and parliament; institution and trust vocabulary (олон нийтийн итгэл, хараат бус байдал, шударга ёс, итгэлгүй байдал); combining огт, ерөөсөө and хэн ч/юу ч ... -гүй for strong negation / EN: not ... in the slightest, no ... whatsoever, never ever

everyday petty corruption: gifts to doctors, "envelopes" for school places, connections (танил тал); conflict-of-interest vocabulary (ашиг сонирхлын зөрчил, танил тал, бэлэг сэлт, ёс зүй); emphatic negative imperatives and refusals (огт битгий, ерөөсөө авахгүй) / EN: under no circumstances, on no account, no way

formal debate on anti-corruption reforms and the Anti-Corruption Agency's role (АТГ); reform and governance terms (шинэчлэл, хяналт, хариуцлагатай засаглал, шийтгэл); full review of emphatic negation in formal argument / EN: emphatic negatives in formal speech (by no means, not in the least, nothing whatsoever, far from)

units.scope: roommates, splitting bills, house rules, whose turn to clean; household-sharing terms; place-of-belonging -ынх (манайх, ээжийнх, хэнийх); EN: whose, possessive pronouns mine/theirs, of one's own

lessons.focus: moving into a shared apartment and introducing roommates; roommate and room terms (хамт амьдрагч, түрээс, өрөө хуваах); -ынх for a household or home: манайх, танайх, Батынх; EN: possessive pronouns mine/yours/ours/theirs
sorting out mugs, food, and chargers in the shared kitchen; shared vs personal belongings; хэнийх, минийх, чинийх, түүнийх as predicates; EN: whose questions and answers (Whose is it? It's hers.)

dividing rent, electricity, heating, and internet bills; utility and payment terms (СӨХ-ийн төлбөр, дулааны мөнгө, хувааж төлөх); -ынх with -аас/-д: Болдынхоос, Сарангийнхад; EN: possessive pronouns as subjects and objects (Mine is paid, theirs isn't)

making a cleaning schedule and arguing about chores; chore and rota terms (ээлж, жижүүр, хогоо гаргах); ээлж with the genitive vs -ынх (миний ээлж, өнөөдөр хэнийх вэ); EN: whose turn, It's your turn to + verb

agreeing on rules about guests, noise, and quiet hours; rule and courtesy terms (зочин дагуулах, чимээгүй цаг, зөвшөөрөл авах); -ынх with family and places: ээжийнх, эмээгийнх, найзынх (going to someone's place); EN: at someone's place (at my mom's, at Bat's)

weighing shared living against living alone and planning to move out; independence and housing terms (бие даах, өөрийн гэсэн, хувийн орон зай); combining өөрийн and -ынх (өөрийнх, бусдынх); EN: of one's own, on one's own, a room of my own

units.scope: hospital queues, bank lines, waiting for results and repairs; time and queue terms; posture auxiliaries -ж суух, -ж зогсох, -ж хэвтэх; EN: by vs until, by the time + clause

lessons.focus: getting a queue ticket at a bank or hospital registration desk; queue terms (дугаар, дараалал, ээлж, цонх, хүлээлгийн танхим); posture auxiliary -ж зогсох (дараалалд зогсож байна); EN: until for duration (wait until your number is called)

waiting at a family clinic or hospital outpatient department; time words (удаан, хагас цаг, удахгүй, түр хүлээх); posture auxiliary -ж суух (хоёр цаг хүлээж суулаа); EN: by vs until contrast (be here by 9 / wait until 9)

lessons.title_en: Stuck in Bed, Waiting for Results
lessons.focus: waiting in a hospital ward for test results and doctor rounds; medical-results vocabulary (шинжилгээний хариу, эмчийн үзлэг, тасаг); posture auxiliary -ж хэвтэх (хариугаа хүлээж хэвтэж байна); EN: by + deadline (results will be ready by Friday)

waiting for phone, car, or apartment repairs and asking about deadlines; repair-time terms (хугацаа, хойшлох, бэлэн болох, хүлээн авах); contrasting -ж суух / -ж зогсох / -ж хэвтэх for idle or lengthy waiting; EN: by the time + present clause (by the time you come, it'll be ready)

politely complaining about line-cutting and priority queues for the elderly and pregnant women; queue etiquette vocabulary (дараалал зөрчих, урд нь орох, давуу эрх, ээлжээ хүлээх); posture auxiliaries in past and negative forms (зогсоогүй, сууж байсан); EN: by the time + past clause with past perfect (by the time I got there, they had closed)

retelling a long day of hospital, bank, and repair-shop waits; review of time and queue terms; combining -ж суух, -ж зогсох, -ж хэвтэх in a narrative; EN: review of by vs until and by the time in past and future stories

units.scope: car, health and livestock insurance, claims, worst cases; risk terms; apprehensive -вий, possibility -ж мэдэх; EN: may well, could easily, there's a chance that

lessons.focus: talking with a friend about getting insured; basic insurance terms (даатгал, даатгалын компани, гэрээ, хураамж, эрсдэл); possibility -ж мэдэх (осол гарч мэднэ); EN: there's a chance that

units.scope: Kazakh eagle hunters in Bayan-Ölgii, training birds, hunting rules and licenses; hunting terms; transitive-intransitive verb pairs (эвдэх/эвдрэх, хагалах/хагарах, нээх/нээгдэх); EN: ergative verbs (the ice broke / he broke the ice)

lessons.focus: visiting a Kazakh eagle hunter's family in Bayan-Ölgii; eagle hunting basics (бүргэд, бүргэдчин, томоға/нүдэвч, ээвэр, морь); intro to transitive vs intransitive pairs: эвдэх/эвдрэх, нээх/нээгдэх; EN: ergative verbs (the door opened / she opened the door)

lessons.title_en: Taking a Chick from the Nest
lessons.focus: how young eagles are taken and raised; nests, cliffs, feathers, feeding (үүр, хад, өд, мах тэжээх); pairs with -р-/-л- vs -га-/-гаа- (хагалах/хагарах, унагах/унах, сэрээх/сэрэх); EN: ergative verbs of change (the egg cracked / he cracked the egg)

daily training: hood, glove, calling the bird back, lure (бээлий, томоға, дуудах, өлсгөх, дасгах); causative vs intransitive pairs (сурах/сургах, дасах/дасгах, суух/суулгах); EN: verbs used both ways (the bird settled / he settled the bird), make/get + object

hunting seasons, permits, protected species, fines; legal hunting terms (агнуурын зөвшөөрөл, хориотой амьтан, улирал, торгууль); agentive transitive vs passive -гд- vs intransitive (хаах/хаагдах, зөрчих/зөрчигдөх, сунгах/сунгагдах); EN: ergative vs passive (the season closed / the season was closed by the ministry)

lessons.title_en: A Winter Hunt in the Mountains
lessons.focus: a fox hunt narrative on frozen slopes; prey, tracks, snow and ice (үнэг, мөр, мөс, цас, хормой); event pairs in storytelling (хөлдөх/хөлдөөх, гулсах/гулсуулах, ойртох/ойртуулах, мөс хагарах/хагалах); EN: ergatives in narrative (the ice broke under us, the engine stopped / he stopped the engine)

the October festival in Ölgii, tourism, debate on tradition vs show; festival and heritage terms (уралдаан, оролцогч, уламжлал хадгалах, жуулчин); choosing the right member of a verb pair in formal and spoken discussion (өөрчлөх/өөрчлөгдөх, сэргээх/сэргэх, тасрах/таслах); EN: ergatives with abstract subjects (traditions change / tourism changed traditions)

units.scope: Geser and Jangar epics, epic singers, legends behind place names; folklore terms; narrative evidential particle аж (байсан аж); EN: inversion after fronted place adverbials (Into the valley rode...)

lessons.focus: Hearing a grandparent tell a legend; folklore terms (домог, үлгэр, тууль, баатар, мангас); narrative evidential аж with simple past (байсан аж, амьдардаг байжээ аж) vs direct past -сан; EN: inversion after fronted place adverbials with be/live (In a far land lived a khan)

Retelling episodes of the Geser epic; hero, enemy and magic vocabulary (хувилгаан, хорон санаат, ид шид, хүлэг морь); аж in sequences of past events (дийлсэн аж, явжээ аж); EN: inversion with verbs of motion after directional adverbials (Into the valley rode Geser)

lessons.focus: Describing the ideal land of the Oirat epic Jangar; utopia and landscape vocabulary (мөнх залуу, бүмбэ орон, ордон, эрдэнэ); stative аж (байдаг аж, ажээ) for describing the legendary world; EN: inversion after there/here and place phrases with stative verbs (Beyond the mountains stood a palace)

A documentary interview about epic singers and their training; performance vocabulary (туульч, хайлах, товшуур, цээжлэх, шүтлэг ёс); contrasting аж (reported tradition) with -жээ and -сан юм байна (new realization); EN: inversion vs normal order in descriptive vs neutral narration (On the stage sat an old singer / An old singer sat on the stage)

lessons.title_en: How the Lake Got Its Name
lessons.focus: Tour guide explaining legends behind place names (Хөвсгөл, Өлгий, Тэрхийн Цагаан нуур); place and origin vocabulary (нэрийдсэн, гаралтай, үлдэгдэл, ул мөр); гэдэг аж, гэж нэрлэсэн аж for passed-on explanations; EN: fronted place adverbials with pronoun subjects (no inversion: Here it stopped) vs noun subjects (Here stopped the horse)

Writing and performing your own short legend for a culture evening; storytelling structure vocabulary (эхлэл, оргил, төгсгөл, сургамж); combining аж, -жээ and converbs into a full narrative; EN: review of inversion after fronted place and direction adverbials for dramatic effect

planning a secret birthday party with coworkers; party and surprise terms (гэнэтийн, бялуу, лаа, нууцлах, чимэглэх); -д зориулж зохион байгуулах, contrasting -д зориулж vs -д зориулсан / EN: It's difficult/fun/impossible to keep it a secret, It's + adjective + for someone + to

gift customs compared: returning gifts, money in envelopes, regifting, charity donations; giving and receiving terms (өглөг, хандив, буцааж бэлэглэх, мөнгөн бэлэг); integrated -д зориулж/-д зориулсан in discussion / EN: It's + adjective + to-infinitive with not and past forms (It's considered rude not to, It was wrong to)

meeting for coffee or dinner in Ulaanbaatar, small talk and nervousness; first-date vocabulary (болзох, ичих, сэтгэл хөдлөх, анхны сэтгэгдэл); MN past negative questions -аагүй юу/-ээгүй юу (Та өмнө нь энд ирээгүй юу?) / EN Haven't you...? / Didn't you...? for experiences and past events

defining the relationship, meeting friends, anniversaries and gifts; romance terms (үерхэх, хайртай, найз охин/залуу, сэтгэлтэй байх); MN negative questions for confirming and hoping (Чи надад хайртай биш гэж үү? Ойлгосон биш үү?) / EN negative questions expecting yes (Isn't it obvious? Aren't we a couple?)

jealousy, unanswered calls and arguments; conflict vocabulary (атаархах, гомдох, хардах, маргалдах); MN complaining and surprised negative questions (Яагаад утсаа авахгүй байгаа юм бэ? Чи мессеж уншаагүй юм уу?) / EN Why don't you...? / Why didn't you...? and surprised Can't you...?

breaking up, comforting a heartbroken friend; breakup vocabulary (салах, хаях, сэтгэл шархлах, мартах); MN negative questions as suggestions and comfort (Найзуудтайгаа гадуур гарахгүй юу? Чи түүнийг мартаагүй юу?) / EN Why don't you...? suggestions and answering negative questions correctly (Yes, I have / No, I haven't)

apologizing, making up and getting back together; reconciliation vocabulary (эвлэрэх, уучлалт гуйх, дахин итгэх, хоёр дахь боломж); MN review of -хгүй юу, -аагүй юу and polite -ж болохгүй юу requests / EN review of negative questions plus tag-like Won't you...? / Wouldn't it be better...?

units.scope: running a guanz or shop, siblings as partners, handing over; small-business terms; -ын тусламжтайгаар, -ыг ашиглан; EN: Would you mind + -ing, Do you mind if...?

lessons.focus: describing a family-run guanz or shop and who does what; small-business basics (эзэн, ажилтан, орлого, зардал, хөрөнгө); -ын тусламжтайгаар for help from people (ахынхаа тусламжтайгаар нээсэн); EN: Would you mind + -ing for simple requests

brothers and sisters splitting roles, shares and profits; partnership terms (хамтрагч, хувь эзэмших, ашиг хуваах, хариуцлага); -ын тусламжтайгаар with institutions and loans (банкны зээлийн тусламжтайгаар); EN: Would you mind + -ing vs Would you mind not + -ing

ordering meat, flour and stock and checking deliveries; supply terms (нийлүүлэгч, нөөц, захиалга, нэхэмжлэх, падаан); -ыг ашиглан with tools and resources (QPay-г ашиглан төлөх); EN: Do you mind if I + present simple when asking permission

parents retiring and passing the shop to the next generation; succession terms (шилжүүлэх, залгамжлах, туршлага, үнэ цэнэ, бүртгэл); review of -ын тусламжтайгаар and -ыг ашиглан in longer speech; EN: review of polite Would you mind / Do you mind requests in a family meeting

a university ethics seminar on unfair hiring algorithms and deepfakes; AI ethics terms (ялгаварлал, ил тод байдал, хувийн мэдээлэл, хариуцлага); contrasting -аас үүдэн, -аас шалтгаалан and -аас үүдэлтэй; EN: was to / were to for unlikely future events

an HR manager and employees planning reskilling and new career paths; skills and labor-market terms (ур чадвар, давтан сургах, шинэ мэргэжил, хөдөлмөрийн зах зээл); causal origin forms in reports and plans; EN: What if AI were to create more jobs than it destroys?

a public debate on Mongolia's workforce, mining automation and the future economy; review of all unit vocabulary in formal argument; all three causal origin forms in extended speech; EN: were to/was to in formal hypotheses and counterarguments

units.scope: NGOs, donations, fundraising, helping ger-district families; philanthropy terms; хичнээн ... ч concessive; EN: the + adjective for groups (the poor, the elderly)

lessons.focus: discussing vulnerable groups in Ulaanbaatar and the countryside; social groups (өнчин хүүхэд, ахмад настан, хөгжлийн бэрхшээлтэй иргэд, өрх толгойлсон эх); EN: the + adjective for groups (the poor, the elderly, the homeless) with plural verb agreement

a volunteer's first day at a local NGO; philanthropy and NGO terms (ТББ, сайн дурын ажилтан, хандив, буяны байгууллага, санхүүжилт); introducing хичнээн ... ч concessive with nouns and adjectives (хичнээн хэцүү ч, хичнээн цөөн хүн ч)

planning a fundraising campaign with charity concerts and online QPay donations; fundraising terms (аян зохион байгуулах, хандивлагч, зорилтот дүн, ил тод тайлан); хичнээн ... -сан ч / -вал ч with verbs (хичнээн их мөнгө цуглуулсан ч хүрэлцэхгүй); EN: no matter how much / however much + clause

delivering coal, warm clothes and food to ger-district families before winter; aid and living-conditions terms (түлш, дулаан хувцас, хүнсний багц, амьжиргааны түвшин, айл өрх); хичнээн ... ч with хэчнээн and extent (хичнээн хүйтэн байсан ч тэд найдвараа алдаагүй); EN: the + adjective in fixed pairs (the rich and the poor, the young and the old)

lessons.title_mn: Буяны үйлс үнэхээр тус болдог уу?
lessons.focus: debating dependency, transparency and long-term development versus one-off gifts; evaluation terms (урт хугацааны нөлөө, хараат байдал, итгэлцэл, нийгмийн хариуцлага, тогтвортой хөгжил); contrasting хичнээн ... ч with хэдийгээр ... ч and -сан ч in argument; EN: the + adjective for abstract qualities and nationalities (the unknown, the Mongolian) vs groups

a successful entrepreneur's speech funding a school library in her home soum; giving-back and legacy terms (нутаг усандаа тус болох, тэтгэлэг, буцааж өгөх, сангийн байгууллага, ач тус); consolidating хичнээн ... ч in emotive and formal speech (хичнээн хол явсан ч нутгаа мартдаггүй); EN: review of the + adjective in formal and rhetorical English (to serve the needy, a voice for the voiceless)

units.scope: Bogd Khan Uul, Otgontenger, climbing, taboo names for peaks; sacred landscape terms; resultative -аастай/-ээстэй (бичээстэй, өлгөөстэй); EN: noun + infinitive (the first to climb, the last to leave)

lessons.focus: Hiking Bogd Khan Uul from Zaisan and learning why it is protected; sacred landscape terms (тахилгат уул, дархан цаазат газар, овоо, хадаг); MN: resultative -аастай/-ээстэй for states left by an action (хадаг уяастай мод, чулуу овоолоостой); EN: the first/oldest + to-infinitive (the first protected area in the world)

Why people say Хайрхан or Өндөр instead of a peak's real name; taboo and respectful naming terms (цээр, хүндэтгэлийн нэр, хайрхан, нэрийг нь хэлэхгүй); MN: -аастай/-ээстэй in descriptions of marked places (нэр бичээстэй самбар, хадаг өлгөөстэй мөчир); EN: noun + infinitive with only/last (the only word to use, the last name to mention)

lessons.title_en: Otgontenger: A Climb Not for Everyone
lessons.title_mn: Отгонтэнгэр: хүн бүхний авирах оргил биш
lessons.focus: Planning a trip to Otgontenger in Zavkhan and its climbing restrictions; climbing and permit terms (оргил, мөсөн гол, авиралтын зөвшөөрөл, хориотой бүс); MN: -аастай/-ээстэй vs -сан for resulting states (тэмдэг хадаастай байна vs тэмдэг хадсан); EN: the first/second/next to + infinitive (the first team to reach the summit)

Circling an ovoo, making offerings and taking part in a state mountain worship ceremony; ritual vocabulary (тахилга, сүү өргөх, нар зөв тойрох, ёслол); MN: -аастай/-ээстэй with ritual objects (сүү цацаастай чулуу, хийморийн мод босгоостой); EN: superlative + noun + infinitive (the youngest person to take part, the last to leave the ceremony)

Arguing over tourism, litter and mining near sacred peaks; conservation and belief terms (байгаль хамгаалал, ариун газар, бохирдол, хууль бус олборлолт); MN: -аастай/-ээстэй in notices and reports (анхааруулга бичээстэй самбар, зам хаагаастай); EN: noun + infinitive for purpose and obligation (a place to protect, rules to follow, no reason to climb)

Telling and writing a reflective account of a sacred mountain journey; mixed review of sacred landscape, taboo and climbing vocabulary; MN: -аастай/-ээстэй combined with narrative past in description; EN: noun + infinitive in narration (she was the first to notice, the last to come down)

units.scope: Gandan, the 1930s purges, revival after 1990; religious history terms; certainty forms -сан нь тодорхой, -сан нь гарцаагүй; EN: time reference phrases (by then, ever since, from then on)

lessons.focus: visiting Gandan monastery, prayer wheels and the Migjid Janraisig temple; monastery and worship terms (хийд, сүм, лам, хурал, мани хүрд); -сан нь тодорхой for well-established facts; EN: ever since + clause

monastic life in the 1920s, the number of lamas and monasteries; religious history terms (шавь, хутагт, номын сургууль, лам нарын тоо); -сан нь гарцаагүй for strong historical certainty; EN: by then, by that time

a museum exhibit on the destruction of monasteries and the execution of lamas; repression terms (хэлмэгдүүлэлт, баривчлах, буудан хороох, нураах, цагаатгах); contrasting -сан нь тодорхой with -сан бололтой for proven vs presumed facts; EN: from then on, thereafter

families who buried sutras and statues, rediscovered relics; heritage objects (судар, бурхан шүтээн, тангад бичиг, хадгалах, илрүүлэх); -сан нь гарцаагүй байх with inference from evidence; EN: until then, up to that point, at the time

reopening and rebuilding monasteries like Amarbayasgalant, young novices, freedom of worship; revival terms (сэргээн босгох, шашин шүтэх эрх чөлөө, бандь, сэргэн мандалт); -снаас хойш combined with -х нь тодорхой for current and future certainty; EN: since then, ever since, so far

a panel discussion on memory, responsibility, and religion's role today; historiography and evaluation terms (түүхэн үнэн, гэрч, архивын баримт, дурсгал); hedged vs certain claims (-сан нь тодорхой, -сан нь гарцаагүй, -сан байж магадгүй); EN: time reference phrases in argument (in those days, from that point onward, to this day)

units.scope: sorting trash, plastic bags, repairing vs throwing away, refill shops; waste terms; -хдаа/-хдээ and -хаараа/-хээрээ; EN: even if vs even though

lessons.title_en: Which Bin Does This Go In?
lessons.focus: sorting trash at an apartment building's bins; waste types (хуванцар, цаас, шил, хүнсний хог, ангилах); -хдаа/-хдээ for 'when doing X' (хог хаяхдаа ангилаарай); EN: even though for real facts

shopping with cloth bags at a supermarket or Mercury market; bags and packaging (гялгар уут, даавуун цүнх, сав баглаа боодол); -хаараа/-хээрээ for 'when/once someone does X' (дэлгүүр орохоороо уут авчирдаг); EN: even if for hypothetical situations

deciding whether to repair a broken kettle, shoes, or phone; repair and disposal verbs (засвар, солих, хуучирсан, ашиглах хугацаа); contrast between -хдаа (during an action) and -хаараа (when it happens, often habitual or causal); EN: even if vs even though in repair decisions

buying shampoo, oil, and grains by weight at a refill shop in Ulaanbaatar; containers and measures (сав, дүүргэх, жинлэх, дахин ашиглах); -хдаа with the subject's own actions (сав авчрахдаа хямд авна); EN: even though + contrast with although

garbage trucks, burned trash, and khoroo cleanup days; collection and pollution terms (хог тээврийн машин, хогийн цэг, шатаах, бохирдол); -хаараа/-хээрээ for consequences (хог шатаахаараа агаар бохирдоно); EN: even if + negative conditions (even if the truck doesn't come)

a family's month-long zero-waste challenge and what they learned; review of recycling vocabulary (дахин боловсруулах, бууруулах, хэмнэх); combined review of -хдаа/-хдээ and -хаараа/-хээрээ in narration; EN: choosing between even if and even though

units.scope: assembling furniture, small fixes, video tutorials, asking for a hand; tool terms; reflexive pronouns өөрөө, өөрийгөө, өөрийн, өөрсдөө; EN: by myself, on my own, help yourself

lessons.focus: assembling a new shelf or wardrobe at home; furniture parts and tool terms (халив, алх, шураг, боолт, заавар); MN өөрөө as emphatic 'myself/by oneself' (би өөрөө угсарна); EN by myself, on my own

following a YouTube repair tutorial step by step; tutorial and instruction vocabulary (алхам, түр зогсоох, дахин үзэх, хэмжих); MN өөрийгөө as reflexive object (өөрийгөө сургах, өөрийгөө шалгах); EN reflexive pronouns teach yourself, cut yourself

fixing a dripping tap, a loose door handle, a broken socket; household repair terms (цорго, бариул, залгуур, түлхүүр, соронзон хэмжүүр); MN өөрийн as 'one's own' (өөрийн багаж, өөрийн гараар); EN of my own, my own + noun

lessons.title_en: Can You Give Me a Hand?
lessons.focus: asking a neighbor or friend to help hold, lift or lend a drill; requesting and offering help vocabulary (барьж өгөх, өргөх, өрөм, шат); MN өөрсдөө for plural subjects (бид өөрсдөө хийчихье, тэд өөрсдөө); EN ourselves/themselves, do it ourselves

a work break during a group fix-up, offering tea and snacks; hospitality and break phrases; MN reflexive possessive with өөрийн/өөрөө in polite offers (өөрөө аваад уугаарай); EN help yourself, make yourself at home, enjoy yourselves

lessons.title_mn: Өөрөө хийсэн бүтээл: амжилт ба алдаа
lessons.focus: telling the story of a DIY project that went wrong or right; project and mistake vocabulary (буруу угсрах, дахин хийх, мэргэжлийн засварчин дуудах); MN contrasting өөрөө, өөрийгөө, өөрийн, өөрсдөө in one narrative; EN by myself vs myself vs on my own review

units.scope: saddling up, riding through valleys, crossing rivers and passes; riding terms; path forms дундуур, дээгүүр, доогуур, хажуугаар, -ыг гатлах; EN: prepositions of movement (across, through, along, over)

lessons.focus: meeting the horse guide and preparing horses at a herder's camp; horse gear (эмээл, хазаар, жолоо, дөрөө, ташуур, морь унах); EN: get on/off, up/down vs MN: -ын дээр/доор vs дээгүүр/доогуур (static place vs movement)
riding through valleys, forests and herds; landscape and pace terms (хөндий, ой, шогшоо, хатираа, гүйлгэх); MN: дундуур for moving through; EN: through vs across
following a riverbank and passing gers and camps; riverside terms (эрэг, бургас, хадан цохио, жим); MN: хажуугаар, -ын дагуу; EN: along, past, by
finding a shallow ford and crossing safely; water and safety terms (гүехэн, гүн, урсгал, гарам, норох); MN: -ыг гатлах, -ыг гатлан гарах; EN: across, into, out of
climbing a mountain pass, stopping at the ovoo, riding down; mountain terms (даваа, уул, энгэр, хад, огцом); MN: дээгүүр, доогуур, -ыг давах; EN: over, up, down, under

retelling the whole route at the evening camp; review of riding and route vocabulary; MN: combining дундуур, дээгүүр, доогуур, хажуугаар, -ыг гатлах in narration; EN: mixed prepositions of movement (across, through, along, over, past)

units.scope: tech support, utility bills, polite complaint calls, follow-ups; service terms; softeners -х гэсэн юм, -ж болох болов уу; EN: distancing past (I was wondering if, I was hoping you could)

lessons.focus: calling a hotline, menus and hold times (дугаар дарах, оператор, хүлээлгэнд байх); opening a call with the softener -х гэсэн юм (асуух гэсэн юм); EN: I was wondering if...
tech support for internet, routers and apps (рүүтер, сүлжээ, дахин асаах, тасрах); describing problems politely with -ж болох болов уу (шалгаж болох болов уу); EN: I was hoping you could...

lessons.title_mn: Төлбөрийн баримт буруу байх шиг байна
lessons.focus: electricity, heating and water bills (тоолуур, өр, нэхэмжлэх, илүү бодогдох); combining -х гэсэн юм with reasons in polite complaints; EN: distancing past with want/need (I wanted to ask about...)

complaining about poor service and asking for compensation (гомдол, буцаан олгох, хохирол, менежер); softened requests -ж өгч болох болов уу; EN: I was hoping to speak to..., Would it be possible to...

follow-up calls about unresolved tickets (хүсэлтийн дугаар, шийдвэрлэх, мэдэгдэх, хугацаа); softened reminders -сан юм аа, -ж болох болов уу; EN: I was just calling to check whether..., I was told that...

full service calls from start to finish, confirming solutions and thanking (баталгаажуулах, санал хүсэлт, үнэлгээ); review of -х гэсэн юм and -ж болох болов уу in context; EN: review of distancing past and closing a call politely

units.scope: temperament, subtle character portraits, first impressions; character terms; adjective suffixes -лаг/-лэг, -саг/-сэг, -мхай/-мхий; EN: verb + object + -ing (I can't imagine him lying)

lessons.focus: Meeting a new colleague and describing your first impression; temperament words (даруу, цэгцтэй, ухаалаг, хөгжилтэй); adjectives in -лаг/-лэг (ухаалаг, эрүүл саруул → хүмүүжилтэй vs хүмүүжлэг) / EN: verb + object + -ing (I noticed her smiling, I remember him arguing)

Discussing whether character is inborn or learned, family resemblances; temperament terms (догшин, тайван, түргэн зантай, зөөлөн); -саг/-сэг adjectives (ажилсаг, мэдрэмтгий vs эвсэг, хүнсэг) / EN: can't imagine / can't picture + object + -ing

Gossiping about difficult people at work and home; negative traits (худалч, хов жив, хамаагүй, ааш муутай); -мхай/-мхий adjectives (худалдамхай, мартамхай, уурламхай, аймхай) / EN: hate/can't stand/don't mind + object + -ing

Writing a subtle portrait of a grandparent or teacher; nuanced traits (ухаантай боловч бардам, дотогшоо, шулуун шударга); contrasting -лаг/-саг/-мхай forms with -тай/-гүй (ухаалаг vs ухаантай) / EN: picture/recall/remember + object + -ing in descriptive writing

Realizing your first impression was wrong about a neighbor; perception and judgment words (өнгөц, гаднаа, дотроо, буруу ойлгох); hedged trait descriptions with -мхай/-мхий + юм шиг, -лаг байх / EN: catch/find/leave + object + -ing (I caught him helping, found her crying)

Comparing candidates' personalities for a team; workplace character terms (хариуцлагатай, санаачлагатай, хамтач, тэвчээртэй); combining -лаг/-лэг, -саг/-сэг, -мхай/-мхий in evaluations / EN: object + -ing with possessive vs object (I can't imagine him/his lying), resent/appreciate + object + -ing

units.scope: petitions, demonstrations on Sükhbaatar Square, citizen journalism; civic terms; complement clauses with гэдгийг, гэдэг нь; EN: anticipatory it (it remains to be seen whether)

lessons.focus: collecting signatures online and on the street for a park near a ger district; petition terms (өргөдөл, гарын үсэг, иргэдийн санаачилга, шаардлага); MN: complement clause -сан/-х гэдгийг мэдэх/ойлгох; EN: anticipatory it with adjectives (It is important that..., It is clear that...)

planning and joining a peaceful demonstration, permits from the city; protest terms (жагсаал, цуглаан, зөвшөөрөл, уриа лоозон, тайван); MN: гэдэг нь as subject clause (Бид энд байгаа гэдэг нь...); EN: anticipatory it with verbs (It seems that, It turns out that)

citizen journalism, live streams and eyewitness posts; media terms (иргэний сэтгүүлч, шууд дамжуулалт, гэрч, баримт бичлэг); MN: гэдгийг with reporting verbs (харуулах, батлах, нотлох); EN: it + passive reporting (It was reported that, It has been confirmed that)

writing demands and an open letter to officials about air pollution; civic terms (шаардах, хариуцлага, ил тод байдал, нээлттэй захидал); MN: гэдэг нь in definitions and emphasis (Гол асуудал гэдэг нь ...); EN: it + noun phrase (It's a shame that, It's no surprise that)

assessing outcomes after protests, the government's response, public debate; result terms (хариу арга хэмжээ, нөлөө, хууль өөрчлөх, амлалт); MN: -х эсэх гэдгийг and гэдэг нь эргэлзээтэй; EN: it remains to be seen whether, it is uncertain whether/if

discussing freedom of assembly, the 1990 hunger strike legacy and youth activism; rights terms (жагсаал цуглаан хийх эрх чөлөө, үндсэн хууль, идэвхтэн, иргэний нийгэм); MN: combining гэдгийг and гэдэг нь in argued paragraphs; EN: it + to-infinitive and it + -ing (It's worth remembering, It's up to us to...) review

units.scope: transit through Russia and China, sea ports, rail corridors, logistics; transport-economy terms; -ыг дамжин, -аар дамжуулан; EN: advanced comparatives (nowhere near as, twice as... as, by far)

lessons.focus: a geography lecture on Mongolia's landlocked position; borders, transit, sea access terms (далайд гарцгүй, хил залгаа, транзит); -ыг дамжин for routes passing through places (Хятадыг дамжин далайд гарах); EN: nowhere near as / not nearly as

a freight forwarder explains how cargo reaches the sea; port, container, freight, shipping terms (боомт, чингэлэг, ачаа тээвэр, далайн тээвэр); -аар дамжуулан for channels and intermediaries (боомтоор дамжуулан, зуучлагчаар дамжуулан); EN: twice as... as, three times as... as

a briefing on Trans-Mongolian and new southern rail lines; rail logistics terms (цариг, ачаа шилжүүлэх, коридор, нүүрсний вагон); contrasting -ыг дамжин and -аар дамжуулан in route descriptions; EN: by far + superlative, far and away

logistics managers discuss border queues and transport costs; supply-chain economy terms (тээврийн зардал, саатал, дамжлагын хураамж, ложистик); -ыг дамжин/-аар дамжуулан in cause and cost chains; EN: considerably/significantly/marginally + comparative, much less, even more

a policy roundtable on transit agreements and the economic corridor with Russia and China; agreement and negotiation terms (транзит тээврийн хэлэлцээр, эдийн засгийн коридор, хамаарал, олон тулгуурт); formal -аар дамжуулан for means and mechanisms (хэлэлцээрээр дамжуулан); EN: the + comparative, the + comparative; no less/no more than

lessons.title_mn: Далайд гарцгүй орон хөгжиж чадах уу?
lessons.focus: an essay and debate comparing Mongolia with Switzerland, Kazakhstan and Laos; reviewing transport-economy vocabulary; integrating -ыг дамжин and -аар дамжуулан in argument; EN: mixing advanced comparatives (nowhere near as, by far, twice as) in persuasive writing

units.scope: justice reform, rehabilitation, amnesty, life after release; penal terms; аль аль нь, хэн хэн нь, аль нэг нь; EN: concessive much as, while, albeit

lessons.focus: A radio report on a detention center and a prison in Mongolia; penal terms (хорих анги, ялтан, хорих ял, цагдан хорих, шүүх, ял эдлэх); аль аль нь for 'both' (хоёр байгууллага аль аль нь хэт дүүрсэн); EN: concessive while (While prisons are overcrowded, ...)

Visiting a prison workshop with sewing, carpentry and classes; rehabilitation terms (нийгэмшүүлэх, мэргэжлийн сургалт, хөдөлмөр эрхлэлт, сэтгэл зүйч); хэн хэн нь for 'each and every one / all of them' (хэн хэн нь гэрчилгээ авсан); EN: albeit (a small, albeit growing, program)

A TV debate on an amnesty law; legal and political terms (өршөөл, ялаас чөлөөлөх, хугацаанаас өмнө суллах, хүнд гэмт хэрэг, хохирогч); аль нэг нь for 'one of them / either' (аль нэг тал нь буулт хийх ёстой); EN: much as (Much as I support amnesty, ...)

A man leaving prison meets his family and a probation officer; release and reintegration terms (суллагдах, тэнсэн харгалзах, хяналтын байцаагч, бүртгүүлэх, ял шийтгэлтэй байсан); contrasting аль аль нь, хэн хэн нь and аль нэг нь in family talk; EN: while vs whereas for contrast

lessons.title_en: Looking for a Job with a Record
lessons.focus: Job interviews and an employer's dilemma about a criminal record; employment and stigma terms (ялын тодорхойлолт, гадуурхалт, итгэл олох, дахин гэмт хэрэг үйлдэх, ялгаварлан гадуурхах); negated аль нь ч / хэн нь ч vs хэн хэн нь (хэн нь ч ажилд аваагүй); EN: albeit and while in balanced statements

lessons.title_en: Do People Deserve a Second Chance?
lessons.focus: Writing an opinion essay on justice reform and restorative justice; reform terms (шүүхийн шинэчлэл, нөхөн төлбөр, эвлэрүүлэн зуучлал, урьдчилан сэргийлэх); combining аль аль нь, хэн хэн нь and аль нэг нь in formal argument; EN: review of much as, while and albeit in academic writing

units.title_en: At the Dentist and the Optician
units.scope: toothaches, fillings, braces, eye tests, choosing glasses; dental and eye-care terms; frequency and multipliers өдөрт гурван удаа, хоёр дахин, -дахь удаагаа; EN: adverb position (frequency and mid-position adverbs)

lessons.focus: booking an urgent dental visit and describing a toothache; tooth and mouth terms (араа шүд, буйл, мэдрэг, хавдах); frequency with -д/-т + удаа (өдөрт хоёр удаа, долоо хоногт нэг удаа) / EN: frequency adverbs before main verbs and after be (It always hurts, I'm never late)

getting a filling and following the dentist's instructions; treatment terms (ломбо, цоорол, мэдээ алдуулах, шүд авах); ordinal visits -дахь удаагаа (хоёр дахь удаагаа ломбо тавиулж байна) / EN: mid-position adverbs with auxiliaries and modals (I have already had..., You should usually...)

a teenager getting braces and a cleaning schedule; orthodontic and hygiene terms (шүдний аппарат, шүдний утас, шүдний чулуу, цайруулах); multipliers хоёр дахин, гурав дахин үнэтэй/удаан / EN: adverbs of definite frequency at the end of the clause (twice a day, every six months) vs mid-position

lessons.title_en: Can You Read the Bottom Line?
lessons.focus: taking an eye test at the optician; vision terms (хараа муудах, ойрын/холын хараа, бүдэг, нүдний дусал); combining frequency and duration (хоёр жилд нэг удаа, өдөрт хэдэн цаг дэлгэц харах) / EN: position of only, just, even, also and their effect on meaning

picking frames, lenses and contact lenses at an optical shop; eyewear terms (хүрээ, линз, контакт линз, цэнхэр гэрлийн шүүлтүүр); comparing with multipliers and ordinal times (хоёр дахин хөнгөн, анх удаагаа шил зүүх) / EN: degree and focus adverbs in mid-position (really, hardly, almost, definitely) and with negatives (I definitely don't vs I don't definitely)

giving family advice on daily dental and eye care, review; prevention vocabulary (урьдчилан сэргийлэх, үзлэгт хамрагдах, чихэр багасгах); review of өдөрт гурван удаа, хоёр дахин, -дахь удаагаа in longer advice texts / EN: review of adverb position, including sentence-initial adverbs for emphasis (Sometimes..., Usually...)

units.scope: working from home, freelance gigs, invoices, coworking spaces in UB, time zones; freelance terms; arrangement forms -хаар болсон, -хаар шийдсэн; EN: stative verbs in continuous forms (I'm thinking of, she's being difficult)

lessons.focus: describing a home-office day in a UB apartment; remote work terms (алсаас ажиллах, интернэт тасрах, видео уулзалт); MN: -хаар болсон for arrangements decided by others (гэрээсээ ажиллахаар болсон); EN: contrast state vs activity: I have a laptop / I'm having a meeting

finding projects on platforms and through friends; freelance terms (захиалагч, төсөл, хугацаа, үнийн санал); MN: -хаар шийдсэн for one's own decisions (бие даан ажиллахаар шийдсэн); EN: I'm thinking of + -ing vs I think that

sending invoices, late payments, polite reminders; payment terms (нэхэмжлэх, урьдчилгаа, татвар, данс); MN: -хаар тохиролцсон vs -хаар болсон for agreed terms; EN: stative verbs with changed meaning: it costs / we're costing the project, I see / I'm seeing a client

lessons.title_en: A Desk at a Coworking Space
lessons.focus: renting a desk at a UB coworking space, meeting other freelancers; coworking terms (гишүүнчлэл, хурлын өрөө, сарын төлбөр); MN: negative arrangements -хгүй байхаар шийдсэн, -хаар болоогүй; EN: feel, look, smell in simple vs continuous (the place looks great / I'm looking at desks)

scheduling calls with clients in Europe and the US, late-night meetings; time zone terms (цагийн зөрүү, цагийн бүс, хуваарь); MN: -хаар болсон with time expressions (маргааш оройн 10 цагт ярихаар болсон); EN: be + adjective for temporary behavior (the client is being difficult / unreasonable)

discussing pros and cons of freelance life, burnout and balance; work-life vocabulary (ажил амьдралын тэнцвэр, тогтмол бус орлого, ганцаардал); MN: review -хаар болсон vs -хаар шийдсэн in telling one's career story; EN: review of stative verbs in continuous forms (I'm loving it, I'm wanting a change, I'm being careful)

units.scope: karaoke rooms, birthday nights out, late taxis, getting home safely; nightlife vocabulary; collective action -цгаа- in all tenses (ирцгээсэн, бүжиглэцгээв); EN: stranded prepositions (Who did you go with?)

lessons.title_mn: Өнөө орой хэн хэн ирэх вэ?
lessons.focus: planning a birthday night out in a group chat; party and invitation words (төрсөн өдөр, найзууд, цуглах, урих); -цгаа- with present-future and voluntative (ирцгээнэ, явцгаая); EN: stranded prepositions in simple questions (Who are you going with? What's it for?)

calling a karaoke place to reserve a room; karaoke vocabulary (өрөө, цаг, микрофон, дуу сонгох, багц үнэ); -цгаа- with intention and progressive (дуулцгаах гэж байна, хүлээцгээж байна); EN: prepositions at the end of Wh- questions (What time is it booked for? How many people is it for?)

telling friends about last night's karaoke and dancing; song and performance words (хит дуу, хамтдаа дуулах, алга ташилт, бүжиглэх); -цгаа- in the past tenses (дуулцгаасан, бүжиглэцгээв, инээлдэцгээлээ); EN: stranded prepositions with phrasal and prepositional verbs (the song we danced to, who she was talking to)

finding a ride home after midnight in Ulaanbaatar; taxi and ride-hailing words (такси дуудах, апп, хаяг, үнэ тохирох, зогсоол); -цгаа- with converbs and imperatives (суугаад явцгаа, буцгаагаарай); EN: stranded prepositions in relative clauses (the street I live on, the driver we paid)

getting home safely and checking on friends; safety words (аюулгүй, байршил хуваалцах, ганцаараа, дагуулж хүргэх); negated and habitual -цгаа- (явцгаадаггүй, хүргэцгээдэг); EN: stranded prepositions in passives and infinitives (She needs someone to walk home with; Has he been taken care of?)

piecing together the night out in a group chat the next day; review of nightlife vocabulary plus losing things and paying back (төлбөр хуваах, мартаж орхих); mixed review of -цгаа- across tenses; EN: review of stranded prepositions vs formal fronted prepositions (Who did you leave with? / With whom did you leave?)

units.scope: public libraries, book clubs, e-books, the UB book fair; reading and publishing terms; range forms -аас эхлээд ... хүртэл, -аас авахуулаад; EN: like vs as

lessons.focus: registering at the Central Public Library in Ulaanbaatar; library terms (уншлагын танхим, зээлэх, буцаах, хугацаа сунгах); range -аас ... хүртэл for opening hours and loan periods; EN: like + noun for similarity (It looks like a museum)

lessons.title_en: What Do You Like to Read?
lessons.title_mn: Та ямар ном унших дуртай вэ?
lessons.focus: talking about reading habits and favorite genres; genre vocabulary (уран зохиол, намтар, яруу найраг, детектив); -аас эхлээд ... хүртэл listing a range of genres or authors; EN: like vs such as for giving examples

lessons.title_mn: Манай номын клуб өнөө орой цугларна
lessons.focus: discussing a novel at a café book club; discussion terms (гол дүр, үйл явдал, зохиолч, бүлэг); -аас авахуулаад for 'starting from... and including' (characters, plot, ending); EN: as + subject + verb vs like (as I said, as you know)

lessons.title_mn: Цаасан ном уу, цахим ном уу?
lessons.focus: comparing e-books, audiobooks and printed books; device and format terms (цахим ном, аудио ном, уншигч төхөөрөмж, татаж авах); -аас эхлээд ... хүртэл contrasting ranges of price, size and storage; EN: as for roles and functions (I use my phone as an e-reader) vs like for comparison

browsing stalls, meeting authors and getting signed copies at the book fair; publishing terms (хэвлэлийн газар, шинэ хэвлэл, хөнгөлөлт, гарын үсэг зурах); -аас авахуулаад for wide-ranging offers (children's books to classics); EN: as if/as though vs like in informal speech (It felt like a festival)

lessons.title_mn: Ном унших нь яагаад чухал хэвээр байна вэ
