lessons.focus: a short talk or opinion piece on reading habits in Mongolia, from rural mobile libraries to young readers online; reading-culture terms (уншлагын соёл, хэвлэн нийтлэх, уншигч, номын сан хөгжүүлэх); review of -аас эхлээд ... хүртэл and -аас авахуулаад in longer texts; EN: review of like vs as (as a librarian, just as/just like, as usual)

units.title_mn: Үг хэлэх эрх чөлөө ба цензур
units.scope: press freedom, defamation cases, online speech, self-censorship; media-law terms; opposition postpositions -ын эсрэг, -ыг эсэргүүцэн, -ын өмнөөс; EN: headline language (dropped articles, to + infinitive for future)

lessons.focus: scanning news headlines about press freedom; journalism and freedom-of-expression terms (үг хэлэх эрх чөлөө, хэвлэлийн эрх чөлөө, сэтгүүлч); EN headline language: dropped articles and auxiliaries, present simple for past events
a journalists' union statement against a restrictive draft law; protest and media-law vocabulary (хууль тогтоомж, хязгаарлалт, хяналт); MN -ын эсрэг and -ыг эсэргүүцэн for opposing laws and decisions
following a defamation case between a politician and a news site; legal terms (гүтгэлэг, нэр төр, нэхэмжлэл, торгууль); EN headline to + infinitive for future and is to (Court to rule on...)

lessons.title_mn: Бусдын өмнөөс дуу хоолой болох нь
lessons.focus: lawyers and NGOs defending detained bloggers and silenced sources; advocacy and representation terms (өмгөөлөгч, эх сурвалж, нууцлал); MN -ын өмнөөс vs -ын төлөө, and -ын эсрэг/-ыг эсэргүүцэн in contrast

online speech: deleted Facebook posts, platform rules, the cyber-law debate; digital speech terms (агуулга устгах, хаалт, үзэн ядалтын яриа); EN headline style for online news: passives without be (Post removed, Account blocked)

reporters and citizens discussing self-censorship and fear of consequences; nuanced vocabulary (өөрийгөө хязгаарлах, айдас, шахалт, шүүмжлэл); review: all three opposition postpositions in debate plus rewriting headlines as full sentences and back

units.scope: herders' children in boarding schools, separation from family, rural education gaps; rural education terms; repeated converbs for prolonged action (хүлээж хүлээж, явж явж); EN: generic reference with a/the/zero article

lessons.focus: a herder family sends a six-year-old to the sum school dormitory in autumn; boarding school terms (дотуур байр, сумын төв, багш, жижүүр, анги дүүргэлт); repeated converbs for prolonged action introduced (явж явж, хүлээж хүлээж) | EN: generic zero article with plural and uncountable nouns (Children need sleep)

a child's first weeks away from parents, homesickness, weekend visits; separation and emotion vocabulary (гэр орноо санах, уйлах, дасах, бэтгэрэх); repeated converbs with emotional duration (уйлж уйлж, санаж санаж ... дасах) | EN: generic a/an for typical members (A child misses its mother)

daily routine, dorm rules, meals, cold rooms and caretakers; dorm life vocabulary (байрны багш, хоолны газар, унтлагын өрөө, халаалт, ариун цэвэр); repeated converbs in routines and endurance (тэвчиж тэвчиж, хичээж хичээж) | EN: generic the + singular noun for species and institutions (The boarding school plays a key role)

comparing rural and city schools, test scores, teacher shortages, dropouts; education gap terms (боловсролын тэгш бус байдал, сургууль завсардах, багшийн хомсдол, суралцах орчин); repeated converbs in explanatory and analytical sentences (хойшилж хойшилж, буурч буурч) | EN: contrasting generic a, the, and zero article in report language

families torn between labor at the khot ail and schooling, boys herding livestock, mothers moving to the sum center; herder household terms (малчин өрх, мал маллах, хот айл, нүүдэл, хүүхдийн хөдөлмөр); repeated converbs in narrated life stories (нүүж нүүж, бодож бодож шийдсэн) | EN: generic the + adjective and plural nouns for social groups (herders, the rural poor)

debating solutions such as ger kindergartens, mobile teachers, online lessons, and dorm reform; policy and reform terms (гэр цэцэрлэг, явуулын багш, зайн сургалт, бодлого, хөрөнгө оруулалт); repeated converbs integrated with formal argument (ярьж ярьж эцэст нь) | EN: mixed review of generic reference in essay writing

units.title_en: National Service and Coming of Age
units.scope: conscription, alternative service fees, army memories, rites of passage; military service terms; duty forms -х учиртай, -х үүрэгтэй; EN: formal obligation (be obliged to, be required to, it falls to)

lessons.focus: receiving a conscription notice and registering at the district military office; conscription terms (цэрэг татлага, цэргийн үүрэг, бүртгэл, эрүүл мэндийн үзлэг); MN -х үүрэгтэй for legal duty; EN be required to / be obliged to

lessons.title_mn: Цэргийн алба хаахын оронд мөнгө төлөх
lessons.focus: family debate over the alternative service fee versus enlisting; fee and exemption terms (мөнгөн төлбөр, чөлөөлөлт, хойшлуулах, оюутны хөнгөлөлт); MN -х учиртай for expected or destined duty; EN be obliged to vs have to, be exempt from

a recent conscript describes routine, drills and discipline; barracks terms (анги, дарга, жагсаал, харуул, цэргийн хувцас); MN contrasting -х ёстой, -х үүрэгтэй and -х учиртай; EN it falls to someone to, be expected to

an older relative recalls service in socialist times; veteran and memory terms (ахмад дайчин, хилийн цэрэг, халагдах, ах дүүгийн холбоо); MN past duty -х учиртай байсан, -х үүрэгтэй байсан; EN was obliged to, were required to, fell to in past narratives

lessons.title_en: Becoming a Man, Becoming an Adult
lessons.title_mn: Эр хүн болох, насанд хүрэх ёс
lessons.focus: discussing rites of passage: first haircut, first horse race, service, the first salary; coming-of-age terms (эр цэрэг, насанд хүрэх, ёс заншил, хариуцлага); MN -х учиртай for social and moral expectations; EN be duty-bound to, it is incumbent on someone to

lessons.title_mn: Цэргийн алба бүх нийтийнх байх ёстой юу?
lessons.focus: a formal debate on conscription, women's service, fairness of fees and civilian alternatives; policy terms (тэгш байдал, иргэний алба, хууль тогтоомж, үүрэг ба эрх); MN -х үүрэгтэй and -х учиртай in formal argument; EN mixed formal obligation (shall, be obliged to, it falls to the state to)

units.title_mn: Мах, цагаан хоол ба өвөрмөц байдал
units.scope: meat-centered diets, vegetarian cafés in UB, health and identity debates; diet and nutrition terms; resemblance forms -тай төстэй, -тай ойролцоо, -д дүйцэх; EN: emphatic structures (the very, itself, of all things)

lessons.title_en: A Country That Runs on Meat
lessons.focus: talking about the traditional meat-and-dairy diet of herders and city families; diet terms (махан хоол, цагаан идээ, улаан идээ, илчлэг, уураг); MN: introducing -тай төстэй for similarities (хонины мах үхрийн махтай төстэй амттай); EN: emphatic 'the very' (the very heart of our cuisine)

ordering at a vegetarian café in UB and comparing dishes to familiar ones; plant-based food terms (цагаан хоол, буурцаг, тофу, ногоон хоол, махны орлуулагч); MN: -тай төстэй vs -тай ойролцоо (махтай ойролцоо амт, бууз шиг төстэй хэлбэр); EN: 'itself' for emphasis (the café itself is tiny, the tofu itself has little taste)

lessons.title_en: Protein, Iron and the Nutrition Debate
lessons.title_mn: Уураг, төмөр ба хоол тэжээлийн маргаан
lessons.focus: a doctor and a nutritionist discussing whether people can get enough nutrients without meat; nutrition terms (шим тэжээл, төмөр, витамин B12, дутагдал, тэнцвэртэй хооллолт); MN: -д дүйцэх for equivalence (нэг аяга сэвэг зарам 100 грамм махны уурагт дүйцнэ); EN: emphatic 'the very' plus superlative (the very best source, the very last thing you need)

lessons.title_en: Telling Your Grandmother You Don't Eat Meat
lessons.focus: family tension over a vegetarian grandchild at Tsagaan Sar and in the countryside; identity and tradition terms (уламжлал, өвөг дээдэс, хүндлэл, харьяалал, гадуурхах); MN: contrasting all three forms (-тай төстэй, -тай ойролцоо, -д дүйцэх) in personal arguments; EN: 'of all things', 'of all people', 'of all days' (She became vegetarian on Tsagaan Sar, of all days!)

lessons.title_mn: Бурхны шашин, ёс зүй ба амьтан идэх
lessons.focus: discussing Buddhist views, animal welfare and herders' respect for livestock; ethics terms (амь хөнөөх, нүгэл, энэрэл, мал аж ахуй, ёс суртахуун); MN: -д дүйцэх in abstract comparisons (энэ нь нүгэлд дүйцэх үйлдэл үү?); EN: combining 'the very', reflexive 'itself' and 'of all things' in reasoned argument

lessons.title_en: Debate: Is Meat Part of Being Mongolian?
lessons.title_mn: Мэтгэлцээн: Мах идэх нь монгол хүний онцлог мөн үү?
lessons.focus: a formal debate on national identity, health, climate and changing diets; review of diet, nutrition and identity vocabulary; MN: all resemblance forms -тай төстэй, -тай ойролцоо, -д дүйцэх in extended argument; EN: all emphatic structures (the very, itself, of all things) in persuasive speech

units.scope: lake trips, fishing, boats, taimen catch-and-release; fishing and lake vocabulary; approximation орчим, гаруй, шахам; EN: countable vs uncountable shifts (a fish/fish, a coffee, chicken)

lessons.title_mn: Хойд зүг рүү аялал төлөвлөх нь
lessons.focus: planning a trip from Ulaanbaatar to Khövsgöl via Mörön; travel distances, durations and costs; approximation with орчим (700 км орчим, 12 цаг орчим); EN: uncountable nouns made countable (a piece of luggage, two bags of food)

checking into a ger camp on the lakeshore; lake and shore vocabulary (эрэг, давалгаа, тунгалаг ус, арал); гаруй for 'more than' (мянга гаруй жил, хорь гаруй гэр); EN: countable vs uncountable shifts with materials and places (a stone/stone, a wood/wood)

renting a boat and a boat tour to the islands; boat and safety vocabulary (завь, сэлүүр, аврах хантааз, хөлөг онгоц); шахам for 'almost/nearly' (хоёр цаг шахам, хагас шахам дүүрсэн); EN: a coffee / coffee, a tea / tea when ordering on board

a local guide teaching fishing; fishing gear and fish species (дэгээ, загасны саваа, өгөөш, хадран, цурхай); combining орчим, гаруй, шахам to estimate size and weight; EN: fish as plural, fishes for species, a fish vs fish as food

rules for protecting the taimen, licenses and catch-and-release; conservation and fishing-rule vocabulary (зөвшөөрөл, суллах, ховордсон, торгууль); approximations in rules and facts (метр шахам урт, тавин гаруй жил амьдардаг); EN: chicken/a chicken, lamb/a lamb: animal vs meat

retelling the trip and exaggerating fish stories around the fire; review of lake, boat and fishing vocabulary; approximation орчим, гаруй, шахам in narrative and boasting; EN: review of countable/uncountable shifts (a fish/fish, a coffee, chicken, a light/light)

units.scope: assembling and taking down a ger, seasonal moves; ger parts (тооно, унь, хана, багана); spatial postpositions дээр, доор, дотор, гадна, цаана, наана with cases; EN: separable vs inseparable phrasal verbs (put it up, take it down)

lessons.focus: a herder family shows a guest around their ger; ger parts тооно, унь, хана, багана, хаалга, туурга, эсгий, бүслүүр; дээр, доор, дотор with genitive (тооны доор, гэрийн дотор) and EN phrasal verbs as a concept (put up, take down)

lessons.title_en: Laying the Floor and Raising the Walls
lessons.focus: first steps of assembling a ger in summer pasture; хана дэлгэх, хаалга босгох, шал тавих, газар тэгшлэх; locative and ablative with postpositions (хананы дотор, хаалганы гаднаас) and EN separable phrasal verbs with noun objects (set up the walls / set the walls up)

lifting the crown and fitting roof poles with neighbors' help; тооно өргөх, унь хатгах, багана тулах, уяа татах; цаана and наана with directional and ablative endings (баганын цаана, галын наагуур) and EN separable phrasal verbs with pronouns (lift it up, not lift up it)

covering the frame against wind and cold; эсгий, бүрээс, өрх, хаяавч, дээвэр, бүслүүр чангалах; дээгүүр, доогуур, гаднуур with movement (эсгийн дээгүүр бүрээс нөмрөх) and EN inseparable phrasal verbs (look after, go over, run into)

taking down and packing the ger for a move; гэр буулгах, ачих, боох, уях, тэрэг/машин; spatial postpositions in sequences with converbs (тоонын доороос унийг гаргаад) and EN mixing separable and inseparable verbs (take it down, pack it up, get on with it)

a family's seasonal move from summer to winter camp; нүүдэл, зуслан, намаржаа, өвөлжөө, хашаа, малын хороо; review of all spatial postpositions with cases in a narrative and EN phrasal verbs review in a retelling (set off, pack up, settle in)

units.scope: the general entrance exam (ЭЕШ), graduation, results, exam stress; exam and school vocabulary; connectives тэгээд, тэгэхээр, тэгвэл, тэгсэн чинь; EN: in time vs on time, at the end vs in the end, at last

lessons.focus: registering for the general entrance exam and choosing subjects; exam and registration vocabulary (бүртгэл, оноо, хичээл сонгох, шалгалтын төв); MN тэгээд for sequencing actions; EN on time vs in time
planning revision with classmates and tutors; study vocabulary (давтлага, тест бөглөх, сорил, цээжлэх); MN тэгэхээр for drawing conclusions; EN in time (to/for) vs on time in study contexts
the morning of the exam, nerves and calming down; stress and feelings vocabulary (сандрах, айх, тайвшрах, хугацаа дуусах); MN тэгвэл for advice and consequences; EN at the end (of) vs in the end
checking scores online and reacting to results; results vocabulary (дүн гарах, босго оноо, тэнцэх, унах); MN тэгсэн чинь for unexpected outcomes; EN at last vs finally vs in the end

school graduation ceremony, teachers, parents and the last bell; graduation vocabulary (төгсөх, гэрчилгээ, сүүлчийн хонх, багшдаа талархах); MN mixing тэгээд and тэгсэн чинь in narration; EN at the end of the ceremony vs in the end, at last

choosing a university or retaking the exam, talking it over with family; university application and future plans vocabulary (их сургууль сонгох, дахин өгөх, мэргэжил, тэтгэлэг); MN review of тэгээд, тэгэхээр, тэгвэл, тэгсэн чинь in discussion; EN review of in time/on time, at the end/in the end, at last

units.scope: dust storms, spring snow, forecast apps, dressing for changes; weather vocabulary; change verbs from adjectives -рах/-рэх (хүйтрэх, дулаарах, сэрүүсэх); EN: double comparatives (colder and colder)

lessons.focus: chatting about the first warm spring days in Ulaanbaatar; temperature and spring weather words (дулаан, хүйтэн, гэсэлт, хайлах); change verbs дулаарах, хүйтрэх in present -ж байна and past -лаа; EN: get warmer / get colder

a sudden spring snowfall that surprises friends and herders; snow and cold-snap vocabulary (нойтон цас, хүйтний эрч, хяруу); -рах/-рэх verbs from more adjectives (сэрүүсэх, харанхуйлах, бүрхэх) with -сан; EN: double comparatives with -er and -er (colder and colder)

a dust storm hits the city and the Gobi; wind and visibility vocabulary (шороон шуурга, салхи ширүүсэх, үзэгдэх орчин); intensifying change verbs (ширүүсэх, хүчтэй болох) with -саар байна; EN: more and more + long adjectives (more and more dangerous)

checking forecast apps and comparing predictions; forecast vocabulary (цаг агаарын мэдээ, хур тунадас, магадлал, градус); change verbs with the future -на and -х төлөвтэй; EN: the comparative + and + comparative for forecasts (it will get windier and windier)

deciding what to wear when the weather keeps changing; layering and outdoor clothing vocabulary (давхар хувцас, малгай, ороолт, нимгэн/зузаан); change verbs in conditionals -вал (хүйтэрвэл, дулаарвал) for advice; EN: less and less / fewer and fewer

telling the story of a trip where the weather changed many times; review of weather vocabulary and expressions; narrating sequences of change with -рах/-рэх verbs and converbs -аад/-ээд, -сээр; EN: review of double comparatives in storytelling

units.scope: the 1939 battles, veterans, memorials, WWII memory; military history terms; plural past participles -гсад/-гсэд (оролцогсод, амь үрэгдэгсэд); EN: passive and perfect infinitives (to be remembered, to have fought)

lessons.focus: reading a museum panel about the start of the Khalkhin Gol battles; front, border, troops, offensive, Soviet-Mongolian forces; plural past participle -гсад/-гсэд introduced (оролцогсод, ирэгсэд) / EN: passive infinitive (is said to be, needs to be explained)

listening to a grandson describe a veteran grandfather; soldier, cavalry, tank, wounded, medal, hero; -гсад/-гсэд as subject and object nouns (оролцогсдыг, шархадсад) / EN: perfect infinitive (is proud to have fought, seems to have served)

a memorial ceremony and laying wreaths; casualties, losses, missing, grave, monument, minute of silence; -гсад/-гсэд with case endings and possessives (амь үрэгдэгсдийн дурсгалд) / EN: passive infinitive in purpose and wishes (deserve to be remembered, want to be honored)

visiting the Khalkhin Gol memorial complex in Dornod; memorial, museum, relic, steppe battlefield, anniversary; -гсад/-гсэд vs -сан хүмүүс in natural speech (зочилсон хүмүүс / зочлогсод) / EN: perfect passive infinitive (is believed to have been built, appears to have been damaged)

lessons.title_en: Khalkhin Gol and World War II
lessons.title_mn: Халх голын тулалдаан ба Дэлхийн II дайн
lessons.focus: a history lecture on the battles' place in WWII; Japan, Manchukuo, ceasefire, consequences, Zhukov, turning point; formal written -гсад/-гсэд in historical prose (байлдагсад, дайчлагдагсад) / EN: perfect infinitive after reporting verbs (is thought to have influenced, is known to have changed)

a panel discussion on teaching war memory to young people; oral history, archive, collective memory, commemoration, reconciliation; combining -гсад/-гсэд with -ын төлөө, -д зориулсан for tributes / EN: passive and perfect infinitives combined in argument (ought to be taught, should have been recorded)

units.scope: old capitals, Silk Road trade, the monastery city, urban history; historical terms; era expressions -ын үед, -ын эрин, -ын тэртээ, эхэн/сүүл үе; EN: quantifying expressions (a great deal of, the bulk of, a handful of)

lessons.focus: visiting Erdene Zuu and the Karakorum ruins with a guide; old capital and ruin terms (нийслэл, туурь, хэрэм, ордон); -ын үед / -ны үед for dating events (Өгэдэй хааны үед)

a museum talk on Silk Road trade through Karakorum; trade and caravan terms (жин, худалдаачин, бараа солилцоо, элч); EN: a great deal of / a large number of vs a handful of with countable and uncountable nouns
comparing Karakorum's founding with other medieval cities; time-span terms (зуун, мянганы, тэртээ, түүхэн эх сурвалж); -ын тэртээ and -ын эрин (найман зууны тэртээ, эзэнт гүрний эрин)

lessons.title_en: Ikh Khüree, the Moving Monastery City
lessons.focus: a documentary on how Örgöö and Ikh Khüree moved before settling in today's Ulaanbaatar; monastery-city terms (хүрээ, лам хувраг, дацан, суурьшил); эхэн үе / сүүл үе / дунд үе (XVIII зууны эхэн үед)

an urban historian's lecture on the city's 20th-century growth and rebuilding; urban history terms (хотжилт, хүн ам, барилгажилт, төлөвлөлт); EN: the bulk of / the majority of / a fraction of with agreement (the bulk of the population was/were)

drafting a short heritage-guide text comparing Karakorum and Ikh Khüree; review of historical vocabulary; combining -ын үед, -ын эрин, -ын тэртээ, эхэн/сүүл үе with EN quantifying expressions in formal writing

units.scope: border closures, online school, shortages, stranded citizens; pandemic terms; intensifying тэр байтугай, ... ч байтугай, бүр ч, улам бүр; EN: binomials (sooner or later, by and large, on and off)

lessons.focus: first news of the pandemic, the border closures and the quarantine regime of early 2020; pandemic terms (цар тахал, хорио цээр, хил хаах, тусгаарлах); бүр ч and улам бүр for escalation (байдал улам бүр хүндэрсэн); EN: binomials of time and frequency (sooner or later, now and then)

TV lessons and online classes, kids at home, struggling parents and teachers; distance-learning terms (теле хичээл, цахим сургалт, сүлжээ тасрах); тэр байтугай for surprising extremes (тэр байтугай багш нар ч утасгүй байсан); EN: binomials by and large, on and off, back and forth

panic buying, flour and fuel shortages, queues and price rises; shortage and supply terms (хомсдол, нөөцлөх, үнийн өсөлт, хүнсний хангамж); ... ч байтугай for 'let alone' (мах ч байтугай гурил олдохгүй байсан); EN: binomials of quantity and choice (odds and ends, more or less, all or nothing)

citizens stuck abroad, charter flights home, waiting lists and quarantine hotels; repatriation terms (гацах, тусгай нислэг, буцаах, хүлээлгийн жагсаалт); combining ... ч байтугай and тэр байтугай in personal accounts; EN: binomials of hardship (ups and downs, sick and tired, safe and sound)

full lockdown at home, masks, PCR tests, vaccination debates and mental strain; health-measure terms (бүх нийтийн бэлэн байдал, ПГУ шинжилгээ, вакцинжуулалт, сэтгэл зүйн дарамт); улам бүр vs бүр ч in describing gradual and sudden worsening; EN: binomials of rules and order (rules and regulations, law and order, cut and dried)

lessons.title_en: Looking Back on the Lockdown Years
lessons.focus: reflecting on lessons learned, the economic and social aftermath, essays and interviews; recovery and reflection terms (сэргэлт, үр дагавар, сургамж); all intensifiers тэр байтугай, ... ч байтугай, бүр ч, улам бүр in extended argument; EN: using binomials naturally in reflective speech and writing (first and foremost, by and large, sooner or later)

units.scope: family and neighbor disputes, court mediators, compromise talks; conflict-resolution terms; considering-forms -ыг бодвол, -ыг бодоход; EN: conceding and countering (granted, admittedly, that said, even so)

lessons.focus: Apartment neighbors argue over noise and a leaking ceiling; dispute vocabulary (маргаан, гомдол, зөрчил, нэхэмжлэл); MN: -ыг бодвол for weighing circumstances (нөхцөл байдлыг бодвол); EN: granted / admittedly to concede a point

Siblings disagree over caring for an elderly parent and a shared apartment; family conflict and feelings terms (гомдох, эвлэрэх, итгэлцэл); MN: -ыг бодоход for considering and reflecting (ээжийн насыг бодоход); EN: that said / even so to counter after conceding

First session with a court mediator: procedure, neutrality, confidentiality; mediation terms (эвлэрүүлэн зуучлал, зуучлагч, талууд, хэлэлцээр, тохиролцоо); MN: contrasting -ыг бодвол (comparison: шүүхэд хандахыг бодвол) vs -ыг бодоход (reflection); EN: admittedly X, but Y; it's true that... but

Compromise talks over a ger-district plot boundary and fence; negotiation and compromise terms (буулт хийх, хил зааг, шаардлага, ашиг сонирхол); MN: -ыг бодвол with cost/benefit reasoning (зардлыг бодвол, цаг хугацааг бодвол); EN: even so, all the same, nevertheless in countering offers

Repairing a friendship and workplace rift after hurtful words; reconciliation terms (уучлах, гэмших, сэтгэлийн шарх, эвлэрэл); MN: -ыг бодоход with emotional reflection (болсон явдлыг бодоход сэтгэл өвдөнө); EN: be that as it may, to be fair, granted that + clause

lessons.title_en: Peace Is Better Than Being Right
lessons.title_mn: Зөв байснаас эв найртай байсан нь дээр
lessons.focus: Reflective discussion on Mongolian traditions of reconciliation (elders, proverbs like эв түнжин) and modern mediation; summary of conflict-resolution vocabulary; MN: review of -ыг бодвол and -ыг бодоход in argued paragraphs; EN: structuring a balanced argument with granted, admittedly, that said, even so

units.scope: Sky Resort ski slopes, skating rinks, the Khövsgöl ice festival; winter sports terms; directional adverbs урагш, хойш, дээш, доош, өөд, уруу; EN: hard/hardly, late/lately, high/highly

lessons.focus: renting skis and buying a lift pass at Sky Resort; ski gear and slope terms (цана, өргөгч, налуу, малгай хамгаалалт); directional дээш/доош with motion verbs (дээш гарах, доош гулгах); EN: hard (adverb) vs hardly

a beginner lesson with an instructor; body movements and balance (тэнцвэр, өвдөг нугалах, унах, босох); урагш/хойш for leaning and moving (урагш тонгойх, хойш унах); EN: hardly + ever/any, hard-working vs hardly working
skating at an outdoor rink in Ulaanbaatar with friends; skating and ice terms (тэшүүр, мөсөн талбай, хальтирах, эргэх); өөд/уруу vs дээш/доош (өгсүүр өөд, уруу гулгах); EN: late vs lately

lessons.title_en: Off to the Khövsgöl Ice Festival
lessons.focus: planning a trip to the Khövsgöl ice festival; festival events (мөсөн баримал, морин чарга, мөсөн дээрх шагай харваа); combining directions with places (нуур өөд, хойд зүг рүү, урагш явах); EN: high vs highly (highly recommended, jump high)

watching and commenting on ice races and tug-of-war at Khövsgöl; competition and cheering terms (уралдаан, тэргүүлэх, гүйцэх, хоцрох); directional adverbs as modifiers of motion (урагш тэмүүлэх, хойш ухрах, дээш өргөх); EN: late/lately and high/highly in commentary

writing a review of a ski weekend and the ice festival; evaluative winter-sports vocabulary (хүйтэн ч сайхан, аюулгүй байдал, зохион байгуулалт); review of all six directional adverbs in narrative; EN: review of hard/hardly, late/lately, high/highly

units.scope: pet peeves, loud neighbors, crowded buses, rude service; annoyance vocabulary; insufficiency and unbearability -хааргүй (тэсэхээргүй, идэхээргүй); EN: can't stand / can't bear / can't help + -ing

lessons.focus: talking about small daily annoyances (people chewing loudly, being late, phone noise); annoyance vocabulary (уурлах, бухимдах, залхах, ядаргаатай); -х дургүй and -д дургүй review leading into EN can't stand + noun / + -ing

loud neighbors, late-night drilling, barking dogs in an apartment building; noise vocabulary (чимээ, шуугиан, өрөмдөх, хананы цаана); introducing -хааргүй for unbearability (тэсэхээргүй, унтахааргүй); EN can't bear + -ing / to-infinitive

crowded rush-hour buses, pushing, stuffy air, no seats; crowding vocabulary (шахцалдах, түлхэх, бүгчим, дүүрэн); -хааргүй for insufficiency of space or conditions (зогсохооргүй, амьсгалахааргүй); EN can't stand vs don't mind contrast

rude cashiers, ignored customers, cold food at a café; service-complaint vocabulary (хүнд сурталтай, ааш муутай, тоомсоргүй, гомдол гаргах); -хааргүй with food and quality (идэхээргүй, уухааргүй, өмсөхөөргүй); EN can't help + -ing (I couldn't help noticing)

admitting your own irritating habits and reactions (sighing, complaining, checking your phone); vocabulary for self-control (өөрийн эрхгүй, тэвчих, барьж ядах, дуугүй өнгөрөх); -хааргүй in past and with degree (тэсэхээргүй байсан, ярихааргүй болсон); EN can't help + -ing vs can't help it / couldn't help but

longer conversation venting about a terrible week and getting advice; consolidating annoyance and coping vocabulary (сэтгэл тайвшрах, уураа гаргах, тоохгүй байх); review of -хааргүй together with -х дургүй and -ж ядах; EN review of can't stand / can't bear / can't help + -ing in connected speech

units.scope: trial classes, new foods, first yoga or dance lessons; trying-out vocabulary; trial auxiliary -аад үзэх with imperatives (идээд үзээрэй, өмсөөд үз); EN: It's the first time + present perfect

lessons.focus: a friend offers an unfamiliar dish at a café (shar tos, khailmag, sushi); new-food and taste words (амт, исгэлэн, ер бусын, дасаагүй); trial auxiliary -аад/-ээд үзэх in imperatives (идээд үз, амсаад үзээрэй); EN: try + noun / try + -ing for experiments

signing up for a trial class at a studio or language center; trial-class vocabulary (туршилтын хичээл, бүртгүүлэх, багш, түвшин, анхан шат); -аад үзье and -аад үзмээр байна for proposing and wanting to try; EN: It's the first time I've + past participle

a first yoga session with an instructor's instructions; body-movement and stretching words (сунгах, амьсгалах, тэнцвэр, дэвсгэр, булчин); -аад үз in polite instructions and past -аад үзсэн/үзлээ for reporting results; EN: It's my first time + -ing vs It's the first time + present perfect

a first dance class (salsa, Mongolian biyelgee) and feeling awkward; dance and nerves vocabulary (алхам, хэмнэл, хос, ичих, эвгүй санагдах); negative and softened -аад үзээгүй, -аад үзэхгүй юу; EN: the first/second time + present perfect with never ... before

trying new styles or gear: a modern deel, climbing shoes, a new haircut; fitting and testing words (өмсөж үзэх өрөө, тохирох, хэмжээ, туршиж үзэх); informal -аад үз vs polite -аад үзээрэй, and -аад үзье гэвэл for offers; EN: try on / try out, It's the first time + present perfect in questions (Is this the first time you've...?)

lessons.title_en: Stepping Out of My Comfort Zone
lessons.focus: telling friends about a month of trying new things and whether to continue; experience and reflection vocabulary (айдас, зориг, сонирхол татах, үргэлжлүүлэх, дадал); combining -аад үзэх forms in narration, suggestion and advice; EN: review of It's the first time + present perfect vs was the first time + past perfect

units.scope: year-end rush, overtime, too many tasks, burnout; workload terms; inability auxiliaries -ж барахгүй, -ж гүйцэхгүй (тоолж барахгүй); EN: verb + preposition + -ing (insist on, complain about)

lessons.focus: December at the office: reports, deadlines, the year-end rush; workload terms (ачаалал, хугацаа, тайлан, яаралтай ажил); -ж гүйцэхгүй for not finishing in time (дуусгаж гүйцэхгүй нь); EN: complain about + -ing

an overflowing to-do list and constant new requests; task and priority vocabulary (даалгавар, тэргүүлэх ач холбогдол, жагсаалт); -ж барахгүй for countless/unmanageable amounts (тоолж барахгүй, хийж барахгүй); EN: deal with / cope with + -ing

overtime, late buses, missed family dinners; overtime and pay terms (илүү цаг, нөхөн амралт, цалин); contrasting -ж барахгүй and -ж гүйцэхгүй in past and present forms (гүйцээгүй, барсангүй); EN: insist on + -ing, apologize for + -ing

asking a manager for help, more time, or fewer tasks; negotiation and request phrases (хугацаа сунгах, ажил хуваарилах, туслах хүн); polite refusals with -ж гүйцэхгүй нь ээ, -ж амжихгүй байх; EN: object to / think about / count on + -ing

burnout signs: exhaustion, sleeplessness, irritability; burnout vocabulary (ядрах, сэтгэл санааны дарамт, бухимдах, сульдах); -ж барахгүй with feelings and the body (тэвчиж барахгүй, унтаж барахгүй); EN: give up / keep on / worry about + -ing

taking leave, delegating, setting limits after the rush; work-life balance terms (ээлжийн амралт, хил хязгаар, хуваарь); review of -ж барахгүй / -ж гүйцэхгүй in advice and reflection; EN: verb + preposition + -ing review (succeed in, focus on, look forward to)

units.scope: steering talk, changing topics, interrupting politely; conversation terms; topic introducers гэвэл, гэхээр, гэдэг чинь; EN: conversational markers (anyway, speaking of which, mind you)

lessons.focus: breaking the ice at a reception or office party; conversation terms (яриа өдөх, сэдэв, хөөрөлдөх, small talk); topic introducer гэвэл (Ажил гэвэл...); EN: so, well, by the way as openers

linking to what someone just said over dinner with friends; topic links (сэдэвтэй холбоотой, дурдах, санагдуулах); гэхээр for picking up a topic (Хөвсгөл гэхээр...); EN: speaking of which, talking of, that reminds me

steering away from awkward topics at a family gathering; steering terms (сэдэв өөрчлөх, яриа эргүүлэх, эвгүй сэдэв); гэдэг чинь for reframing a topic (Улс төр гэдэг чинь...); EN: anyway, anyhow, moving on, at any rate

interrupting politely in a meeting and taking the floor; turn-taking terms (үг таслах, үг авах, ээлж, саналаа хэлэх); polite interrupting phrases with -х гэсэн юм and -ж болох уу combined with гэвэл; EN: if I could just, sorry to cut in, hold that thought

adding caveats and second thoughts while chatting with a colleague; nuance terms (тайлбар, нэмэлт, эргэлзээ, сөрөг тал); contrasting гэвэл vs гэхээр vs гэдэг чинь in topic shifts; EN: mind you, then again, having said that, still

steering a rambling discussion back and wrapping up gracefully; closing terms (гол сэдэв, хазайх, дүгнэх, яриагаа өндөрлөх); review of гэвэл, гэхээр, гэдэг чинь in returning to topics; EN: anyway, as I was saying, where was I, to get back to, all in all

units.scope: curating, provenance, returning artifacts to Mongolia; museum terms; anaphoric reference дээрх, дараах, тус, нөгөө, мөнөөх; EN: the former/the latter, respectively, the aforementioned

lessons.focus: touring the Chinggis Khaan National Museum and reading exhibit labels; museum terms (үзмэр, үзэсгэлэн, хадгаламж, сан хөмрөг); дээрх and дараах in labels and guides; EN: the above / the following
planning an exhibition and choosing objects for display; curating terms (куратор, сэдэвчилсэн үзэсгэлэн, тайлбар бичвэр); тус in formal reference (тус музей, тус үзмэр); EN: the former / the latter

tracing an object's history through archives and old auction records; provenance terms (гарал үүсэл, эзэмшигч, баримт бичиг, хууль бус худалдаа); нөгөө for the other of two or something already known; EN: respectively

retelling a story of a manuscript smuggled abroad and later rediscovered; heritage and trafficking vocabulary (соёлын өв, хулгайлагдсан, илрүүлэх); мөнөөх for previously mentioned items in narrative, compared with нөгөө; EN: the aforementioned, the said

news and negotiations about returning artifacts and fossils to Mongolia; repatriation terms (буцаан олгох, эх оронд нь авчрах, олон улсын гэрээ, нэхэмжлэл); combining дээрх, тус, мөнөөх in reports; EN: the former/the latter and respectively in formal reporting

debating private collections, ownership of heritage and museum ethics; collecting and ethics vocabulary (хувийн цуглуулга, цуглуулагч, ёс зүй, өмчлөх эрх); review of all anaphoric forms in essays and debate; EN: cohesive reference across a whole argument

units.scope: apartment construction, building quality, site accidents, inspections; construction terms; derived nouns -уур/-үүр, -мж, -вэр/-вар (хэмжүүр, санамж, шийдвэр); EN: not until / it wasn't until... that, only when inversion

lessons.title_en: A New Apartment Block Goes Up
lessons.focus: touring a rising apartment project in Ulaanbaatar with a site engineer; core construction terms (суурь, арматур, бетон, давхар, барилгын компани); derived nouns in -вэр/-вар (шийдвэр, бүтээвэр, хийвэр) for results of actions; EN: not until + clause (Work can't start until the permit arrives)

a foreman briefing new workers on equipment and measuring; tools and instruments (өргөгч кран, хэмжүүр, түвшин хэмжигч, шат, тоног төхөөрөмж); instrument nouns in -уур/-үүр (хэмжүүр, түлхүүр, шүүр, хөрөөдүүр); EN: it wasn't until... that cleft (It wasn't until noon that the crane arrived)

a morning safety briefing and warning signs on site; protective gear and hazards (хамгаалалтын малгай, бүс, тор, өндрөөс унах); nouns in -мж (санамж, сануулга vs санамж, хэрэгцээ vs шаардлага, хамгаалалт vs дэмжлэг) for notices and instructions; EN: only when + inversion (Only when you wear a harness may you go up)

reporting and discussing a fall from scaffolding and its aftermath; accident and injury terms (осол, гэмтэл, яаралтай тусламж, хариуцлага, нөхөн олговор); mixing -вэр/-вар and -мж nouns in reports (тайлбар, гомдол vs шийдвэр, дүгнэлт vs нотолгоо); EN: not until + inversion (Not until the investigation ended did they admit fault)

a state inspection of a building with failed checks and required fixes; inspection and quality terms (стандарт, зөрчил, акт, ашиглалтад оруулах, магадлал); combining -уур/-үүр, -мж, -вэр nouns in formal findings (шалгуур, хэмжээ vs хэмжүүр, шаардлага vs санамж, шийдвэр); EN: only after / only then + inversion (Only after the cracks were repaired was the permit issued)

a public debate on building quality, cheap materials and earthquake readiness in UB; quality and accountability vocabulary (чанар, газар хөдлөлтөд тэсвэртэй, хямд материал, захиалагч, худалдан авагч); review of derived nouns -уур/-үүр, -мж, -вэр/-вар in argument; EN: review of not until / it wasn't until... that / only when inversion for emphasis in debate

units.scope: Mongolian Wikipedia, glossaries, explaining concepts clearly; definition terms; formal coordinators бөгөөд, ба, болон, түүнчлэн; EN: apposition and definitional phrasing (refers to, is defined as)

lessons.title_mn: Энэ нэр томьёо юу гэсэн үг вэ?
lessons.focus: asking about and explaining unfamiliar terms in a lecture or meeting; core definition vocabulary (нэр томьёо, тодорхойлолт, ойлголт, утга, гэдэг нь); MN: defining with ... гэдэг нь ... юм / гэж нэрлэдэг, ба for joining paired nouns; EN: X refers to Y, X means, is called

drafting a short Mongolian Wikipedia article on a place or person (e.g. Хархорин); encyclopedic vocabulary (эх сурвалж, ишлэл, засварлах, нийтлэл, ангилал); MN: бөгөөд linking clauses in written definitions (... хот бөгөөд ... байрладаг); EN: apposition with commas (Karakorum, the former capital, ...)

compiling a glossary for a mining or IT report; category and classification words (төрөл, ангилал, хамаарах, бүрдэх, жишээлбэл); MN: болон in lists of coordinated nouns and noun phrases, ба vs болон; EN: is defined as, is a type of, consists of

expanding an explanation of a cultural concept (e.g. отор, ерөөл) for foreign readers; vocabulary of features and functions (онцлог, үүрэг, зориулалт, шинж чанар); MN: түүнчлэн and мөн for adding information across sentences; EN: also known as, that is (i.e.), in other words, namely

explaining a scientific or legal concept to a non-expert (inflation, a mortgage, the greenhouse effect); paraphrase and comparison vocabulary (өөрөөр хэлбэл, товчхондоо, энгийнээр хэлэхэд, жишээ нь); MN: combining бөгөөд, ба, түүнчлэн in one clear explanation without overusing them; EN: definitional relative clauses (a device that..., a process by which...)

reviewing and correcting definitions in student essays and online entries; precision vocabulary (нарийвчлал, хоёрдмол утга, ялгаа, хамрах хүрээ, үл хамаарах); MN: choosing the right formal coordinator for register (бөгөөд/ба/болон/түүнчлэн vs spoken тэгээд, бас); EN: distinguishing terms (as opposed to, as distinct from, strictly speaking, in the sense of)

units.scope: flat tires, breakdowns on steppe roads, towing, roadside help; car repair terms; sequencing эхлээд, дараа нь, эцэст нь with -аад; EN: It takes + time + to-infinitive

lessons.title_en: A Flat Tire on the Steppe
lessons.focus: noticing a flat tire on a dirt road and changing it; tire and tool words (дугуй, домкрат, сэлбэг дугуй, түлхүүр, боолт); MN эхлээд ... -аад, дараа нь for steps; EN: It takes + time + to-infinitive (It takes twenty minutes to change a tire)

describing a breakdown to a fellow traveler; engine and car-part terms (мотор, аккумлятор, асаагуур, тос, хөргөлтийн шингэн); MN chains of -аад/-ээд/-оод/-өөд for what happened in order; EN: It takes + person + time + to-infinitive (It took us an hour to find the problem)

phoning a relative, a tow service or 105 and giving your location by landmarks and kilometer markers; roadside-help words (чирэгч машин, авто засвар, байршил, замын хажуу); MN эхлээд, дараа нь, эцэст нь in instructions; EN: How long does it take to...? / It will take about... to get there

being towed to the nearest soum center and arranging the trip; towing terms (чирэх, чирүүлэх, трос, зогсоол, сумын төв); MN -аад sequences with эцэст нь for the outcome; EN: It takes + money/effort + to-infinitive, negative and question forms (It didn't take long to...)

explaining the problem to a mechanic and asking about cost and timing; repair terms (засварчин, сэлбэг, солих, оношлох, баталгаа); MN мэдээд, үзээд, солиод within эхлээд ... дараа нь ... эцэст нь; EN: It takes + time + to-infinitive with mechanics' estimates and the past (It took three days to get the part)

retelling the whole breakdown story and giving advice for long steppe drives; review of car trouble vocabulary and safety checks (бензин, нөөц ус, гар чийдэн, сэлбэг); MN full narrative with эхлээд, дараа нь, эцэст нь and -аад; EN: It takes in narratives and advice (It takes patience to drive in the countryside)

units.scope: fear of heights, flying, dogs, public speaking; fear vocabulary; daring forms -ж зүрхлэх, -ж дийлэх, -хаас эмээх; EN: verb + object + to-infinitive (want/expect/encourage someone to)

lessons.focus: looking down from the Zaisan stairs and a tall apartment balcony; fear words (айх, айдас, толгой эргэх, чичрэх, сандрах); айх with ablative -аас/-ээс vs -хаас айх, EN: be afraid of / scared of + noun or -ing

a nervous passenger on a flight from Chinggis Khaan Airport; flying vocabulary (турбулент, хөөрөх, газардах, хамгаалах бүс); -хаас эмээх as softer, worried fear, EN: want someone to + verb (I want you to hold my hand)

stray dogs on the walk home in a ger district and a neighbor's dog in the stairwell; dog and danger vocabulary (хазах, хуцах, золбин нохой, хотоо хорио); -ж зүрхлэхгүй (dare not do), EN: expect someone to + verb

giving a presentation at university or work; public speaking vocabulary (тайз, үзэгчид, догдлох, үгээ мартах, гар хөлрөх); -ж зүрхлэх with positive and question forms (асууж зүрхэлсэн үү), EN: encourage / ask someone to + verb

a friend coaching someone to try a zipline in Terelj or to speak at a meeting; courage vocabulary (зориг, зоригтой, тэвчих, даван туулах); -ж дийлэх / -ж дийлэхгүй (manage or fail to overcome), EN: tell / persuade / help someone to + verb

lessons.title_mn: Чи юунаас хамгийн их айдаг вэ?
lessons.focus: a café conversation comparing childhood fears and fears now; review of fear vocabulary and phobias (фоби, харанхуй, могой, хаалттай өрөө); combining -ж зүрхлэх, -ж дийлэх, -хаас эмээх in a story, EN: review of verb + object + to-infinitive, including negatives (asked me not to)

units.scope: decluttering, donating clothes, selling secondhand online, reusing things; household item terms; transformation -ыг ... болгох; EN: other/another/the other/others

lessons.focus: Opening an overstuffed closet and sorting what to keep; household items and storage terms (шүүгээ, өлгүүр, хайрцаг, хуучин хувцас); intro to -ыг ... болгох for changing a state (өрөөг цэвэрхэн болгох); EN: another vs other with singular and plural nouns

lessons.title_mn: Үлдээх үү, өгөх үү, хаях уу?
lessons.focus: Deciding with family what to keep or get rid of; decluttering verbs (ангилах, ялгах, хаях, хадгалах); -ыг ... болгох with nouns (агуулахыг ажлын өрөө болгох); EN: the other vs the others for the rest of a set

Taking clothes to a donation point or a ger-district family; donation and condition terms (хандив, бүрэн бүтэн, угаасан, бага болсон); purpose with болгох (хуучин дээлийг хүүхдийн хувцас болгох); EN: others vs other people, one... the other

Posting secondhand items on Facebook groups and Unegui.mn, answering buyers; listing and pricing terms (зар, хямдруулах, шинэвтэр, хүргэлт); болгох for prices and amounts (үнийг хагас болгох); EN: another + number (another 5,000 tögrög), each other vs one another review

lessons.title_en: A Second Life for Old Things
lessons.focus: Upcycling jars, T-shirts, and old furniture; craft and reuse terms (дахин ашиглах, цүнх оёх, будах, засах); full -ыг ... болгох transformations (савыг цэцгийн сав болгох, футболкыг уут болгох); EN: other as adjective vs pronoun (other bags / the others)

Reflecting on a tidier home and new buying habits; minimalism and habit terms (хэрэглээ, хэрэгцээ, хуримтлуулах, энгийн амьдрал); review of -ыг ... болгох in abstract uses (амьдралаа энгийн болгох); EN: review of other/another/the other/others in context

units.scope: student shifts, cafés and call centers, first paycheck, balancing study and work; part-time work terms; time clauses -х үед, -ын үеэр, -сан даруйд; EN: during vs while vs for

lessons.focus: students browsing job ads and asking about shifts; job-ad terms (цагийн ажил, ээлж, цалин, туршлагагүй байж болно); -х үед for when something happens (хичээлгүй үед ажиллана); EN: while + clause vs during + noun

lessons.title_en: My First Shift at the Café
lessons.focus: barista training, taking orders, closing up; café work vocabulary (кассчин, захиалга, ээлж солих, цэвэрлэгээ); -ын үеэр with events and periods (оройн ээлжийн үеэр); EN: during the shift vs for three hours

call-center work, scripts, difficult customers; call-center terms (дуудлага хүлээн авах, операторч, гомдол, хүлээлгийн хугацаа); -сан даруйд for right after (дуудлага дууссан даруйд тэмдэглэнэ); EN: for + duration vs during + period

receiving pay, taxes, deductions, spending and saving; pay terms (цагийн хөлс, суутгал, нэмэгдэл, цалингийн хуудас); combining -сан даруйд and -ын үеэр (цалин орсон даруйд, амралтын үеэр); EN: while vs during vs for in money stories

scheduling around exams, asking a manager for time off, tiredness; balance vocabulary (хуваарь, чөлөө авах, ядрах, цаг зохицуулах); contrasting -х үед and -ын үеэр (шалгалт өгөх үед vs шалгалтын үеэр); EN: while + -ing and during + noun with the same meaning

reflecting on part-time jobs in a short talk or post; skills and experience terms (хариуцлага, харилцааны чадвар, туршлага хуримтлуулах); review of -х үед, -ын үеэр, -сан даруйд in connected narrative; EN: mixed review of during/while/for

units.scope: misdiagnosis, medical complaints, informed consent, hospital accountability; patient-rights terms; causative as adversative passive (шалгуулах, хазуулах, буруу онош тавиулах); EN: modal perfect continuous (must have been working)

lessons.title_en: Know Your Rights as a Patient
lessons.focus: reading a hospital patient-rights poster and charter; core rights terms (өвчтөний эрх, эмнэлгийн нууц, мэдээлэл авах эрх, эмчилгээнээс татгалзах); review of causative -уул/-үүл as 'let/have someone do' (үзүүлэх, шалгуулах) before the adversative use; EN: must have + past participle as a warm-up for deduction

telling a friend how a hidden illness was missed; misdiagnosis terms (онош, буруу онош тавих, хожуу илрэх, дахин шинжилгээ); causative as adversative passive for things suffered (буруу онош тавиулах, буруу эм бичүүлэх); EN: must have been + -ing for deduction about ongoing past situations (the doctor must have been working a double shift)

talking with a surgeon before an operation and asking about risks; informed-consent terms (мэдээлэлтэй зөвшөөрөл, эрсдэл, хүндрэл, мэдээ алдуулалт, гарын үсэг); adversative passive for unwanted procedures (зөвшөөрөлгүй хагалгаа хийлгэх, тайлбар авалгүй тариулах); EN: might have been / could have been + -ing for possible past explanations

an emergency-room visit after a dog bite and a long wait without care; ER and neglect terms (яаралтай тусламж, түргэн тусламж, хайхрамжгүй байдал, анхаарал хандуулах); adversative passive with agents in the dative (нохойд хазуулах, жижүүрт хөөгдөх versus хөөлгөх); EN: can't have been + -ing for negative deduction (they can't have been paying attention)

writing a formal complaint to a hospital and the Ministry of Health; complaint and accountability terms (гомдол гаргах, хариуцлага тооцох, ёс зүйн хороо, нөхөн төлбөр, нотлох баримт); adversative causatives in formal written register (хохироох versus хохирол учруулах, эрүүл мэндээрээ хохирох); EN: modal perfect continuous in formal complaints (staff appear to have been ignoring protocols, should have been monitoring)

a radio debate on medical malpractice, doctor overload and patient trust; malpractice and reform terms (эмчийн алдаа, мэргэжлийн хариуцлагын даатгал, хяналт шалгалт, ачаалал, итгэл); contrasting adversative causatives with plain passives and active forms in argument (шалгуулсан, шалгагдсан, шалгасан); EN: mixed modal perfect continuous forms for weighing blame (they must have been overworked, they may have been cutting corners)

units.scope: Naadam child jockeys, horse welfare, safety rules, regulation debates; welfare terms; maximizing forms аль болох, -х чинээгээрээ; EN: Latinate vs phrasal-verb register (tolerate vs put up with)

lessons.focus: Reading about Naadam horse races and child jockeys; race and jockey vocabulary (хурдан морь, уяач, унаач, соёолон, азарга, барианд орох); intro to аль болох + adjective/adverb (аль болох хурдан, аль болох хөнгөн); EN: noticing formal vs everyday verbs in race reports (participate vs take part)

Explaining jockey safety rules to parents before a race; safety-equipment and regulation terms (хамгаалах хэрэгсэл, насны доод хязгаар, даатгал, гэмтэл, бүртгэл); аль болох in requests and rules (аль болох эрт бүртгүүлээрэй); EN: Latinate rule language vs spoken equivalents (require/need, ensure/make sure, prohibit/ban)

A trainer describes preparing horses and preventing overwork; horse-welfare vocabulary (сойх, усгүйжилт, ядаргаа, малын эмч, эрүүл мэндийн үзлэг, зовлон шаналал); -х чинээгээрээ for doing all one can (чадах чинээгээрээ, хүч чинээгээрээ); EN: tolerate vs put up with, endure vs go through, recover vs get over

A TV talk show debating children in long-distance races; debate and rights terms (хүүхдийн эрх, хүүхдийн хөдөлмөр, соёлын өв, эрсдэл, хариуцлага); combining аль болох and -х чинээгээрээ in arguments (аль болох багасгах, чадах чинээгээрээ хамгаалах); EN: switching register mid-argument: formal claims vs phrasal-verb rebuttals (eliminate/do away with, reduce/cut down on)

A working group drafts amendments on race distance, weather limits and age; legal-regulatory terms (журам, нэмэлт өөрчлөлт, хяналт тавих, торгууль, хэрэгжилт, мөрдөх); аль болох and -х чинээгээрээ in formal written register (аль болох богиносгох, боломжийн чинээгээрээ хэрэгжүүлэх); EN: converting phrasal verbs into Latinate formal equivalents for official texts (carry out → implement, look into → investigate)

Interviews with a former child jockey, a vet and a horse owner on welfare and reform; review of welfare, safety and debate vocabulary; full use of maximizing forms in personal testimony (би чадах чинээгээрээ…, аль болох олон хүүхдийг…); EN: choosing register for audience: rewriting a formal statement as casual speech and vice versa

units.scope: saving face, reputation, public shaming online, family honor; honor and shame terms; pretense forms -сан болох, -сан дүр үзүүлэх; EN: reflexive verb idioms (pride oneself on, avail oneself of)

lessons.focus: a manager is corrected in front of colleagues; core honor and shame terms (нэр төр, нүүр улайх, ичгүүр, гутамшиг); EN: pride oneself on vs be ashamed of
avoiding an awkward truth at a family dinner; tact and discretion vocabulary; pretense form -сан болох (мэдээгүй болох, унтсан болох); EN: pretend to vs make out that
spending beyond one's means to impress relatives and neighbors; reputation and status terms (нэр хүнд, хов жив, хүний нүд); -сан дүр үзүүлэх, -х дүр эсгэх; EN: avail oneself of, content oneself with

a viral post publicly shames a café worker; online shaming terms (олны өмнө шившиг болох, гүтгэлэг, нэр муутгах); pretense forms contrasted with real states; EN: bring oneself to, distance oneself from

parents fear a divorce will disgrace the family; family honor vocabulary (ураг төрлийн нэр, ааваас өвлөх нэр, гутаах); -сан болох / дүр үзүүлэх in reported family speech; EN: hold oneself responsible for, absent oneself from

a public figure's apology statement, judged sincere or staged; restoring reputation terms (нэр төрөө сэргээх, гэмшил, хүлээн зөвшөөрөх); review of all pretense forms; EN: review of reflexive verb idioms (acquit oneself well, reconcile oneself to)

units.scope: horse coat colors, livestock age terms, breeding lines, famous racehorses; horse vocabulary; descriptive adjective + noun-тай phrases (хурдан хөлтэй, өндөр нуруутай); EN: near-synonym distinctions (breed/raise/rear)

lessons.focus: describing horses at a herder's camp; basic coat colors (хээр, зээрд, хул, хонгор, бор, хар, цагаан, саарал, алаг); color adjective + морь and noun-тай phrases for markings (цагаан төөнгөтэй, халзан); EN: near-synonym colors and markings (chestnut vs sorrel, blaze vs star)

counting a family's herd by age; livestock age terms (унага, даага, шүдлэн, хязаалан, соёолон, азарга, гүү, морь, байдас); descriptive adjective + noun-тай phrases for age and build (залуу насны, өндөр нуруутай); EN: breed vs raise vs rear

a trainer appraising a racehorse's body; horse anatomy and qualities (дэл, сүүл, туурай, цээж, хөл, хурд, тэсвэр); stacked adjective + noun-тай phrases (хурдан хөлтэй, өргөн цээжтэй, нарийн бэлхүүстэй); EN: near-synonyms for strength and speed (stamina vs endurance, fast vs swift vs quick)

tracing a horse's pedigree with a breeder; breeding-line terms (удам, угшил, үүлдэр, эх, эцэг, цус ойртолт, сайжруулах); possessive and genitive chains with noun-тай descriptions (алдартай азаргын удамтай); EN: breed (noun) vs strain vs line vs pedigree

telling the stories of famous Naadam racehorses; titles and race terms (түрүү, айргийн тав, аварга, тоос шороо, уяач, уралдаан); relative modifiers combined with noun-тай phrases (олон түрүүтэй, нэртэй алдартай уяачийн); EN: famous vs renowned vs legendary vs celebrated

negotiating a horse purchase and comparing candidates; review of colors, ages and bloodlines with temperament terms (номхон, догшин, сургамтгай); contrasting several noun-тай descriptions in one argument; EN: near-synonym review (breed/raise/rear, tame/train/break in)

units.scope: allergies, reading labels, eating out with restrictions; ingredient terms; occasional -х нь бий, -х үе бий; EN: adjective + preposition (allergic to, free from)

lessons.focus: telling a new coworker about your allergy; common allergens (самар, сүү, өндөг, улаан буудай, загас, далайн хоол, харшил, харшилтай); EN: allergic to, sensitive to, intolerant of

lessons.title_mn: Заримдаа ийм юм болох үе бий
lessons.focus: describing reactions and how often they occur; symptoms (тууралт, загатнах, хавдах, амьсгал давчдах, гэдэс өвдөх); occasional -х нь бий, -х үе бий; EN: prone to, subject to, susceptible to
checking packaged food at a supermarket in Ulaanbaatar; ingredient and label terms (найрлага, агуулсан, ул мөр, хадгалалтын хугацаа, нэмэлт бодис, глютен); EN: free from, high in, low in, rich in

lessons.title_en: Can You Make It Without Meat?
lessons.focus: ordering buuz, khuushuur or tsuivan with restrictions at a guanz or café; special diets (цагаан хоолтон, веган, сахаргүй, давсгүй, тосгүй); -х нь бий for dishes and cases that sometimes contain something; EN: suitable for, safe for, aware of

hosting Tsagaan Sar or birthday guests with dietary needs; substitutes and cooking terms (орлуулах, тусад нь хийх, холилдох, лактозгүй сүү, ургамлын тос); -х үе бий vs -х нь бий contrasted; EN: worried about, careful with, used to

a serious reaction while eating out, calling 103 and explaining afterward; emergency and medicine terms (харшлын эм, тарилга, яаралтай тусламж, ухаан алдах, анафилакси); review of -х нь бий / -х үе бий; EN: responsible for, grateful for, adjective + preposition review

units.scope: meeting old classmates, catching up, how lives turned out; school-memory terms; understatement тийм ч ... биш, нэг их ... -гүй; EN: less/fewer/the least

lessons.focus: a class group chat organizing a 15-year reunion; reunion and school terms (төгсөгч, ангийн багш, ангийнхан, уулзалт зохион байгуулах); understatement тийм ч ... биш (тийм ч хол биш, тийм ч үнэтэй биш); EN: less + uncountable noun (less time, less money)

greeting old classmates at the restaurant door; appearance and change vocabulary (таних, өөрчлөгдөх, хөгшрөх, туранхай болох); нэг их ... -гүй (нэг их өөрчлөгдөөгүй, нэг их таниагүй); EN: fewer + countable noun (fewer gray hairs, fewer people than last time)

sharing memories of teachers, pranks and school events; school-memory terms (жижүүр, ангийн дарга, хичээл тасдах, шагнал, ширээний хань); тийм ч / нэг их with past forms (тийм ч сайн сурдаггүй байсан, нэг их тоодоггүй байсан); EN: less/fewer in comparisons with than (I studied less than you)

lessons.title_en: So, What Are You Doing Now?
lessons.focus: catching up on jobs, families and where people live now; life-path vocabulary (гэр бүл зохиох, ажил солих, гадаадад суурьших, хүүхэдтэй болох); modest self-description with understatement (тийм ч амжилттай биш, нэг их том ажил биш); EN: not as... as vs less... than (my job is less stressful)

talking about surprises, regrets and who ended up where; outcome vocabulary (санаанд оромгүй, хувь заяа, мөрөөдөл биелэх, бүтэлгүйтэх); contrasting understatement with emphasis (тийм ч муу биш vs маш сайн, нэг их санаа зовоогүй); EN: the least + adjective / the least + noun (the least likely to, the least money)

toasts, group photos and promising to stay in touch; farewell and reunion-planning terms (хундага өргөх, холбоотой байх, дараагийн уулзалт, хамтдаа зураг авахуулах); review of тийм ч ... биш and нэг их ... -гүй in polite, modest speech; EN: review of less/fewer/the least (fewer people came, the least we can do)

units.scope: no signal, asking herders the way, landmarks, GPS; orientation terms; -ын зүгт, -ыг чиглэн, -ыг барин; EN: relative adverbs where/when/why

lessons.focus: realizing you're lost on a steppe road with a dead phone and no GPS; signal, battery, map, offline map, track (зам мөр), fork in the road (салаа зам); EN: relative adverb where (the place where we turned off)

finding direction by the sun, ger doors facing south, and the compass; зүүн, баруун, хойд, өмнөд, зүүн хойд, нар мандах/жаргах; -ын зүгт (баруун хойд зүгт, уулын зүгт); EN: relative adverb where vs which (the hill where / the hill which)

describing the route by landmarks such as ovoo, wells, power lines, a lone tree, and saddle passes; худаг, овоо, даваа, хөндий, гол, цахилгааны шугам; -ыг барин (голыг барин, шугамыг барьж явах); EN: relative adverb when (the time when we passed the well)

stopping at a ger, greeting politely, and asking for directions to the soum center; сумын төв, хэдэн километр, тойрох, эргэх, шууд явах; -ыг чиглэн (сумын төвийг чиглэн, уулыг чиглэн явах); EN: why in relative clauses (the reason why, that's why)

understanding vague rural directions with distances in horizon terms and relative positions; хөтөл, ар, энгэр, бэл, нэг уулын цаана; combining -ын зүгт, -ыг чиглэн and -ыг барин in one route; EN: where/when/why vs in which/at which/for which (formal alternatives)

retelling a getting-lost story and giving tips to other travelers about GPS, spare fuel, and telling family your route; safety and navigation review; all three orientation postpositions in past narration; EN: omitted relative adverbs and the place/day/reason (that) structures

units.title_en: First Week at a New Job
units.scope: onboarding, new colleagues, office etiquette; workplace-routine terms; possessive contrast -ыг нь vs -аа/-ээ; EN: gerunds as subjects and objects

lessons.focus: arriving on the first day, meeting HR, getting an ID badge and a laptop; onboarding terms (гэрээ, үнэмлэх, ажлын байр, туршилтын хугацаа); reflexive -аа/-ээ for one's own things (үнэмлэхээ авлаа, компьютерээ асаалаа); EN: gerunds as subjects (Starting a new job is exciting)

being introduced to colleagues and the manager, remembering names and roles; colleague and role terms (хамт олон, хэлтсийн дарга, туслах, баг); third-person -ыг нь vs reflexive -аа (нэрийг нь мартчихлаа vs нэрээ хэлэв); EN: gerunds after verbs (enjoy meeting, avoid forgetting)

unwritten rules about greetings, lunch, dress code, phones in meetings; etiquette terms (хувцаслалт, хоцрох, чимээгүй, хүндэтгэх); -ыг нь vs -аа with borrowed and shared things (аягыг нь угаана vs аягаа угаана); EN: gerunds after prepositions (Thanks for helping, before leaving)

daily schedule, morning meetings, reporting, timesheets, systems and passwords; workplace-routine terms (шуурхай хурал, тайлан, цаг бүртгэл, имэйл, хуваарь); choosing -ыг нь or -аа for tasks and reports (тайлангаа илгээ vs тайланг нь шалга); EN: gerund subjects with it-alternatives (Checking email takes time / It takes time to check email)

asking a mentor or colleague how things work, admitting mistakes, saying thank you; help and mistake terms (зааварчилгаа, алдаа, ойлгохгүй байна, зөвлөгөө); -ыг нь in requests about others' things (принтерийн кодыг нь хэлж өгөөч, файлыг нь явуулаач); EN: mind/suggest/recommend + gerund (Would you mind showing me?)

lessons.title_mn: Эхний долоо хоногоо эргэн харах нь
lessons.focus: Friday chat with the manager, feedback, impressions, goals for next week; review and feedback terms (санал, сэтгэгдэл, зорилго, ахиц); mixed review of -ыг нь vs -аа/-ээ in longer accounts; EN: review of gerunds as subjects and objects (Working here has been great; I'm looking forward to learning more)

units.scope: facial expressions, posture, reading moods, silence; nonverbal terms; -х маягтай, -сан байдалтай, -х янзтай; EN: look/sound/seem + adjective, come across as

lessons.focus: Guessing a coworker's mood from their face in a morning meeting; facial expressions (хөмсөг зангидах, инээмсэглэх, нүд ирмэх, царай барайх); -х маягтай for how someone looks (уурлах маягтай, ядарсан маягтай) / EN: look + adjective (You look tired)

lessons.title_mn: Биеийн байдал юу хэлж байна вэ
lessons.focus: Watching body posture in a job interview or lecture hall; posture terms (бөхийх, гараа эвхэх, тэгш суух, мөрөө хавчих); -сан байдалтай for visible states (гараа эвхсэн байдалтай, санаа зовсон байдалтай) / EN: seem/appear + adjective vs seem to + verb

Interpreting tone on a phone call with a relative from the countryside; voice and tone terms (дуу намсах, өнгө хүйтэн, ширүүн, зөөлөн); -х янзтай for impressions from sound (гомдсон янзтай, яарсан янзтай) / EN: sound + adjective, sound like + noun/clause

Awkward and respectful silences at family gatherings and with elders; silence vocabulary (дуугүй болох, түр завсарлах, эвгүй чимээгүй, хүндэтгэлийн чимээгүй); contrasting -х маягтай, -сан байдалтай, -х янзтай in one description / EN: seem as if/as though, it seems that

A foreign guest misreads Mongolian gestures (pointing with the hand, offering with the right hand, touching hats, stepping on the threshold); gesture and etiquette terms (дохио зангаа, гар өргөх, толгой дохих); negative and question forms of -х янзтай / -х маягтай (тийм янзгүй, ... маягтай юу?) / EN: come across as + adjective/noun

Discussing how a new manager or a TV debate guest came across; impression vocabulary (итгэлтэй, бардам, даруу, хөндий, найрсаг харагдах); combining all three forms with харагдах and санагдах in nuanced judgments / EN: come across as vs look/seem/sound, give the impression that

units.scope: fake cashmere, counterfeit goods, plagiarism, originality; authenticity terms; deverbal adjectives -мал/-мэл/-мол (хиймэл, зохиомол); EN: so/such inversion (So convincing was the copy that...)

lessons.focus: checking a cashmere sweater at a shop and reading labels; authenticity terms (жинхэнэ, хуурамч, хольцтой, шошго); deverbal adjectives -мал/-мэл/-мол introduced (хиймэл, холимог vs хольсон); EN: So soft was the wool that... (so + adjective inversion)

spotting counterfeit brand bags, phones and medicines at Naran Tuul; counterfeit-goods vocabulary (дуураймал, хууль бус, барааны тэмдэг); -мал/-мэл/-мол with harmony (дуураймал, хиймэл, будмал); EN: such + noun inversion (Such was the demand that...)

a university plagiarism case and citing sources; academic honesty terms (хулгайлах, эх сурвалж, хуулбар, зохиогчийн эрх); -мал/-мэл/-мол as modifiers vs participles (зохиомол vs зохиосон); EN: so + adverb inversion (So closely had he copied that...)

fake reviews, made-up biographies and fabricated news; fabrication terms (зохиомол, худал, баримтгүй, хуурамч профайл); -мал/-мэл/-мол adjectives used as nouns (зохиомол нь, хиймэл нь); EN: so + many/much/few/little inversion (So many were the fake reviews that...)

comparing artificial and natural materials in fur, leather, stones and flowers; material terms (байгалийн, хиймэл арьс, нийлэг, үнэт чулуу); contrasting -мал/-мэл/-мол with -ын and -лаг/-лэг adjectives; EN: such + be + noun inversion (Such is the quality of the fakes that...)

debating originality, imitation and inspiration in art, fashion and brands; originality terms (бие даасан, шинэлэг, санаа авах, дуурайх); full review of -мал/-мэл/-мол in argument; EN: so/such inversion in formal argument and essays

units.scope: mentors, inspiring figures, life influences; mentorship terms; -х төдийгүй, -аас дутахгүй, -тай мөр зэрэгцэн; EN: not only... but also, as well as + -ing

lessons.title_en: The Person Who Changed My Path
lessons.focus: describing a first mentor (a teacher, coach or older relative) and how you met; mentorship terms (зөвлөгч, багш шавь, үлгэр дуурайл, удирдамж, нөлөө); MN -х төдийгүй for adding a second, stronger point (зааж өгөх төдийгүй урам өгдөг байсан); EN not only... but also with matching phrases

an apprentice talks about a wrestling coach or a morin khuur master; skills and know-how terms (туршлага, ур чадвар, хөдөлмөрч зан, сахилга бат, арга барил); MN -х төдийгүй with nouns and participles (ур чадвартай төдийгүй даруу); EN not only with inversion at the start of a sentence (Not only did she teach me...)

lessons.title_en: Just as Good as the Best
lessons.focus: praising young Mongolian talents and comparing them with famous role models; achievement and talent terms (авъяас, амжилт, шилдэг, нэр хүнд, өрсөлдөх чадвар); MN -аас дутахгүй for equal standing (дэлхийн тамирчдаас дутахгүй); EN as well as + -ing (as well as training, she studies)

lessons.title_en: Side by Side with My Mentor
lessons.focus: a young researcher or entrepreneur working next to a senior colleague as an equal partner; collaboration terms (хамтран ажиллах, түнш, итгэл хүлээлгэх, хариуцлага, өсөж хөгжих); MN -тай мөр зэрэгцэн for working alongside someone as an equal; EN as well as + -ing after the main clause versus as well as + noun

lessons.title_mn: Түүхэн дэх урам зориг өгөгч хүмүүс
lessons.focus: discussing historical and public figures (Natsagdorj, Tsend-Ayush, Olympic champions) and why they inspire people; inspiration and legacy terms (урам зориг, өв, нөлөө бүхий, бахархал, тэргүүлэгч); MN combining -х төдийгүй, -аас дутахгүй and -тай мөр зэрэгцэн in short profiles; EN not only... but also with subject-verb agreement (not only he but also his students were...)

a speech or essay about giving back by mentoring the next generation; mentoring program terms (залуу үе, дэмжлэг үзүүлэх, туршлага хуваалцах, сайн дурын, хөтөлбөр); MN using all three structures to write a reflective paragraph in a formal style; EN choosing between not only... but also and as well as + -ing for formal emphasis and variety

units.scope: bureaucratic jargon, fine print, doctor-speak, plain-language reform; register terms; simplifying periphrastic official verbs (шийдвэрлэх ажлыг зохион байгуулах → шийдэх); EN: prepositional passives (is being looked into)

lessons.focus: reading a bank loan agreement and phone contract terms; contract jargon (нөхцөл, заалт, үүрэг хариуцлага, алданги); spotting periphrastic official verbs (хүсэлт гаргах, төлбөр төлөх ажлыг гүйцэтгэх) / EN: recognizing prepositional passives in contracts (will be charged for, is referred to as)

lessons.title_en: What Did the Doctor Just Say?
lessons.focus: decoding a diagnosis and discharge note; medical jargon vs everyday words (цусны даралт ихсэх → даралт ихтэй, эмчилгээ хийлгэх); rewriting doctor-speak as plain Mongolian / EN: prepositional passives with care verbs (is being looked after, was operated on)

official notices about utilities and permits; bureaucratic register terms (албан бичиг, шийдвэрлэх, хэрэгжүүлэх, зохион байгуулах); simplifying stacked verbs (шийдвэрлэх ажлыг зохион байгуулах → шийдэх) / EN: present continuous prepositional passives (is being looked into, is being dealt with)

editing a ministry press release for the public; register terms (албан хэллэг, ярианы хэв, ойлгомжтой, товч тодорхой); replacing nominal chains (-ын асуудлыг хэлэлцэх → ярилцах) / EN: perfect and modal prepositional passives (has been taken care of, must be paid for)

lessons.title_mn: Албан тушаалтнууд яагаад ингэж ярьдаг вэ
lessons.focus: discussing how jargon hides responsibility and creates distance; vagueness and accountability terms (бүрхэг, хариуцлагаас зугтах, тодорхойгүй); periphrastic passives that hide the agent (арга хэмжээ авагдах) vs active plain verbs / EN: agentless prepositional passives (the matter was not followed up on, it was frowned upon)

debating a plain-language law for public documents and forms; reform and policy terms (шинэчлэл, стандарт, иргэнд ээлтэй, хүртээмж); full rewriting of official texts with simplified verbs as a review / EN: prepositional passives in argument (should be done away with, is widely looked down on)

units.scope: late for work, missed buses, explaining delays; punctuality terms; MN past perfect -сан байсан, -чихсан байлаа; EN: past perfect continuous (had been waiting)

lessons.focus: texting your boss or a friend that you're late; punctuality words (хоцрох, цагтаа, цагаасаа өмнө, on time, in time); MN хоцорсон байна vs хоцорлоо, EN review of past simple vs past perfect with already/just

missing the bus or the morning shuttle in Ulaanbaatar; stop and schedule terms (буудал, хуваарь, сүүлчийн автобус); MN past perfect -сан байсан for an earlier past event, EN past perfect had + past participle

lessons.title_en: I Had Been Waiting for an Hour
lessons.focus: complaining about long waits in traffic jams and at stops; duration and traffic words (түгжрэл, удаан, бүтэн цаг); MN -аад байсан / -ж байсан for ongoing past action, EN past perfect continuous had been + -ing with for/since

oversleeping and morning mishaps; alarm, sleep and rush words (сэрүүлэг, унтаж хэтрэх, яарах); MN completive past perfect -чихсан байлаа (унтчихсан байлаа), EN past perfect continuous vs past perfect simple

giving reasons and apologizing politely at work or class; excuse and apology phrases (уучлаарай, шалтгаан, санамсаргүй); MN past perfect with causal -сан учраас / -чихсан болохоор, EN because/so + had been -ing

a story of a disastrous late morning and promises to be punctual; review of punctuality vocabulary; MN combined narrative with -сан байсан and -чихсан байлаа, EN narrative mixing past simple, past perfect and past perfect continuous

units.title_mn: Энэ долоо хоногт халуун ус байхгүй
units.scope: UB summer hot-water shutoffs, public bathhouses, heating water at home; plumbing terms; -хад хүрэх, -хаас өөр гарцгүй; EN: make do with, do without, end up + -ing

lessons.focus: reading the district heating company's summer shutoff notice and asking neighbors about dates; shutoff and repair terms (халуун ус хаах, засвар, дулааны шугам, хуваарь); review of -хаар төлөвлөгдсөн/-ын турш for schedules; EN: be due to / will be off for + duration

boiling water in kettles and pots and washing with a basin; household water vocabulary (данх, тогоо, сав, шанага, хүйтэн/бүлээн ус); -хаас өөр гарцгүй for having no other option; EN: make do with + noun

going to a public bathhouse (нийтийн халуун ус), buying a ticket, booking a private shower room, waiting in line; bathhouse terms (шүршүүр, тасалбар, алчуур, сауна, хувцас солих өрөө); -хад хүрэх for being driven to do something; EN: end up + -ing

a tap leaking when the water comes back and calling the plumber (сантехникч); plumbing terms (цорго, хоолой, гоожих, бөглөрөх, усны тоолуур, хаалт); -хад хүрэх and -хаас өөр гарцгүй in repair situations; EN: end up + -ing vs have to

coping strategies such as a quick cold shower, washing hair at a friend's place, using a water heater (бойлер); comfort and hygiene vocabulary (бойлер, хүйтэн усанд орох, угаах, тэвчих); combining -хаас өөр гарцгүй with -хгүйгээр; EN: do without + noun/-ing

telling a story about the shutoff week in a chat or short post, including complaints and humor; review of all unit vocabulary; -хад хүрэх and -хаас өөр гарцгүй in narrative; EN: make do with, do without and end up + -ing together

units.title_en: Sounds and Lights of the City
units.scope: construction noise, barking dogs, city lights at night; sound words; expressive verbs -лзах/-лзэх, -гнах/-гнэх (гялалзах, хангинах); EN: sound verbs (buzz, rattle, creak)

lessons.focus: complaining about construction noise in an apartment block; drills, hammers, trucks (өрөм, алх, чимээ шуугиан); -гнах/-гнэх sound verbs (дүнгэнэх, хангинах, тачигнах) in present -ж байна; EN: buzz, bang, rattle in present continuous

talking to neighbors and the khoroo about stray and chained dogs; animal sounds (хуцах, гаслах, ульх, мяулах); -лзах/-лзэх and -гнах for animal noises (гаслан уйлах, ёолгонох) with habitual -даг; EN: bark, howl, whine, growl with keep + -ing

noticing small sounds at home: old doors, pipes, windows in the wind; household sound words (чахрах, шажигнах, хоржигнох, дуслах); choosing -гнах vs -лзах for repeated vs continuous sounds; EN: creak, rattle, drip, hum

describing Ulaanbaatar at night from Zaisan or a rooftop; lights, signs, screens (гэрэл, неон, самбар, од); light verbs with -лзах/-лзэх (гялалзах, анивчих, гялтганах, түмэрлэх); EN: shine, flash, flicker, glow, sparkle

complaining about billboard glare and car headlights at night; light pollution and blackout curtains; expressive verbs as modifiers with -сан/-даг participles (гялалзсан самбар, анивчдаг гэрэл); EN: -ing adjectives from sound and light verbs (a flickering light, a buzzing sign)

describing a full city scene in a short story or post, morning to night; mixing sound and light words with ideophones (пид пад, жингэр жингэр); combining -лзах/-гнах verbs with converbs -ж/-аад in longer descriptions; EN: review of sound and light verbs with hear/see + object + -ing

units.scope: student council, team captain, event organizer, class leader; role terms; instrumental -аар for roles (ахлагчаар сонгогдох, багшаар ажиллах); EN: as + role, serve as, elect/appoint

lessons.focus: choosing a class leader at school or university; class roles (ангийн дарга, ахлагч, нарийн бичиг); instrumental -аар/-ээр/-оор with сонгогдох/сонгох (ахлагчаар сонгогдсон); EN: elect/choose + object + as/role noun

campaigning for student council at a university in Ulaanbaatar; election terms (нэр дэвших, санал өгөх, ерөнхийлөгч, гишүүн); -аар нэр дэвших, -аар томилогдох; EN: run for, be elected (as) president, zero article with unique roles

a basketball or wrestling team picks a captain; team roles (ахлагч, дасгалжуулагч, орлогч, хаалгач); instrumental -аар тоглох/ажиллах for positions (хамгаалагчаар тоглох); EN: as + role (play as, act as), appoint someone captain

lessons.title_mn: Наадмын арга хэмжээ зохион байгуулах нь
lessons.focus: volunteers organizing a school or khoroo Naadam event; event roles (зохион байгуулагч, сайн дурын ажилтан, хөтлөгч, шүүгч); -аар ажиллах, -ын үүрэг гүйцэтгэх; EN: serve as, work as, volunteer as
filling in for an absent teacher, manager, or MC; substitute roles (орлогч, түр үүрэг гүйцэтгэгч, туслах); -ыг орлон -аар ажиллах, түр -аар томилох; EN: take over as, stand in for, in the role of

a farewell speech by an outgoing leader reflecting on duties and successes; responsibility terms (бүрэн эрх, хариуцлага, залгамжлагч, хугацаа); mixing -аар ажиллах/сонгогдох/томилогдох in past narratives; EN: review of as + role, serve as, elected/appointed passives

units.scope: grazing rights, overgrazing, disputes over winter camps; land tenure terms; literary negation үл, эс (үл хөдлөх, эс зөвшөөрөх); EN: cause and result links (consequently, give rise to, as a result of which)

lessons.focus: A herder explains how pastures are shared in a soum; land tenure terms (бэлчээр, эзэмшил, ашиглах эрх, нийтийн өмч, газрын гэрчилгээ); fixed compounds with үл: үл хөдлөх хөрөнгө, үл мэдэгдэх; EN: cause and result with because of / as a result

A radio report on overgrazing and the cashmere boom; degradation terms (доройтол, даац хэтрэх, малын тоо толгой, цөлжилт); үл + verb for literary negation (үл тоох, үл ялиг); EN: consequently, therefore, as a consequence

Two families argue over an old winter camp site; camp and season terms (өвөлжөө, хаваржаа, зуслан, намаржаа, хашаа, отор); эс + verb in formal statements (эс зөвшөөрөх, эс хүлээн зөвшөөрөх); EN: give rise to, lead to, result in

A formal complaint and hearing at the soum office; administrative and legal terms (гомдол, шийдвэр, хил хязгаар, гэрээ, баг); contrasting эс vs -гүй and үл vs -хгүй in written vs spoken register; EN: as a result of which, owing to which, whereupon

Herders form a group to rotate pastures and rest the land; co-management terms (сэлгэх, амраах, хамтын менежмент, хэлэлцээр, дүрэм); set phrases with эс (эс бөгөөс, эс тэгвээс) as formal 'otherwise'; EN: thereby, hence, which is why

A policy debate essay on privatizing pastureland; policy terms (хувьчлал, нийтийн эзэмшил, тогтвортой байдал, хууль тогтоомж); review of үл/эс in argumentative writing (үл ойлголцол, эс тооцвол); EN: chaining cause and result links in a cohesive argument

units.scope: diaspora children, weekend Mongolian schools, code-switching at home; heritage language terms; minimal condition -ж л байвал, -аад л; EN: would rather/prefer + object + past or to-infinitive

lessons.focus: diaspora parents in Seoul, Chicago and Prague describe their children's Mongolian; heritage language terms (эх хэл, өв соёлын хэл, хос хэлтэй, хэл мартах); minimal condition -ж л байвал (гэртээ монголоор ярьж л байвал мартахгүй) / EN: would rather + subject + past (I'd rather you spoke Mongolian at home)

a weekend Mongolian school run by volunteers abroad; school and community terms (сайн дурын багш, сурах бичиг, анги дүүргэлт, нийгэмлэг); -аад л for minimal sufficient action (долоо хоногт нэг ирээд л ахиц гарна) / EN: would prefer + object + to-infinitive (I'd prefer the kids to learn Cyrillic first)

families mixing Mongolian with English, Korean or Czech at home; code-switching terms (хэл хольж ярих, зээлсэн үг, хэлний шилжилт, аялга алдах); contrasting -ж л байвал with -вал for 'as long as' vs plain condition / EN: would rather + past vs would rather + bare infinitive (I'd rather not / I'd rather they didn't)

children keeping contact with grandparents in Mongolia, stories, songs and Tsagaan Sar greetings online; intergenerational transmission terms (үе дамжих, ам дамжсан үлгэр, ёс заншил, холбоо тасрах); -аад л байвал / -аад л байхад chained with results (утсаар ярьсаар л байвал) / EN: would prefer + object + not to / would rather + object + didn't in polite family requests

lessons.title_en: Debating Language Policy for the Diaspora
lessons.title_mn: Гадаад дахь монголчуудын хэлний бодлогын хэлэлцүүлэг
lessons.focus: state support, online textbooks, the Mongolian script abroad, embassy programs; policy terms (хэлний бодлого, цахим сургалт, уламжлалт монгол бичиг, дэмжлэг үзүүлэх); minimal condition in formal argument (хөтөлбөр хэрэгжиж л байвал, санхүүжүүлээд л орхивол хангалтгүй) / EN: formal would prefer that + subjunctive vs would rather in discussion

a young adult raised abroad reflects on losing and regaining Mongolian; identity and belonging terms (өвөрмөц байдал, харьяалал, хэлээ сэргээх, ичих сэтгэл); review of -ж л байвал and -аад л in a reflective narrative / EN: review of would rather/prefer + object + past or to-infinitive in personal reflection

units.scope: removing and raising statues, renaming streets, public memory debates; commemoration terms; -ын нэрэмжит, -ын дурсгалд зориулсан, -ын нэрээр нэрлэх; EN: named after, dedicated to, in memory of

lessons.title_en: Who Is This Street Named After?
lessons.focus: walking tour of central Ulaanbaatar asking about street and square names; naming vocabulary (гудамж, талбай, өргөн чөлөө, нэрэмжит, алдартан); -ын нэрэмжит as modifier and predicate; EN: named after vs named for
