describing monuments like the Sükhbaatar and Chinggis Khaan statues and the Zaisan memorial; commemoration terms (хөшөө, баримал, дурсгалын самбар, цогцолбор, сийлбэр); -ын дурсгалд зориулсан, -д зориулан босгосон; EN: dedicated to, erected in honor of

city council decisions to rename streets, schools and districts; renaming vocabulary (нэр өөрчлөх, хуучин нэр, шинэ нэр, шийдвэр гаргах); -ын нэрээр нэрлэх, -ыг ... гэж нэрлэх, passive нэрлэгдэх; EN: be renamed, formerly known as, object complements with rename

the removal of the Lenin statue in 2012 and other socialist-era monuments; removal and relocation terms (буулгах, нүүлгэх, сэргээн засварлах, түүхэн өв, бэлгэдэл); combining -ын дурсгалд зориулсан with passive -гд- and causative forms; EN: in memory of vs in honor of, passive with modals (should be removed)

public debate about which figures to honor, socialist and democratic heroes, local vs national memory; debate and memory terms (олон нийтийн санаа бодол, маргаан, үнэлэмж, мартагдах, нийтийн ой санамж); contrasting -ын нэрэмжит, -ын дурсгалд, -ын нэрээр in argumentation; EN: commemorate, honor, pay tribute to with nuance

writing a formal proposal to the district for a memorial or named park; formal commemoration register (санаачлага, зохион байгуулах, нээлтийн ёслол, мөнхжүүлэх); integrating all three naming and dedication structures in written register; EN: formal proposal phrasing with named after, dedicated to, in memory of

units.scope: wrestling ranks, title ceremonies, champions' retirements, praise chants; title and epithet terms; genitive chains and stacked titles (улсын дархан аварга); EN: complex premodification (three-time national champion)

lessons.title_en: From Falcon to Titan: The Wrestling Ranks
lessons.focus: Explaining the Naadam ranking ladder to a foreign friend; rank terms (начин, харцага, заан, гарьд, арслан, аварга, улсын/аймгийн/сумын); MN: basic genitive and attributive noun chains (улсын заан, аймгийн арслан) / EN: noun modifiers before nouns (a provincial wrestling title)

Reading a champion's full title in a program and on a broadcast; epithets and title elements (дархан, даян, далай, түмний, үзэсгэлэнт); MN: ordering stacked titles (улсын дархан аварга, улсын даян аварга) / EN: complex premodification with numbers and hyphens (three-time national champion)

Listening to the засуул announce wrestlers and chant their titles; praise and chant vocabulary (цол дуудах, магтаал, засуул, эрэмгий, ган); MN: genitive chains with possessive -ын/-ийн in poetic praise lines (нутгийн минь бахархал) / EN: descriptive epithets and fronted adjective strings (the mighty, undefeated lion of the west)

Following a state title-granting ceremony and decree; ceremony terms (зарлиг, цол олгох, тэмдэг, жанжин, шагнал гардуулах); MN: long genitive chains in formal decree language (Монгол Улсын Ерөнхийлөгчийн зарлигаар) / EN: heavy noun phrases with post- and premodifiers in official announcements

Reading and discussing news of a great champion's farewell; career and legacy terms (зодог тайлах, ахмад бөх, амжилт, түрүүлэх, үүх түүх); MN: participle + genitive chains modifying titles (арван удаа түрүүлсэн улсын аварга) / EN: participial and compound premodifiers (record-breaking, long-serving, ten-time-winning)

Writing a tribute speech or article about a famous wrestler; evaluative and honorific vocabulary (алдар цуут, домогт, гавьяат, хүндэт); MN: combining stacked titles, epithets and genitive chains in polished written style / EN: varying premodification vs postmodification for clarity and rhythm

units.scope: buying winter meat, coal and bulk food; storage terms; measure words ширхэг, боодол, шуудай, толгой, гулууз; EN: compound nouns (meat supply, coal bag)

lessons.focus: buying a whole sheep or a beef carcass at the market in late autumn; meat cuts and carcass terms (гулууз, хонины мах, үхрийн мах, өвчүү, хавирга); measure words гулууз and толгой (хоёр гулууз мах, нэг толгой хонь); EN: noun + noun compounds (winter meat, sheep carcass)

ordering coal and firewood for a ger-district home; fuel terms (нүүрс, түлээ, шахмал түлш, тонн, машин); measure word шуудай with numbers and prices (арван шуудай нүүрс, шуудай нь хэд вэ); EN: compound nouns with materials and containers (coal bag, firewood pile)

buying bulk staples at a wholesale store; dry goods (гурил, будаа, гоймон, элсэн чихэр, тос, давс); measure words шуудай, боодол and ширхэг contrasted (нэг шуудай гурил, гурван боодол гоймон, таван ширхэг лааз); EN: container compounds vs of-phrases (a flour sack vs a sack of flour)

lessons.title_en: Where Do We Keep It All?
lessons.focus: storing food through winter in the storage shed, balcony, cellar and freezer; storage terms (агуулах, зоорь, хөлдөөгч, саравч, хадгалах, хөлдөх, муудах); measure words with locations and the passive (тагтан дээр хоёр гулууз мах хадгалагдаж байна); EN: compound nouns for places and devices (storage shed, meat freezer, food cellar)

sharing the cost of a countryside meat and dairy order sent by herding relatives; distribution terms (хуваах, хувь, тус бүр, нийт, үлдэгдэл); distributive measure phrases (айл бүрт нэг гулууз, хүн тус бүр хоёр шуудай); EN: compound nouns in plural and possessive (meat orders, the family's coal supply)

checking the household winter list and planning how long supplies will last; preparation and quantity vocabulary review (нөөц, хүрэлцэх, дутах, хангалттай); combining all measure words with approximation (гурван сар орчим хүрэлцэнэ, арав гаруй шуудай); EN: multi-word compounds and stress (winter food supply list, coal delivery truck)

units.scope: addressing elders, strangers, teachers and bosses; address terms ах, эгч, дүү; vocative аа/ээ/оо/өө and минь; EN: terms of address (sir, ma'am, Mr./Ms., first-name basis)

lessons.focus: stopping strangers on the street and in shops; kinship-based address terms ах, эгч, дүү for non-relatives by apparent age; EN: excuse me, sir/ma'am vs. calling people 'brother/sister'

calling out to friends, children and neighbors in the yard; names and address words as vocatives; vocative particles аа/ээ/оо/өө by vowel harmony (Болд оо, эгч ээ, дүү гээ) and when to drop them; EN: Hey, Bold! / Hi there, intonation for calling names

visiting grandparents and greeting elderly herders; respectful terms ээж, аав, өвөө, эмээ, настан for unrelated elders; та and polite verb forms with elders; EN: polite address to older people (sir, ma'am, Mr./Mrs. + surname)
school and university classrooms; addressing teachers and lecturers (багш аа, профессор оо) and classmates; vocative with titles vs. names; EN: Mr./Ms./Dr./Professor + surname, Miss vs Ms.

lessons.title_en: At the Office: Boss or First Name?
lessons.title_mn: Ажил дээр: дарга уу, нэрээр нь уу?
lessons.focus: new job, emails and meetings with managers; workplace address terms дарга, захирал, name + ах/эгч, name + гуай; switching from та to чи; EN: first-name basis, 'Call me...', Dear Mr./Ms. in emails

family talk, songs and letters to loved ones; affectionate address хүү минь, охин минь, ээж ээ минь, хайрт минь; vocative-possessive минь combined with аа/ээ; EN: terms of endearment (honey, sweetie, buddy) and when they're appropriate

units.scope: coffee chains, studying in cafés, baristas, loyalty apps; café vocabulary; light-verb phrases (захиалга өгөх, шийдвэр гаргах); EN: will for present assumptions (That'll be my order)

lessons.focus: ordering drinks at a UB coffee chain; coffee drinks, sizes, milk options; MN light verb захиалга өгөх/авах vs захиалах; EN: will for present assumptions (That'll be my latte)

studying and working in cafés, finding seats, Wi-Fi and outlets; café space and study vocabulary; MN light verbs анхаарал хандуулах, цаг гаргах; EN: will for assumptions about people (She'll be a student)

a barista's shift, making drinks, training; barista tools and brewing terms; MN light verbs туршлага хуримтлуулах, сургалт явуулах; EN: will for assumptions about the present situation (The machine'll be warming up)

loyalty apps, QR payments, promotions and discounts; app and reward vocabulary; MN light verbs бүртгэл үүсгэх, хөнгөлөлт эдлэх; EN: will/won't for assumptions with questions and negatives (That won't be the right code)

lessons.title_mn: Сүлжээ кафе юу, жижиг кафе юу?
lessons.focus: choosing between chains and independent cafés, prices, atmosphere; business and taste vocabulary; MN light verbs шийдвэр гаргах, сонголт хийх, санал өгөх; EN: will have + past participle for assumptions about the past (They'll have opened a new branch)

meeting friends and colleagues in cafés, small talk, splitting the bill; review of café vocabulary; mixed light-verb phrases (уулзалт хийх, тооцоо хийх, яриа өрнүүлэх); EN: review of will/will have for assumptions in conversation

units.scope: children's camps, packing, counselors, calls home; camp vocabulary; continuing imperatives -ж байгаарай, -ж байгаач; EN: articles with institutions (go to school vs the school)

lessons.focus: parents comparing summer camps near UB and in Terelj; camp types, sessions, fees, age groups (хүүхдийн зуслан, ээлж, бүртгэл); MN intro to -ж байгаарай as 'keep doing'; EN: go to camp / go to school vs the camp / the school

packing with a parent the night before; clothes, sleeping bag, flashlight, sunscreen, labels; MN -ж байгаарай for ongoing reminders (дулаан хувцасаа өмсөж байгаарай); EN: zero article with bed, school, camp (go to bed, at camp) vs the bed

arrival day, cabin groups, camp rules from the counselor; counselor, cabin, schedule, lights-out (зөвлөх багш, байр, унтах цаг); MN polite plural -ж байгаарай vs friendly -ж байгаач; EN: in hospital/in prison/at church vs the hospital/the church as buildings

activities: hiking, swimming, campfire, crafts, sports; activity and safety vocabulary; MN -ж байгаач in peer talk between kids (хамт явж байгаач); EN: have breakfast/lunch, go to the lake, the river, by bus with no article

phone calls with parents, homesickness, reassuring a child; feelings and news vocabulary (санах, дасах, гэрээ бодох); MN -ж байгаарай/-ж байгаач in caring farewells (сайн хооллож байгаарай, залгаж байгаач); EN: be at home vs the home, at work, in class

lessons.title_en: The Last Night and Going Home
lessons.focus: closing ceremony, saying goodbye to friends and counselors, pickup day; farewell and memory vocabulary; MN review of continuing imperatives for keeping in touch (холбоотой байж байгаарай); EN: review of institutional articles: back to school, the camp next summer

units.scope: DNA tests, hereditary diseases, debates on Mongol origins; genetics terms; literary хэмээх, хэмээн; EN: postpositive adjectives (the people concerned, the genes responsible)

lessons.focus: reading and discussing a home ancestry test report; DNA, gene, chromosome, ancestry percentages, haplogroup; literary хэмээх as 'called/known as' before nouns (гаплогрупп хэмээх ойлголт); EN: postpositive adjectives with 'concerned/involved' (the relatives involved)

talking with a genetic counselor about hereditary diseases; hereditary, mutation, carrier, risk, screening; хэмээн as quotative-descriptive converb (удамшлын өвчин хэмээн оношлох); EN: the genes responsible, the people affected

lessons.title_en: Where Did the Mongols Come From?
lessons.focus: a lecture on debates about Mongol origins; Xiongnu, Xianbei, migration, ancient DNA, steppe peoples; хэмээх in titles and named theories (Хүннү хэмээх нүүдэлчид); EN: postpositive adjectives after indefinite pronouns and with 'available/possible' (the best evidence available)

discussing the famous Y-chromosome study and media claims; lineage, descendant, Y-chromosome, sample, claim; хэмээн with reported claims and labels (удам хэмээн зарлах); EN: postpositive adjectives in time and quantity phrases (the period studied, the samples tested, ten years old)

debating who should own genetic data and testing ethics; consent, database, privacy, discrimination, biobank; contrasting хэмээх/хэмээн with neutral гэдэг/гэж in formal vs everyday register; EN: postpositive adjectives contrasted with prepositive meaning (the people present vs the present situation)

lessons.title_mn: Удам угсааны тухай шинжлэх ухааны нийтлэл
lessons.focus: writing and editing a popular-science article on genes and ancestry; genetics terms review and academic phrasing; consolidating хэмээх and хэмээн in written register; EN: combining postpositive adjectives and reduced phrases in formal writing (the communities concerned, the data available)

units.title_mn: Эрхтэн шилжүүлэн суулгалт ба биоёс зүй
units.scope: transplants, donor registries, end-of-life choices, cultural barriers; bioethics terms; formal connectives ингэснээр, ийнхүү, тийнхүү; EN: shell nouns (this issue, such a move)

lessons.focus: a patient on a transplant waiting list tells her story; transplant terms (эрхтэн шилжүүлэн суулгах, донор, хүлээгчдийн жагсаалт, бөөр, элэг); MN ингэснээр to link an action to its result / EN shell nouns this situation, this problem referring back to a described case

registering as a donor through E-Mongolia and a health center; registry and consent terms (бүртгэл, зөвшөөрөл, донорын карт, гэрээслэл); MN ийнхүү to sum up a sequence of steps / EN shell nouns with this/such: this decision, such a step

a family and doctors discuss brain death at the ICU; end-of-life terms (тархины үхэл, амьдрах чадварыг дэмжих аппарат, эмчилгээг зогсоох, хөнгөн үхэл); MN тийнхүү in formal narrative and reasoning / EN shell nouns + that-clause or to-infinitive: the fact that, the choice to

cultural and religious barriers: Buddhist beliefs, burial customs, family objections; belief and taboo terms (шарил, бүрэн бүтэн байх, оршуулга, хойд нас); contrasting ингэснээр vs ийнхүү vs тийнхүү / EN shell nouns expressing stance: this concern, such beliefs, the view that

policy debate on opt-in vs opt-out systems and organ trafficking abroad; bioethics and law terms (ёс зүй, хууль бус наймаа, таамаглалт зөвшөөрөл, шударга хуваарилалт); chaining formal connectives in argument / EN evaluative shell nouns: such a move, this approach, the problem with this

writing and presenting an op-ed on raising donation rates in Mongolia; review of bioethics vocabulary; integrating ингэснээр, ийнхүү, тийнхүү for cohesion / EN cohesion with shell nouns across paragraphs (this issue, these measures, such efforts)

units.scope: mobile banking, crypto, fintech startups, regulation; fintech terms; acronyms and abbreviations (ХХК, НӨАТ, ТББ, г.м.); EN: nouns from phrasal verbs (setback, takeover, breakdown)

lessons.focus: setting up a mobile banking app, QR payments and digital wallets; app and account terms (апп, данс, гүйлгээ, нэвтрэх код); MN reading common abbreviations г.м., ж.нь, төг.; EN nouns from phrasal verbs for everyday tech: login, setup, checkout, top-up

a young UB fintech team pitching to investors; startup and funding terms (хөрөнгө оруулагч, санхүүжилт, хэрэглэгчийн өсөлт); MN company and legal acronyms ХХК, ХК, ТББ and how to read them aloud; EN nouns from phrasal verbs in business: start-up, buyout, spin-off, takeover

lessons.title_en: Taxes, Fees and the Fine Print
lessons.focus: e-receipts, the VAT lottery and transaction fees; tax and fee terms (НӨАТ, шимтгэл, и-баримт, хураамж); MN declining acronyms with case endings (НӨАТ-ыг, ХХК-ийн, ТББ-д); EN nouns from phrasal verbs in finance: breakdown (of costs), payout, write-off, cutback

friends debating crypto investing, price crashes and hype; crypto terms (криптовалют, блокчэйн, хэтэвч, ханшийн хэлбэлзэл); MN Latin-letter loans and acronyms in Mongolian text (NFT, P2P, ICO) with Mongolian endings; EN nouns from phrasal verbs for market events: setback, comeback, sell-off, downturn

a bank outage, a hacked account and a phishing scam; security and incident terms (халдлага, луйвар, системийн доголдол, нууц үг сэргээх); MN official abbreviations in notices (СЗХ, МБ, ЦЕГ, д/д, №); EN nouns from phrasal verbs for problems: breakdown, shutdown, break-in, rip-off, follow-up

a policy panel on fintech regulation, licensing and financial inclusion for herders; regulation terms (зохицуулалт, тусгай зөвшөөрөл, хяналт, санхүүгийн хүртээмж); MN expanding and abbreviating names in formal writing (Санхүүгийн зохицуулах хороо (цаашид СЗХ гэх)); EN nouns from phrasal verbs in policy debate: crackdown, loophole vs workaround, rollout, backlash, outcome

units.scope: bankhar revival, wolves and herd protection, breeding programs; dog and predator terms; case stacking with reflexives (-ынхаа, -аасаа, -тайгаа); EN: no sooner... than, hardly... when

lessons.focus: a herder introduces her family's bankhar to visiting researchers; breed traits and dog anatomy terms (зузаан үс, дөрвөн нүдтэй, сүүл, хүзүүвч); genitive + reflexive -ынхаа/-ийнхаа (нохойнхоо, хотынхоо) vs plain -ын нь; EN: no sooner... than in past narration

a herder retells a night wolf attack on the sheepfold; predator and livestock-loss terms (чоно, сүрэг, хашаа, хэдэн толгой мал алдах, ул мөр); ablative + reflexive -аасаа/-ээсээ/-оосоо/-өөсөө (хашаанаасаа, сүргээсээ); EN: hardly/scarcely... when with inversion

a breeding-program officer explains how puppies bond with the herd; training and bonding terms (гөлөг, хурга ишигтэй хамт өсгөх, дасгах, итгэл); comitative + reflexive -тайгаа/-тэйгээ/-тойгоо (сүрэгтэйгээ, эзэнтэйгээ); EN: no sooner had... than vs as soon as

a radio interview on the bankhar revival project and its history; breeding and genetics terms (цэвэр үүлдэр, эрлийз, удам, үржүүлэг, бүртгэл); stacked cases with reflexives -даа/-доо, -аараа/-ээрээ (нутагтаа, удмаараа, гэрийнхээ); EN: hardly... when vs no sooner... than contrasted

a khoroo debate between herders and conservationists on wolf control; coexistence terms (махчин амьтан, агнах, хамгаалах, байгалийн тэнцвэр, хохирол нөхөх); combining reflexive case forms in argument (малаа хамгаалахын тулд, чононоосоо биш, нохойтойгоо); EN: inverted no sooner/hardly in formal argument

lessons.title_en: Placing a Dog with a Family
lessons.focus: an NGO report and a follow-up visit to a herding family who received a bankhar; review of dog, predator and breeding terms; full set of reflexive case stacking (-ынхаа, -аасаа, -тайгаа, -даа, -аа) in narrative writing; EN: review of no sooner... than and hardly... when in written reports

units.scope: wards, visiting hours, discharge, caring relatives; inpatient terms; ordinals -дугаар/-дүгээр for floors, rooms, wards; EN: within, during, throughout

lessons.focus: being admitted to a hospital ward; admission terms (хэвтэн эмчлүүлэх, тасаг, өрөө, ор, эмнэлгийн карт); ordinals -дугаар/-дүгээр for floors and rooms (гуравдугаар давхар, 305 дугаар өрөө); EN: ordinal numbers for floors, room/bed numbers

relatives visiting a patient, ward rules; visiting terms (эргэлт, эргэлтийн цаг, гадуур хувцас, бахил, жижүүр); ordinals with wards, beds and turns (хоёрдугаар тасаг, дөрөвдүгээр ор); EN: during + noun vs within + time period

daily routine in the ward; inpatient care terms (тариа, дусал, даралт үзэх, үзлэг, эмчлэгч эмч); ordinals for days of treatment and doses (гурав дахь өдөр, хоёрдугаар тун); EN: throughout the day/night/stay

a family member staying to look after a patient; caregiving terms (асрагч, сахиур, хоол авчрах, хажууд нь хонох); ordinals with -дугаар/-дүгээр vs -дахь in schedules (тав дахь шөнө, нэгдүгээр ээлж); EN: within vs during vs throughout contrasted

discharge, paperwork and home-care instructions; discharge terms (эмнэлгээс гарах, гарах бичиг, давтан үзлэг, эмийн жор, даатгал); ordinals in dates and follow-up instructions (сарын арван тавдугаар өдөр); EN: within + time for deadlines (within two weeks, within 24 hours)

lessons.title_en: Telling the Story of My Hospital Stay
lessons.focus: narrating a whole hospital stay to a friend; review of inpatient, visiting and discharge vocabulary; ordinals across floors, rooms, days and wards in connected narrative; EN: combining within, during, throughout in a past narrative

units.title_mn: Салон ба гоо сайхны чиг хандлага
units.scope: hair salons, nail studios, skincare, beauty trends; beauty vocabulary; colloquial intensifiers аймаар, гоё гэж жигтэйхэн, их л; EN: adjectives vs adverbs (good/well, quick/quickly)

lessons.focus: calling or messaging a salon to book a cut and describe the style you want; hair vocabulary (үс засуулах, богиносгох, будуулах, хуйлруулах, үзүүр); EN adjectives vs adverbs basics: a quick cut / cut it quickly, adjective after be vs adverb after action verbs

choosing colors and designs, gel vs regular polish, chatting with the nail artist; nail vocabulary (хумс, гель будаг, хээ, урт/богино хумс, засвар); MN intensifier их л (их л гоё, их л удаан) for mild emphasis; EN good vs well (good nails, she does them well)

describing daily skincare for dry winter skin in Ulaanbaatar; skincare vocabulary (чийгшүүлэгч тос, нарнаас хамгаалах тос, маск, хуурай/тослог арьс, батга); EN adverbs of manner from adjectives (gentle → gently, careful → carefully, -y → -ily) and their position after the object

reacting to friends' new hair, makeup and nails, giving compliments; appearance and compliment vocabulary (зохиж байна, гоё болжээ, шинэ янз, будалт); MN colloquial intensifiers аймаар (аймаар гоё) and гоё гэж жигтэйхэн; EN adverbs modifying adjectives (really pretty, incredibly natural, absolutely perfect)

discussing viral beauty trends, influencers and K-beauty products; trend vocabulary (трэнд, инфлюэнсер, тойм бичлэг, брэнд, байгалийн будалт); combining аймаар, их л, жигтэйхэн in casual talk and their register; EN linking verbs + adjective vs action verb + adverb (looks natural vs looks carefully, feels soft, smells nice)

complaining about a bad dye job or allergic reaction and asking for a fix or refund; problem vocabulary (буруу өнгө, харшил, тасархай, дахин хийх, мөнгөө буцааж авах); MN intensifiers in negative reactions (аймаар муу, их л удсан); EN tricky pairs: hard/hardly, late/lately, fast, and comparative adverbs (more carefully, faster)

units.scope: watching football and basketball, league games, fans, scores; match vocabulary; scores with instrumental and тэнцэх (3:1-ээр хожих); EN: tenses in live sports commentary

lessons.focus: checking the schedule and inviting friends to watch a game at home or in a sports bar; teams, leagues, fixtures (лиг, баг, тоглолт, улирал); MN -тай/-тэй тоглох for opponents; EN: present simple for timetabled games (The game starts at 8)

going to a basketball league game in Ulaanbaatar, tickets, seats and cheering; fan and venue vocabulary (хөгжөөн дэмжигч, тасалбар, талбай, шүүгч); MN voluntative cheers (Явцгаая!, Хожоорой!); EN: shouted chants and imperatives (Come on!, Let's go!)

asking for and giving scores during and after a match; goals, points, draws (гоол, оноо, тэнцээ); MN scores with instrumental and тэнцэх (3:1-ээр хожих, 2:2-оор тэнцэх, хожигдох); EN: reading scores aloud (three-one, two all, nil/zero)

following live TV and radio commentary of a football match; action verbs (дамжуулах, цохих, хамгаалах, торгууль); MN progressive -ж байна and quick past -лаа for live action; EN: present simple vs present continuous in live commentary

lessons.title_mn: Энэ чинь алдаа биш шүү дээ!
lessons.focus: arguing with friends about referee calls, fouls and missed chances; rules vocabulary (алдаа, шар хуудас, офсайд, торгуулийн цохилт); MN -х ёстой байсан, -сан бол for missed chances; EN: should have / would have in commentary and fan talk

summarizing a finished league game for a fan page or the news; results and standings (хүснэгт, тэргүүлэх, ялалт, ялагдал); MN result phrases -ын ачаар, -аар хожиж тэргүүллээ; EN: shifting tenses from live commentary to past-tense match reports

units.scope: ger etiquette, milking, evening chores, accepting food; hospitality terms; learning and habituation auxiliaries -ж сурах, -ж дасах; EN: offers with Shall I...? and Would you like me to...?

lessons.focus: arriving at a herder's ger and greeting the hosts; ger etiquette (тооно, хоймор, баруун/зүүн тал, босго, нохой хоргоо); MN -ж сурах for learned customs (босго гишгэхгүй байж сурсан); EN: Shall I...? for simple offers (Shall I take my shoes off?)

being served milk tea and dairy foods, accepting with the right hand, tasting before declining; hospitality terms (зочин, гэрийн эзэн, идээ, аяга, тавгийн идээ, амсах); MN -ж дасах with food and taste (ааруул идэж дасах); EN: Would you like me to...? vs Would you like...? (Would you like me to pour more tea?)

early-morning milking of cows, goats and mares with the host; milking terms (саах, сааль, тугал, унага, хувин, зэл, гүү); MN -ж сурах for skills in all tenses (саалж сурч байна, саалж сурлаа, саалж сурсан); EN: Shall I...? and Would you like me to...? for offering help with tasks

bringing the herd back, collecting dung fuel, fetching water, lighting the stove; chore terms (мал хотлох, аргал түүх, ус зөөх, зуух түлэх, хашаа); MN -ж дасах for getting used to routines and conditions (эрт босож дасах, хүйтэнд дасах); EN: Shall I...? vs Should I...? when asking what to do

talking with the family about days in the ger, sleeping on the floor, no internet, quiet nights; habituation and comfort terms (дасал, тав тух, нам гүм, ор дэвсгэр, сүлжээгүй); contrasting -ж сурах (skill) and -ж дасах (habituation), with negatives -ж дасаагүй, -ж сураагүй; EN: polite responses to offers (That would be great, Thanks, but I'm fine, Don't worry about it)

leaving the family, thanking hosts, gifts, promises to return, a short story of the stay; farewell and gratitude terms (бэлэг, ерөөл, сүү өргөх, дахин ирэх, сэтгэл); review of -ж сурах and -ж дасах in narrating the stay (энд ирээд мал саалгаж сурсан); EN: review of Shall I/Would you like me to offers and replies in a farewell dialogue

units.scope: traditional painting, Marzan Sharav, modern artists, art critique; painting terms; formal concessive хэдий ... боловч, боловч; EN: fixed subjunctive expressions (be that as it may, come what may)

lessons.focus: visiting a gallery of traditional painting; basic painting terms (будаг, бийр, даавуу, шугам, өнгө); MN боловч as a simple concessive linking two clauses; EN: be that as it may as a formal discourse linker

describing a crowded narrative painting by Sharav; scene and composition terms (зохиомж, дүрслэл, өнгө аяс, нарийн хийц); MN хэдий ... боловч with past participles (хэдий жижиг зураг боловч); EN: suffice it to say, so be it

a master explaining traditional materials and technique; materials terms (эрдэс будаг, алт мөнгөн шар, цавуу, суурь бэлтгэх); MN хэдий ч and -сан боловч in process descriptions; EN: come what may, whatever it takes

modern artists reinterpreting Mongol zurag; contemporary art terms (хийсвэр, сэдэв, хэв маяг, шинэчлэл, урсгал); MN хэдий ... боловч contrasting tradition and innovation; EN: far be it from me to..., if need be

writing a critic's review of an exhibition; critique terms (шүүмж, үнэлгээ, уран сайхны түвшин, сул тал, давуу тал); MN formal боловч vs гэвч/гэхдээ in written register; EN: be it X or Y, though it be

lessons.title_mn: Мэтгэлцээн: Монгол зураг өөрчлөгдөх ёстой юу?
lessons.focus: panel debate on preserving vs evolving the art form; heritage and market terms (өв соёл, хадгалах, арилжаа, жинхэнэ байдал); MN combining хэдий ... боловч with concessive chains in argument; EN: review of fixed subjunctives (be that as it may, come what may, God forbid, long live)

units.scope: doping scandals, sports bans, governing bodies, athletes' defenses; sports-integrity terms; -ын хэргээр шийтгэгдэх, -ыг далимдуулан; EN: accuse of, charge with, clear of, ban from

lessons.focus: a news report on a wrestler's failed doping test; doping terms (допинг, хориотой бодис, шээсний сорьц, эерэг хариу); MN -ын хэргээр сэжиглэгдэх/шалгагдах; EN accuse of + noun/-ing

how WADA, the Mongolian anti-doping agency and federations work; governing-body terms (холбоо, хороо, хяналт, зөвшөөрөл); MN -ыг далимдуулан for exploiting gaps in the rules; EN charge with vs accuse of
a federation announces sanctions and stripped medals; sanction terms (эрх хасах, медаль хураах, торгууль, шийтгэл); MN -ын хэргээр шийтгэгдэх, -аар хасагдах; EN ban from + -ing/noun, be stripped of

athletes defend themselves at a hearing with explanations and excuses; defense terms (нотлох баримт, санамсаргүй, давж заалдах, гэм буруугүй); MN -ыг далимдуулан for accusations of using loopholes, -сан гэж мэдэгдэх; EN deny + -ing, claim to have

an appeal at the Court of Arbitration for Sport and the verdict; appeal terms (арбитр, шийдвэр хүчингүй болох, цагаатгах, сэргээх); MN contrast of -ын хэргээр шийтгэгдэх and цагаатгагдах; EN clear of, acquit of, overturn a ban

a debate on integrity, pressure on athletes and the spirit of Naadam; ethics terms (шударга ёс, ёс зүй, нэр хүнд, итгэл); MN integrating -ын хэргээр шийтгэгдэх and -ыг далимдуулан in argument; EN review of accuse of / charge with / clear of / ban from in opinion writing

units.scope: parents' hopes, career and marriage pressure, personal choice; expectation terms; past obligation -х ёстой байсан, -сан нь дээр байсан; EN: be expected to, be under pressure to, live up to

lessons.focus: Adult children talk about the hopes their parents had for them (doctor, lawyer, staying close to home); hope and expectation terms (хүлээлт, найдвар, итгэл, хүсэл мөрөөдөл); EN: be expected to + infinitive / MN: -хыг хүлээж байсан, -на гэж найдаж байсан

A student argues with family over studying art instead of medicine; pressure and persuasion terms (шахалт, дарамт, ятгах, тулгах, зөвшөөрөл); EN: be under pressure to, feel pressured into + -ing / MN: -хыг шаардах, -уулах гэж шахах

Relatives at Tsagaan Sar ask about marriage and grandchildren; marriage-pressure terms (хань сонгох, айл болох, ач зээ, хэл ам, гадны нүд); EN: be supposed to vs be expected to, polite deflection / MN: -х ёстой байсан for missed expectations

lessons.title_mn: Үгийг нь сонссон нь дээр байсан болов уу?
lessons.focus: Looking back on decisions made against or for parents' advice; regret and hindsight terms (харамсал, эргэцүүлэл, зөрүүдлэх, буулт хийх); EN: should have / ought to have contrasted with be expected to / MN: -сан нь дээр байсан, -х ёстой байсан

lessons.title_en: Living Up to the Family Name
lessons.title_mn: Гэр бүлийнхээ нэрийг өндөрт өргөх нь
lessons.focus: The eldest child, the family business, and a famous parent's shadow; duty and reputation terms (ууган хүүхэд, үүрэг хариуцлага, нэр хүнд, урмыг хугалах, гутаах); EN: live up to, fall short of, let someone down / MN: -ын хүлээлтийг биелүүлэх, урмыг хугалах

A heartfelt conversation or letter setting boundaries with parents respectfully; autonomy terms (бие даасан байдал, хувийн сонголт, хил хязгаар, ойлголцол, хүндэтгэл); EN: review of be expected to / be under pressure to / live up to in a reflective text / MN: integrated -х ёстой байсан, -сан нь дээр байсан

units.scope: танил тал networks, returning favors, gift money at events, reciprocity norms; social-exchange terms; -ын хариуд, -ын ачийг хариулах; EN: in return for, in exchange for, on behalf of

lessons.focus: talking about танил тал networks when finding a job or a hospital doctor; network terms (танил, холбоо, хүрээ, найдвартай хүн); MN -ын хариуд basics; EN: in return for + noun/-ing

thanking someone who helped you move or get a document fast; gratitude and debt terms (ач тус, өртэй, талархал); MN -ын ачийг хариулах, -ын ачаар review; EN: owe someone a favor, repay, return the favor

deciding how much gift money to give at weddings, birthdays and Tsagaan Sar; gift-money terms (бэлэг мөнгө, дугтуй, хариу бэлэг, хэмжээ); MN -ын хариуд with gifts vs -д зориулж; EN: in exchange for vs in return for
attending an event or asking a favor for a relative or one's office; representation terms (төлөөлөх, нэрийн өмнөөс, итгэмжлэл); MN -ын өмнөөс, -ыг төлөөлж; EN: on behalf of vs instead of

debating when helping acquaintances becomes favoritism or bribery; ethics terms (ах дүүсэх, хээл хахууль, шударга бус давуу байдал); MN -ын хариуд in conditional and negative contexts (-ын хариуд юу ч хүлээхгүй); EN: in return for / in exchange for in formal and critical statements

a reflective essay on reciprocity norms in Mongolian and other cultures; social-exchange terms (харилцан ашиг, хариуцлага, итгэлцэл, ёс заншил); combining -ын хариуд, -ын ачийг хариулах, -ын өмнөөс; EN: in return for, in exchange for, on behalf of in extended writing

units.scope: weekend picnics, cooking khorkhog and boodog, gathering firewood, outdoor cooking steps; outdoor cooking terms; dependent-subject converbs -хаар нь, -хад нь, -аад нь (чулуу халахаар нь мах хийнэ); EN: wh-word + to-infinitive (how to light a fire, where to put the stones)

lessons.focus: friends plan a countryside picnic outside UB and decide who brings what; picnic gear and supplies (тогоо, сав, хутга, давс, гал асаагуур); MN -хаар нь introduced with simple time links (бүгд ирэхээр нь хөдөлнө); EN: wh-word + to-infinitive for planning (what to bring, where to go)

collecting firewood and dried dung and choosing a fire spot; fuel and fire terms (түлээ, аргал, хуурай мөчир, гал түлэх, утаа); MN -хад нь with a different subject (салхи намдахад нь гал түлье); EN: how to / where to + verb (how to light a fire, where to find dry wood)

preparing khorkhog: picking river stones and heating them in the fire; stone and heat vocabulary (голын чулуу, улайсах, халах, хавчуур, түлэгдэх); MN -хаар нь for conditions met by another subject (чулуу халахаар нь мах хийнэ); EN: when to / which to + infinitive (when to add the stones, which stones to use)

layering meat, stones, vegetables and water in the pot or milk can; outdoor cooking steps (давхарлах, таглах, бүлээн ус, жигнэх, сэгсрэх); MN -аад нь for sequenced actions with a different subject (мах болоод нь төмс нэмнэ); EN: wh-word + to-infinitive after know/explain/show (show me how to seal the lid)

making goat or marmot boodog with hot stones and a blowtorch; boodog terms (арьс, хуйх, үс түлэх, хайрах, хоолой боох); MN -хаар нь, -хад нь, -аад нь contrasted in one process (арьс нь хатаад нь хусна); EN: whether to + infinitive and question-word infinitives as objects (decide whether to use a blowtorch)

lessons.title_en: Sharing the Feast and Cleaning Up
lessons.focus: passing hot stones for luck, serving the meat, putting out the fire and leaving no trash; serving and outdoor etiquette terms (халуун чулуу барих, ам хүрэх, гал унтраах, хог ачих); review of -хаар нь, -хад нь, -аад нь in a full picnic story; EN: review of wh-word + to-infinitive in instructions and advice (what to do with the ashes)

units.scope: notes for house-sitters and babysitters, covering a colleague's shift, passing on the boss's orders; instruction and chore terms; reported commands and requests -аарай гэсэн, -аач гэж гуйсан, битгий ... гэж хэлсэн; EN: reported commands (told me to, asked us not to, warned him not to)

lessons.focus: leaving a written note for someone watching your apartment; household chores (цэцэг усалах, муур хооллох, хогоо гаргах, цонх хаах); MN polite imperatives -аарай/-ээрэй in notes and their reported form -аарай гэсэн; EN: tell someone to + verb

parents briefing a babysitter on bedtime, meals and screen time; childcare routine terms (унтуулах, хооллох, утас өгөх, хаалга түгжих); MN negative commands битгий ... гэж хэлсэн, -хгүй байгаарай; EN: tell/ask someone not to + verb

asking a colleague to cover a shift and passing on what to do; shift and handover terms (ээлж, орлох, хүлээлгэж өгөх, касс хаах, түлхүүр үлдээх); MN requests -аач/-ээч гэж гуйсан, -ж өгөөч гэсэн; EN: ask someone to + verb, ask if/whether

passing on the boss's orders at a team meeting; workplace task terms (тайлан гаргах, хурал товлох, хугацаа сунгах, мэдэгдэх); MN reported orders with -аарай гэсэн, -х хэрэгтэй гэсэн, -уулаарай гэсэн; EN: reported commands with told/ordered/instructed us to

relaying warnings about gas stoves, pets, fragile things and strangers at the door; warning and safety terms (хий, залгуур, эвдрэмтгий, танихгүй хүн); MN reported warnings битгий ... гэж анхааруулсан, -уузай гэсэн; EN: warn someone (not) to, remind someone to

lessons.title_en: Did You Do What I Asked?
lessons.focus: coming home and checking whether instructions were followed, explaining mix-ups; review of chore and instruction terms; MN contrasting гэсэн, гэж гуйсан, гэж хэлсэн, битгий ... гэсэн in questions and replies; EN: mixed reported commands, requests and warnings (You told me to... / You asked me not to...)

units.scope: small talk in UB taxis, fares, traffic, news and family talk with strangers; small-talk vocabulary; plural interrogatives by reduplication хэн хэн, юу юу, хаа хаана, хэдэн хэдэн; EN: subject vs object questions (Who called you? Who did you call?)

lessons.title_en: Getting In and Setting the Fare
lessons.focus: flagging a car or ride-hailing in UB and agreeing on a price per kilometer; fare and route words (километр, тохирох, буулгах, шууд явах); MN хэн хэн/юу юу introduced for plural answers (Хэн хэн суух вэ?); EN subject questions with who (Who is getting out first?)

complaining together about traffic jams, the even-odd plate rule (тэгш сондгой) and roadworks; traffic small-talk words (түгжрэл, гэрлэн дохио, тойруу зам, дугаарын хязгаарлалт); MN хаа хаана for multiple places (Хаа хаана зам засвартай байна?); EN subject vs object questions with what (What caused the jam? What did they close?)

the driver asks about your hometown and countryside relatives; origin and hometown words (нутаг, аймаг, сум, нутаг усны хүн); MN хэн хэн and хаа хаана in personal questions (Хэн хэн чинь хөдөө байдаг вэ?); EN who-questions with prepositions (Who do you live with? Who lives with you?)

answering questions about marriage, children and work politely or avoiding them; family small-talk words (хүүхэд, ач зээ, гэрлэх, тэтгэвэр); MN хэдэн хэдэн and юу юу for listing (Юу юу сурдаг вэ? Хэдэн хэдэн настай вэ?); EN which/whose as subject vs object (Whose son works abroad? Whose car did you borrow?)

chatting about radio news, prices and politics without arguing; news and opinion words (үнийн өсөлт, сонгууль, шинэ хууль, ярьж байна лээ); MN юу юу and хэн хэн in news questions (Юу юу үнэтэй болсон бэ? Хэн хэн сонгогдсон бэ?); EN subject vs object questions in the past (Who won? Who did people vote for?)

full ride review: giving last directions, paying by cash or QPay, change and a friendly goodbye; drop-off and payment words (хариулт, шилжүүлэх, энд зогсоорой, сайхан ажиллаарай); MN review of all plural interrogatives in one conversation; EN mixed subject and object questions for retelling the ride (Who paid? What did the driver say?)

units.scope: e-scooter rentals, bike lanes, helmets, breakdowns and dead batteries in UB; micro-mobility terms; frustrated attempts -х гэхээр, -х гэтэл (асаах гэтэл асахгүй); EN: will/would for refusal (it won't start, the lock wouldn't open)

lessons.focus: unlocking a rental scooter with an app near Sükhbaatar Square; scooter and app terms (түрээс, QR код, цэнэг, түгжээ); -х гэтэл for unexpected results (түгжээ тайлах гэтэл апп ажиллахгүй); EN: won't for present refusal (the app won't open)

riding through UB traffic, cars parked in bike lanes; road terms (дугуйн зам, явган хүний зам, уулзвар, гэрлэн дохио); -х гэтэл with blocked actions (зам руу орох гэтэл машин зогсчихсон); EN: wouldn't for past refusal (the driver wouldn't move)

convincing a friend to wear a helmet, night lights, falls; safety gear terms (дуулга, гэрэл, тусгал, тохойн хамгаалалт); -х гэхээр for failed attempts (дуулга өмсүүлэх гэхээр өмсөхгүй); EN: will/won't for people's refusal (he won't wear a helmet)

a scooter dying on the way home, finding a charging point; battery terms (батарей, цэнэглэх, цэнэглэгч, асаах, унтрах); -х гэтэл with negative result (асаах гэтэл асахгүй); EN: it won't start / it wouldn't turn on

flat tires, slipping chains, brakes at a repair shop; bike parts (дугуй, гинж, тоормос, хүрд, суудал, хийлэх); -х гэхээр vs -х гэтэл in describing repeated failure (гинж тавих гэхээр мулталчихдаг); EN: would/wouldn't for repeated past refusal (the chain wouldn't stay on)

debating rentals, parking chaos and rules in the city; micro-mobility policy terms (бичил тээвэр, зогсоол, торгууль, журам); combining -х гэтэл and -х гэхээр in complaints and stories; EN: review of will/would for refusal in people and machines

units.title_mn: Их засаг ба заншлын эрх зүй
units.scope: Chinggis Khaan's Ikh Zasag, Khalkh Juram, customary law and modern codes; legal history terms; archaic legal formulas in reading (-вээс ... торгоно, ялла, болой); EN: shall and whereas in legal and constitutional texts

lessons.title_en: The Great Law of the Steppe
lessons.focus: museum talk on Chinggis Khaan's Ikh Zasag and how it survives only in later sources; legal history terms (хууль цааз, зарлиг, засаг, шийтгэл); MN reading archaic conditional -вээс/-ваас in law clauses (хулгай хийвээс); EN: shall for binding rules (Every man shall...)

reading penalty clauses where fines are counted in horses and cattle (есөн мал, есөөр торгох); fines and offenses vocabulary (торгууль, гэм, хулгай, мал); MN formula -вээс ... торгоно with numeral fines; EN: shall be liable to / shall pay in penalty clauses

lessons.title_en: Khalkh Juram: Law of the Khalkha
lessons.focus: seminar on the 18th-century Khalkh Juram, monasteries and noble courts; customary law terms (ёс заншил, журам, ноён, тамга); MN archaic imperative and decree forms ялла, болой, буюу in reading; EN: shall vs will vs must in legal drafting

comparing the 1924, 1940 and 1992 constitutions' preambles; constitutional terms (оршил, бүгд найрамдах, бүрэн эрхт, тусгаар тогтнол); MN formal preamble style -ын үүднээс, эрхэмлэн дээдэлж; EN: whereas clauses and preamble structure

debate over customary practices (herders' disputes, pasture rights) in modern Civil and Criminal Codes; legal comparison terms (заалт, хүчин төгөлдөр, эрх зүй, шүүх); MN rendering archaic formulas into modern Mongolian (-вээс → -сан тохиолдолд, болой → болно); EN: whereas as contrast vs shall-less modern plain drafting

students draft a club charter mixing old-style and modern legal language; drafting vocabulary (зүйл, хэсэг, батлах, хүчингүй болгох); MN combining reading formulas with modern -х ёстой, -хыг хориглоно; EN: full charter with whereas recitals, shall clauses and shall not prohibitions

units.scope: analyzing Mongolian and world auteur films, festival reviews, directors' styles; film criticism terms; paired verbs хийж бүтээх, ярьж хөөрөх, бодож санах, үзэж харах; EN: verbless and reduced adverbial clauses (Once inside, If in doubt, Though flawed)

lessons.focus: discussing a director's signature style after a screening; auteur, signature style, recurring themes, vision (уран бүтээлч, өвөрмөц хэв маяг, давтагдах сэдэв); MN paired verb хийж бүтээх (кино хийж бүтээсэн найруулагч); EN: reduced time clauses with when/while + -ing or past participle (When interviewed, While filming)

analyzing camera work and composition in a steppe film; shot, long take, framing, lighting, mise-en-scène (кадр, урт зураглал, гэрэлтүүлэг, найруулга); MN paired verb үзэж харах (үзэж харахад анзаарагдах); EN: verbless clauses with once/if/when + adjective or prepositional phrase (Once inside, When in doubt)

comparing talkative and silent characters in Mongolian and world cinema; dialogue, subtext, pacing, monologue (харилцан яриа, далд утга, хэмнэл, монолог); MN paired verb ярьж хөөрөх (дүрүүд ярьж хөөрөх хэсэг); EN: reduced concessive clauses with though/although + adjective (Though flawed, Although brief)

interpreting flashbacks and nostalgia in a film about a childhood in the countryside; flashback, nonlinear plot, symbolism, motif (буцаан харуулах, шугаман бус өрнөл, бэлгэдэл, сэдэл); MN paired verb бодож санах (баатрын бодож санасан зүйл); EN: reduced conditional clauses with if/unless + past participle (If viewed closely, Unless stated otherwise)

writing a short festival review of a Mongolian entry at an international festival; premiere, jury, competition program, critical acclaim (нээлт, шүүгчид, уралдаант хөтөлбөр, шүүмжлэгчдийн өндөр үнэлгээ); MN combining all four paired verbs in review style; EN: participle and verbless openers in reviews (Visually stunning, the film..., Shot in Gobi-Altai, ...)

debating a divisive auteur film in a critics' panel; verdict, pretentious, ambitious, masterpiece, overrated (дүгнэлт, дэмий сүржин, зоримог, шилдэг бүтээл, хэт өргөмжлөгдсөн); MN review of paired verbs in balanced argument; EN: review of verbless and reduced adverbial clauses in argument (Whether intended or not, Where possible, Though admired by many)

units.scope: child labor in informal mining, protection laws, child helplines, NGO reports; child-protection terms; case government of verbs -аар хангах, -аас хамгаалах, -ыг хамгаалах, -д хамруулах; EN: putative should (it is shocking that a child should work, should you need help)

lessons.focus: reading a news feature on children in informal 'ninja' gold mining; child labor and hazard terms (хүүхдийн хөдөлмөр, бичил уурхай, хөдөлмөрийн мөлжлөг); MN -аас хамгаалах (аюулаас хамгаалах) vs -ыг хамгаалах (хүүхдийг хамгаалах); EN: putative should after adjectives (it is shocking that a child should work)

discussing the Law on Child Protection and the minimum working age; legal protection terms (хүүхэд хамгааллын хууль, хөдөлмөр эрхлэх насны доод хязгаар, хууль ёсны төлөөлөгч); MN -аар хангах (хүүхдийг боловсролоор хангах) with institutional subjects; EN: putative should after nouns of judgment (it is a disgrace that, the fact that... should)

a child helpline call and a counselor's guidance; reporting and support terms (хүүхдийн тусламжийн утас, мэдээлэл өгөх, нууцлал хадгалах, сэтгэл зүйн зөвлөгөө); MN -д хамруулах (зөвлөгөөнд хамруулах, үйлчилгээнд хамруулах); EN: conditional inversion with should (Should you need help, call 108)

analyzing an NGO report's findings and recommendations; research and advocacy terms (судалгааны үр дүн, эрсдэлт бүлэг, хүүхдийн эрхийн хамгаалагч, зөвлөмж); MN contrasting -аар хангах, -д хамруулах, -аас хамгаалах in report sentences; EN: putative should after verbs of surprise and regret (it is worrying that so few should be reported)

lessons.title_mn: Мал маллах уу, туслах уу, ажиллах уу?
lessons.focus: debating where family herding chores end and child labor begins, including child jockeys; household-work and welfare terms (гэр бүлийн ажилд туслах, хүнд хөдөлмөр, хүүхдийн сайн сайхан байдал); MN choosing the governed case: хүүхдийн эрхийг хамгаалах, хүнд ачааллаас хамгаалах, хамгааллын үйлчилгээнд хамруулах; EN: putative should vs plain indicative (it's natural that children should help vs it's true that children help)

drafting a formal public statement and appeal for June 1 Children's Day; policy and pledge terms (хамтын хариуцлага, үйлчилгээний хүртээмж, нийгмийн халамж); MN combining all four case patterns in formal written register; EN: integrating putative should in formal appeals (It is unacceptable that..., Should any child be at risk...)

units.title_en: Radio, Podcasts and the Spoken Word
units.scope: Mongolian radio history, podcasts, voice acting, audiobooks; broadcasting and voice terms; written vs pronounced Mongolian (reduced vowels, unwritten vowels, spoken contractions in scripted speech); EN: stress shift in noun-verb pairs (REcord/reCORD) and weak forms

lessons.focus: Hearing the story of Mongolian National Radio and the first broadcasts; broadcasting terms (эфир, нэвтрүүлэг, хөтлөгч, долгион, шууд дамжуулалт); MN: written vs pronounced long and short vowels in announcer speech (reduced non-initial vowels); EN: stress shift in noun-verb pairs (REcord/reCORD, PREsent/preSENT)

Planning and recording a podcast episode with a co-host; podcast and recording terms (бичлэг, дугаар, микрофон, засварлах, сонсогч); MN: unwritten epenthetic vowels heard in clusters (бичлэг [бичилэг], хөтлөгч, ажлаа); EN: more noun-verb stress pairs (CONtract/conTRACT, INcrease/inCREASE, OBject/obJECT)

Reading a radio script aloud and spotting how scripted speech sounds natural; voice and delivery terms (өнгө аяс, хэмнэл, дуудлага, амьсгаа, тодотгол); MN: spoken contractions inside scripts (байгаа юм → байгаам, гэж байна → гэжийна, юу вэ → юу юм бэ reductions); EN: weak forms of function words (to, for, and, can, was) in natural reading

Auditioning as a voice actor for dubbing a cartoon and a Korean drama; voice-acting terms (дуу оруулах, хадмал, дүр, дубляж, найруулагч); MN: contrasting careful vs casual pronunciation of case endings and verb suffixes (-ыг/-ийг, -сан, -лаа) in dialogue; EN: strong vs weak forms in contrast and emphasis (I CAN come / I can [kən] come)

Narrating an audiobook of a Mongolian novel and discussing listeners' habits; audiobook and narration terms (аудио ном, уншигч, өгүүлэгч, бүлэг, сонсголт); MN: reading literary text aloud: written forms vs standard pronunciation (word-final vowels, ь/ъ, long vowels in suffixes); EN: weak forms in auxiliaries and pronouns in connected speech (have, has, them, him)

Debating the future of radio vs podcasts and standard announcer Mongolian; media and pronunciation-norm terms (уран яриа, утга зохиолын хэлний дуудлага, аялга, сонсогдох байдал); MN: review of reduced vowels, unwritten vowels and contractions across registers; EN: review of stress shift and weak forms, incl. stress shift with suffixes (PHOtograph/phoTOgraphy)

units.scope: measuring rooms for furniture, buying rugs, children's height, egg-sized hail; units of length and weight; size comparison -ын чинээ, -тай чацуу, -ын хэмжээтэй; EN: dimension phrases (two meters wide, the size of an egg, a ten-minute walk)

lessons.focus: measuring a room and furniture before buying; units of length (метр, сантиметр, урт, өргөн, өндөр); MN dimension phrases with -тай/-тэй (гурван метр урттай); EN: two meters wide, five feet long

buying a rug at a shop or market; area and shape terms (талбай, квадрат метр, дөрвөлжин, дугуй); size match -ын хэмжээтэй (өрөөний хэмжээтэй хивс); EN: hyphenated dimension adjectives (a two-by-three-meter rug)

measuring children's height at home and at checkups; height and growth vocabulary (өндөр, өсөх, хэмжих, жин); equal size -тай чацуу (ахтайгаа чацуу болсон); EN: as tall as, up to my shoulder, comparison phrases

lessons.title_en: Hail the Size of an Egg
lessons.focus: describing sudden hail and storm damage; everyday size objects (өндөг, нударга, будаа, самар); approximate size -ын чинээ (алганы чинээ); EN: the size of an egg, as big as a fist
weighing produce, parcels and luggage; units of weight (грамм, килограмм, тонн, жинлэх, хүнд, хөнгөн); MN weight phrases with -ын жинтэй, -аар жинлэх; EN: a five-kilo bag, weigh vs weight

describing distances and sizes when giving directions or reviewing places; mixed measurement review (зай, километр, алхам); combining -ын чинээ, -тай чацуу, -ын хэмжээтэй; EN: compound measure adjectives with no plural (a ten-minute walk, a three-hour drive)

units.scope: class meetings, report cards, behavior, parents' group chats; school-and-parent terms; explaining reasons with учир нь, яагаад гэвэл ... юм; EN: too/also/as well/either and their position

lessons.focus: reading a teacher's meeting announcement and replying to confirm attendance; school-and-parent terms (анги удирдсан багш, эцэг эхийн хурал, ирц, хуваарь); MN учир нь to explain why a meeting is called / EN also and too in basic positions (I'll also come, My husband is coming too)

discussing a child's report card with the teacher; grades and subjects vocabulary (дүн, улирлын шалгалт, гэрийн даалгавар, ахиц); MN яагаад гэвэл ... юм for giving reasons / EN as well at the end of a clause vs also before the main verb

the teacher raises a behavior problem and the parent responds; behavior terms (хичээл таслах, хоцрох, зодолдох, сахилга бат, анхааруулга); MN учир нь vs яагаад гэвэл ... юм when explaining a child's actions / EN either in negative sentences (He didn't do his homework either)

following and writing messages in a class parents' chat about fees, trips and reminders; chat and class-fund terms (ангийн сан, хандив, мэдэгдэл, зураг хуваалцах); MN short written reasons with учир нь in informal messages / EN too and also in casual writing (Me too, Same here, us as well)

a one-on-one talk about a struggling child, home situation and support; learning-support terms (хоцрогдол, нэмэлт хичээл, сэтгэл зүйч, анхаарал төвлөрөл); MN polite fuller reasons with яагаад гэвэл ... юм and тийм учраас / EN position of also with be, modals and auxiliaries (She is also shy, He can also stay after class)

telling a spouse or grandparent what was said and agreeing on next steps at home; review of school-and-parent terms and decisions (шийдвэр, санал, хамтран ажиллах); MN combining учир нь and яагаад гэвэл ... юм in a short account / EN contrast and review of too, also, as well and either including Neither/Me neither replies

units.scope: showing elders apps, video calls, QPay, teaching kids to ride bikes; step and gesture vocabulary; manner words ингэж, тэгж, яаж, ийм маягаар; EN: by + -ing, the way (that) + clause

lessons.focus: showing a grandparent how to unlock a phone and open apps; screen and gesture verbs (дарах, гүйлгэх, удаан дарах, томруулах, буцах); manner words ингэж, тэгж with imperatives; EN: imperatives + like this / like that

lessons.title_en: How Do I Call You on Video?
lessons.title_mn: Чам руу видеогоор яаж залгах вэ?
lessons.focus: setting up video calls with relatives abroad and in the countryside; call vocabulary (камер, дуу хаах, чанга яригч, сүлжээ тасрах); asking about manner with яаж, яаж ... -х вэ; EN: How do I...? + by + -ing answers (by tapping the green button)

teaching an elder to pay at a shop and send money by QR code; payment step terms (QR уншуулах, дүн оруулах, гүйлгээ батлах, нууц код); sequenced steps эхлээд, дараа нь with -аад and manner ийм маягаар; EN: by + -ing for method (pay by scanning the code)

correcting mistakes patiently, repeating steps, staying calm; patience and mistake vocabulary (андуурах, дахиад, аажуухан, санаа зоволтгүй); contrast ингэж ... биш, тэгж хийвэл, ийм маягаар/тийм маягаар; EN: the way (that) + clause (That's not the way you open it)

teaching a grandchild to ride a bike in the yard; bike and balance terms (дөрөө, жолоо, тэнцвэр, тоормос, түших); manner with -ж/-аад converbs and ингээд, тэгээд; EN: by + -ing for learning (You learn by falling and trying again)

an elder sharing her own methods (making buuz, sewing a deel) and reflecting on learning together; teaching and method vocabulary (арга, заах, дадлага, туршлага); review of яаж, ийм маягаар, -ж зааж өгөх; EN: the way (that) + clause vs how, by + -ing review

units.scope: monthly budgets, cheaper groceries, cutting subscriptions, comparing prices; household spending terms; intensified comparatives хавьгүй, хамаагүй, арай + comparative; EN: much/far/slightly/a lot + comparative, no better than

lessons.focus: making a monthly household budget; rent, utilities, food, transport and other spending categories (түрээс, төлбөр, зардал, орлого); basic comparison with -аас + adjective and илүү/бага (хоолны зардал түрээснээс их) / EN: comparatives with than, more/less + noun

choosing groceries at the supermarket vs. the market; food prices, discounts and store brands (хямдрал, бөөний үнэ); арай + comparative for slight differences (арай хямд, арай бага) / EN: slightly/a bit/a little + comparative

comparing prices at Mercury market, chain stores and online shops; price-per-kilo, bulk and quality terms; strong comparatives хавьгүй and хамаагүй (хавьгүй хямд, хамаагүй дээр) / EN: much/far/a lot + comparative

reviewing streaming, gym, phone and app subscriptions; subscription and billing terms (сарын төлбөр, цуцлах, автомат төлөлт); contrasting арай vs хавьгүй/хамаагүй to say how much you save / EN: slightly vs much/far + comparative in contrast, not much + comparative

lessons.title_en: No Better Than the Cheap One
lessons.focus: debating brand names vs. cheap alternatives (coffee, detergent, phones); value-for-money and quality vocabulary (чанар, үнэ цэнэ, үнэтэй ч гэсэн); negative comparisons -аас дээр биш, -аас дутахгүй, хамаагүй муу / EN: no better than, no more than, not any + comparative

family discussion reviewing a month of spending and setting savings goals; budgeting and saving terms (хэмнэх, хуримтлал, илүү гарсан зардал); combining intensified comparatives in longer arguments (өнгөрсөн сараас хамаагүй бага зарсан) / EN: mixing much/far/slightly/no + comparative in persuasive talk

units.scope: Dukha life in Khövsgöl taiga, tourism impact, cultural survival; ethnography terms; formal possession бүхий and composition -аас бүрдэх, -аас бүрдсэн; EN: comprise, consist of, be made up of, be composed of

lessons.title_mn: Цаатан буюу духа хэмээх ард түмэн
lessons.focus: Reading an encyclopedia-style introduction to the Dukha of the Khövsgöl taiga; ethnography basics (угсаатан, цөөнх, нүүдэлчин, тайга, хүн ам); formal possession бүхий (өвөрмөц соёл бүхий ард түмэн) / EN: consist of vs be made up of for describing populations

A herder describes the yearly migration and daily care of reindeer; reindeer and camp vocabulary (цаа буга, урц, бэлчээр, нүүдэл, сүрэг); composition -аас бүрдэх for herds and households (сүрэг хэдэн зуун толгойгоос бүрддэг) / EN: comprise (active, no 'of') vs be composed of

An ethnographer's field notes on the urts tent, tools and clothing; material culture terms (шон, арьс, туйрга, эдлэл, гар урлал); -аас бүрдсэн as a modifier (хэдэн шонгоос бүрдсэн урц) and бүхий with physical features / EN: be made of vs be made up of, consist in vs consist of

lessons.title_en: Shamans and Spirits of the Forest
lessons.focus: A lecture on Dukha beliefs, shamanic rituals and taboos; belief terms (бөө, онгон, тахилга, шүтлэг, ёс заншил); бүхий in abstract and formal phrases (эртний уламжлал бүхий зан үйл, эрх бүхий байгууллага) / EN: be composed of in formal and academic description

A debate on tourism income, photo-taking ethics and disrupted migrations; tourism impact terms (орлого, нөлөөлөл, хүндэтгэл, зөвшөөрөл, тогтвортой аялал); -аас бүрдсэн for groups and committees (малчид, жуулчдаас бүрдсэн хэлэлцүүлэг) / EN: subject-verb agreement with comprise/consist of + plural nouns

A grant proposal on language, schooling and grazing rights for the Dukha; cultural survival terms (соёлын өв, устах аюул, хэл шинжлэл, эрх зүйн хамгаалалт, хойч үе); combining бүхий and -аас бүрдэх in formal writing / EN: choosing among comprise, consist of, be made up of, be composed of by register

units.scope: dual-script official documents, calligraphy, school script lessons, signage debates; script and writing terms; means and form -х замаар, -ын хэлбэрээр, -ын аргаар; EN: by means of, by way of, via, through

lessons.focus: reading dual-script official documents and the state policy on using the Mongol script in official papers; script terms (монгол бичиг, кирилл үсэг, үйлдэх, албан бичиг, баталгаажуулах); MN -ын хэлбэрээр for the form something takes (хоёр бичгийн хэлбэрээр); EN: via for channels and routes (submitted via E-Mongolia)

visiting a calligraphy studio and learning about brushes, ink and strokes; calligraphy terms (уран бичлэг, бийр, бэх, зураас, шүд, гэдэс, сүүл); MN -ын аргаар for the method used (уламжлалт аргаар бичих); EN: by means of for tools and methods

parents and teachers discussing Mongol script lessons in secondary school and how children learn them; teaching terms (босоо бичиг, үсэг холбох, цээжлэх, дуудлага, зөв бичих дүрэм); MN -х замаар for the way something is achieved (давтах замаар сурах); EN: through for process (learning through practice)

lessons.title_mn: Хаяг дээр аль бичиг түрүүлэх вэ?
lessons.focus: the debate over storefront and street signage in UB: which script goes first and how big it is; signage terms (хаяг, самбар, хадмал, давхар бичиглэл, торгууль); MN contrast of -х замаар and -ын аргаар in policy talk (хуулиар зохицуулах замаар); EN: by way of meaning 'as a form of' and 'via a place' (by way of example, by way of Beijing)

using transliteration software, Unicode fonts and keyboards for the Mongol script; digital script terms (хөрвүүлэгч, фонт, гар, кодчилол, үсгийн хувилбар); combining all three forms (программын аргаар, автоматаар хөрвүүлэх замаар, файлын хэлбэрээр); EN: contrasting via, through and by means of in tech descriptions

lessons.title_mn: Монгол бичгийг сэргээх нь зөв үү?
lessons.focus: a C1 discussion and essay on the full return of the Mongol script: identity, cost and practicality; heritage and policy terms (сэргээн мандуулах, бүрэн шилжих, үндэсний өв, шилжилтийн үе); review of -х замаар, -ын хэлбэрээр, -ын аргаар in argument; EN: review of by means of, by way of, via and through in formal writing

units.scope: vaccination drives, smoking bans, alcohol sales limits, campaign impact; public-health policy terms; disregard forms -ыг үл харгалзан, -ыг үл тоон; EN: discourage/deter/prevent/stop + object + from -ing

lessons.title_en: Roll Up Your Sleeve: Vaccination Drives
lessons.focus: health-center vaccination campaigns and vaccine hesitancy among parents; vaccination terms (дархлаажуулалт, тун, дархлаа, хамрах хүрээ); MN -ыг үл харгалзан with nouns (эсэргүүцлийг үл харгалзан); EN: prevent/stop + object + from -ing (vaccines prevent children from getting measles)

enforcing smoking bans in cafés, karaoke rooms and bus stops; tobacco-control terms (тамхины хяналт, идэвхгүй татагч, торгууль, хориг); MN -ыг үл тоон for ignoring rules (хоригийг үл тоон тамхи татах); EN: discourage + object + from -ing (high taxes discourage young people from smoking)

debating sales-hour limits, the 1st-of-the-month no-alcohol day and shop licenses; alcohol-policy terms (зөвшөөрөл, худалдаалах цаг, хязгаарлалт, хууль бус борлуулалт); MN contrasting -ыг үл харгалзан (despite) with -ыг үл тоон (in defiance of); EN: deter + object + from -ing, deterrent

planning posters, TV spots and social-media campaigns at the health ministry; communication terms (зорилтот бүлэг, сэрэмжлүүлэг, мэдлэг олгох, зан үйлийн өөрчлөлт); MN -ыг үл харгалзан with verbal nouns (-сныг, -хыг үл харгалзан); EN: stop/keep/discourage contrasts, passive forms (people were discouraged from...)

reading evaluation reports on smoking rates, vaccination coverage and hospital admissions; impact terms (үр нөлөө, үзүүлэлт, буурах хандлага, хяналтын бүлэг); MN үл харгалзан in formal report style (хөрөнгө оруулалт буурсныг үл харгалзан); EN: prevent/deter + object + from -ing with abstract subjects (the policy deterred retailers from selling to minors)

public hearing with doctors, business owners and citizens on new health restrictions; policy-debate terms (нийтийн ашиг сонирхол, хувь хүний эрх чөлөө, хэрэгжилт); MN review of -ыг үл харгалзан / -ыг үл тоон in argument; EN: review of discourage/deter/prevent/stop + object + from -ing in debating

units.title_mn: Уртын дуу ба ардын дууны үг
units.scope: уртын дуу, folk song lyrics, singers' training, UNESCO heritage; verse and melody terms; head-rhyme alliteration (толгой холбох) and parallel lines in Mongolian verse; EN: sound devices (alliteration, assonance, internal rhyme)

lessons.focus: a radio host introduces уртын дуу and богино дуу to listeners; genre and melody terms (уртын дуу, аялгуу, цэц үг, гоёл, шуранхай); recognizing elongated vowels and melismatic syllables in sung lyrics; EN: defining sound devices with 'is characterized by' and 'is marked by'

a literature class reads 'Эрдэнэ шанзодма' and other folk song lyrics; verse terms (бадаг, мөр, холбоц, давталт); head-rhyme alliteration толгой холбох, with lines sharing first sounds; EN: alliteration, identifying repeated initial consonants

a student analyzes nature-then-feeling couplets in folk songs; imagery terms (зүйрлэл, дүр, хос мөр, эсрэгцэл); parallel lines with matching case endings and verb suffixes (уул нь өндөр / ус нь тунгалаг); EN: parallelism and assonance, repeated vowel sounds

a young singer describes years of training with a уртын дуучин; voice and breathing terms (амьсгал, хоолой, цээжний хоолой, дадлага, шавь); describing long training with -саар байгаад and -ж сурах in narrative; EN: internal rhyme in lyrics and chants

a news feature on the 2005 UNESCO listing shared with Inner Mongolia; heritage terms (биет бус соёлын өв, хадгалан хамгаалах, уламжлал, бүртгэх); formal passive and -ын хүрээнд in reports; EN: euphony and cacophony, sound in persuasive prose

a poetry workshop where participants write a quatrain for a homeland song; full review of verse terms; combining толгой холбох with parallel lines in original verse; EN: combining alliteration, assonance and internal rhyme in a short poem
